senses.meaningEn: not in the place where you are expected to be, such as school or work

examples.en: Two students are absent today.
Why were you absent from class yesterday?

senses.note: be absent from + 장소/수업. 결석 = absence(명사). 출석 부를 때 교사가 Who's absent? 라고 물음. 'miss class' 도 같은 뜻으로 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: the number, street, and town where a person lives

examples.en: What's your home address?
Write your name and address on the box.

senses.note: e-mail address = 이메일 주소. 미국식은 흔히 두 번째 음절에 강세(/əˈdres/)도 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a person who is fully grown, not a child

examples.en: Tickets cost ten dollars for adults.
Children must be with an adult at all times.
examples.ko: 어린이는 항상 어른과 함께 있어야 합니다.

senses.note: 어린이와 대화할 때는 grown-up 을 더 자주 씀. 미국식 발음은 /əˈdʌlt/ 또는 /ˈædʌlt/ 둘 다 가능.

senses.meaningEn: for or about grown-up people

examples.en: This is an adult class, so no kids are allowed.
examples.ko: 성인 수업이라서 아이들은 들어올 수 없어.

examples.en: My adult daughter still calls me every day.
examples.ko: 다 큰 딸이 아직도 매일 전화해.

senses.note: adult content/movie 는 '성인용(19금)'이라는 뜻이 되니 주의.

senses.meaningEn: later than a time or event

examples.en: Let's play soccer after school.
I'll do my homework after dinner.

senses.note: after + 명사/동명사(after eating). 시간 표현: ten after six(미국식, 6시 10분). day after day(날마다), one after another(차례로).

senses.meaningEn: later than the time when something happens

examples.en: Call me after you get home.
After we ate, we went for a walk.
examples.ko: 우리는 밥을 먹은 후에 산책을 갔어.

senses.note: after 절도 미래라도 현재형(after you get home). 한국어 '~하고 나서'에 해당. 문장 전체를 '~ later' 로 바꿀 수 없으니 주의: '3일 후' 는 three days later.

senses.meaningEn: following or chasing someone

examples.en: The dog ran after the ball.
Close the door after you.

senses.note: look after = 돌보다, run after = 쫓다, named after = ~의 이름을 따서 짓다. 이런 구동사에서는 '시간'이 아니라 '뒤따름'의 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: the part of the day between noon and evening

examples.en: I usually take a short nap in the afternoon.
examples.ko: 나는 보통 오후에 잠깐 낮잠을 자.

examples.en: Good afternoon, everyone. Please sit down.

senses.note: in the afternoon(오후에), this afternoon(오늘 오후에, 전치사 없음). Good afternoon 은 정오부터 저녁 전까지의 인사. 오후 3시는 three in the afternoon 또는 3 p.m.

senses.meaningEn: one more time; another time

examples.en: Could you say that again, please?
It's raining again today.

senses.note: 보통 문장 끝에 옴. once again = 다시 한번(약간 격식), again and again = 계속 반복해서. 상대 이름을 못 들었을 때: Sorry, what was your name again?

senses.meaningEn: how old a person or thing is

examples.en: What age is your daughter?
We're the same age.

senses.note: 나이를 물을 때는 How old are you? 가 가장 자연스러움. at the age of 10 = 열 살 때. 한국 나이와 만 나이 차이에 주의.

senses.meaningEn: a period of history

examples.en: We live in the age of the internet.
People in the Stone Age used simple tools.
examples.ko: 석기 시대 사람들은 단순한 도구를 썼어.

senses.note: the Ice Age(빙하기), the digital age(디지털 시대).

senses.meaningEn: to become older

examples.en: My grandmother has aged a lot this year.
Some people age faster than others.

senses.note: aging(미) / ageing(영) = 노화. age well = 잘 나이 들다 (사람·와인·치즈 모두).

senses.meaningEn: before now; used after a length of time

examples.en: I moved here two years ago.
She left just a few minutes ago.
examples.ko: 그녀는 몇 분 전에 막 나갔어.

senses.note: 항상 '기간 + ago' 순서(ten minutes ago). 과거형과만 쓰고 현재완료(have done)와 함께 쓰지 않는다. long ago = 오래 전에. before 는 과거 어느 시점 기준이고, ago 는 지금 기준이라는 차이가 핵심.

senses.meaningEn: the mixture of gases around the earth that we breathe

examples.en: Let's open the window and get some fresh air.
examples.ko: 창문 열고 신선한 공기 좀 마시자.

examples.en: The air is very clean in the mountains.

senses.note: 불가산. fresh air = 맑은 공기, air conditioner = 에어컨, air pollution = 대기 오염.

senses.meaningEn: the space above the ground, or travel by plane

examples.en: He threw the ball high into the air.
We sent the package by air.

senses.note: in the air = 공중에, by air = 비행기로, airport = 공항, airline = 항공사.

senses.meaningEn: a machine that makes the air in a room cooler

examples.en: Please turn on the air conditioner.
The air conditioner is too loud at night.

senses.note: 줄여서 AC(미) 또는 air con(영). 한국식 '에어컨'은 그대로 말하면 안 통함. air conditioning = 냉방(시설).

senses.meaningEn: the set of letters used to write a language, in a fixed order

examples.en: Can you say the alphabet backwards?
The Korean alphabet is called Hangul.

senses.note: alphabet 은 '글자 전체 체계'를 뜻함. 글자 하나는 letter. 'A, B, C 외워'는 learn the alphabet. 영어 글자 한 개를 alphabet 이라고 하면 틀림. 순서대로 = in alphabetical order.

senses.meaningEn: before now or before the expected time

examples.en: I have already finished my homework.
Is it ten o'clock already?

senses.note: 주로 긍정문·놀람을 나타내는 의문문에 씀. 부정문·일반 의문문에서는 yet 을 씀(Have you eaten yet?). 미국식은 과거형과도 자주 씀: I already ate.

senses.meaningEn: every time; at all times

examples.en: I always drink coffee in the morning.
She is always late for class.

senses.note: 위치: 일반동사 앞(always drink), be 동사 뒤(is always). 빈도 순서: always > usually > often > sometimes > rarely > never. 부정은 not always(항상 ~인 것은 아니다).

senses.meaningEn: used with -ing to show that something happens too often or is a habit

examples.en: You're always losing your keys!
He's always helping other people.

senses.note: be always + -ing 는 짜증(불평) 또는 애정 섞인 칭찬의 느낌. 단순 현재(always loses)보다 감정이 실린다.

senses.meaningEn: a living thing that can move and eat, such as a dog, bird, or fish

examples.en: What's your favorite animal?
We saw lots of animals at the zoo today.

senses.note: pet 은 '집에서 키우는 동물', wild animal 은 '야생 동물'. 사람을 animal 이라고 하면 '짐승 같다'는 욕이 되니 주의.

senses.meaningEn: relating to or coming from animals

examples.en: He doesn't eat any animal products.
examples.ko: 그는 동물성 식품을 전혀 안 먹어.

examples.en: We're learning about animal homes in science class.
examples.ko: 과학 시간에 동물의 집에 대해 배우고 있어.

senses.note: animal products(동물성 식품), animal rights(동물 권리), animal lover(동물을 사랑하는 사람).

senses.meaningEn: the joint between your foot and your leg

examples.en: I twisted my ankle on the stairs.
Her ankle is swollen, so she can't walk well.
examples.ko: 발목이 부어서 그녀는 잘 못 걸어.

senses.note: 발목을 삐다 = twist / sprain my ankle. 손목은 wrist.

senses.meaningEn: what you say or write when someone asks a question

examples.en: What's the answer to number three?
I don't know the answer, sorry.

senses.note: the answer to the question(전치사 to). 정답 = the right/correct answer, 오답 = the wrong answer.

senses.meaningEn: to say or write something as a reply, or to pick up the phone

examples.en: Please answer the question in English.
Nobody answered the phone when I called.
examples.ko: 내가 전화했을 때 아무도 안 받았어.

senses.note: answer the question(to 없이, answer to ✗). answer the phone/door = 전화를 받다/문을 열어 주다.

senses.meaningEn: used in questions and negative sentences to mean any person

examples.en: Is anybody home?
I don't know anybody in this city.
examples.ko: 이 도시에는 아는 사람이 아무도 없어.

senses.note: anyone 과 같은 뜻, 조금 더 구어적.

senses.meaningEn: used in positive sentences to mean any person at all

examples.en: Anybody can join the club.
Ask anybody; they all know her.

senses.meaningEn: used in questions and negative sentences to mean any person

examples.en: Does anyone know the answer?
I didn't see anyone at the park.

senses.note: 부정문에서 '아무도 ~않다'는 not ... anyone 또는 no one: I saw no one. = I didn't see anyone. 둘 다 부정(didn't + no one)은 틀림.

senses.meaningEn: used in positive sentences to mean any person at all

examples.en: Anyone can learn to swim.
Anyone who wants to come is welcome.

senses.meaningKo: 아파트(한 가구가 사는 집), 공동 주택의 한 집
senses.meaningEn: a set of rooms for living in, inside a larger building

examples.en: I rent a one-bedroom apartment downtown.
examples.ko: 시내에 방 하나짜리 아파트를 빌려 살아.

examples.en: Her apartment is on the fifth floor.

senses.note: 영어 apartment 는 '건물'이 아니라 '한 집(호)'. 건물 전체는 apartment building. 영국식은 flat.

senses.meaningEn: a round fruit with red or green skin and white inside

examples.en: I packed an apple for your lunch.
These apples are sweet and crunchy.

senses.note: 모음으로 시작하므로 an apple. apple pie(사과 파이), apple juice. 속담 An apple a day keeps the doctor away = 하루 사과 하나면 의사가 필요 없다.

senses.meaningEn: the fourth month of the year

examples.en: It rains a lot in April.
Her baby is due in early April.

senses.note: April Fools' Day(4월 1일, 만우절). April showers bring May flowers 라는 속담이 유명. 줄임말 Apr.

senses.meaningEn: one of the two long parts of your body from your shoulders to your hands

examples.en: I broke my arm playing soccer.
She was carrying a baby in her arms.

senses.note: 한국어 '팔'에는 손이 포함되기도 하지만 arm 은 어깨~손목까지. arm in arm = 팔짱을 끼고. 팔꿈치 = elbow, 손목 = wrist.

senses.meaningEn: the school subject where you draw, paint, and make things

examples.en: We painted flowers in art class today.
Art is my favorite class of the week.
examples.ko: 미술은 이번 주 중 가장 좋아하는 수업이야.

senses.note: art class = 미술 수업. 미술 선생님 = art teacher. 셀 수 없는 명사.

senses.meaningEn: paintings, drawings, and other beautiful things people make

examples.en: She loves modern art.
There's a lot of art on the walls.
examples.ko: 벽에 미술 작품이 많이 걸려 있어.

senses.note: art museum/gallery = 미술관. 예술가는 artist. the arts(복수) = 예술 전반(음악·연극 포함).

senses.meaningEn: to say something to someone in order to get an answer

examples.en: Can I ask you a question?
She asked me where I live.

senses.note: ask someone something (ask to someone ✗). 질문하다 = ask a question (question 만 동사로 쓰면 '심문하다' 느낌).

senses.meaningEn: to tell someone you want them to do or give something

examples.en: I asked him to help me with my homework.
Just ask for help if you need it.

senses.note: ask for + 원하는 것(ask for water), ask someone to + 동사(부탁). ask about = ~에 대해 묻다.

senses.meaningEn: to invite someone to go somewhere

examples.en: He asked me to his birthday party.
Why don't you ask her out?
examples.ko: 그녀에게 데이트 신청해 보는 게 어때?

senses.note: ask someone out = 데이트를 신청하다. ask someone over = 집에 초대하다.

senses.meaningEn: the eighth month of the year

examples.en: We always go to the beach in August.
The new school year begins in late August.

senses.note: 강세는 첫 음절(AU-gust). 형용사 august(/ɔːˈɡʌst/, 위엄 있는)는 강세가 달라 전혀 다른 단어. 줄임말 Aug.

senses.meaningEn: the sister of your mother or father, or the wife of your uncle

examples.en: My aunt lives in Busan with her two kids.
examples.ko: 우리 이모는 아이 둘과 부산에 사셔.

examples.en: Aunt Mary is coming for dinner tonight.
examples.ko: 메리 고모가 오늘 저녁 식사하러 오셔.

senses.note: 이모·고모·숙모 모두 aunt 하나로 표현. 이름과 함께 쓸 때 Aunt Mary 처럼 대문자. 발음은 ant 와 같게 /ænt/ 가 미국식.

senses.meaningEn: the season between summer and winter

examples.en: Autumn is the best time to visit Korea.
examples.ko: 가을은 한국을 여행하기 가장 좋은 때야.

examples.en: The autumn leaves were beautiful.

senses.note: 영국식에서 주로 쓰고, 미국식은 fall 이 더 흔하다. 끝의 n 은 발음하지 않는다(/ˈɔːtəm/). 형용사형 autumnal 은 격식 있는 표현.

senses.meaningEn: a very young child who cannot walk or talk yet

examples.en: The baby is sleeping, so please be quiet.
examples.ko: 아기가 자고 있으니까 조용히 해 줘.

examples.en: My sister just had a baby girl.

senses.note: have a baby = 아기를 낳다. 아기를 가리킬 때 it 대신 he/she 를 쓰는 게 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: a name you call someone you love

examples.en: Good morning, baby. Did you sleep well?
Baby, I'll call you after work.

senses.note: 연인·배우자 사이의 애칭. 모르는 사람에게 쓰면 매우 무례함.

senses.meaningEn: made for babies, or very small and young

examples.en: We need to buy some baby clothes.
Look at the baby birds in the nest!
examples.ko: 둥지 안의 아기 새들 좀 봐!

senses.note: baby carrots(작은 당근), baby teeth(유치)처럼 작은 것에도 씀.

senses.meaningEn: the part of your body from your neck to the top of your legs, behind you

examples.en: My back hurts from sitting all day.
examples.ko: 하루 종일 앉아 있었더니 허리가 아파.

examples.en: Lie on your back and relax.

senses.note: 한국어 '허리'도 보통 back 이라고 함(lower back = 허리 아래쪽). waist 는 허리둘레 부위.

senses.meaningEn: to or at the place where someone or something was before

examples.en: I'll be back in five minutes.
When did you get back from Busan?

senses.note: come back(돌아오다), go back(돌아가다), get back(도착해 돌아오다), give back(돌려주다).

senses.meaningEn: the part of something that is farthest from the front

examples.en: Your name is on the back of the card.
Let's sit at the back of the bus.

senses.note: in the back of(안쪽 뒤), at the back of(뒤쪽에), behind(~의 뒤에)를 구분.

senses.meaningEn: a door at the back of a house or building

examples.en: Please use the back door; the front is locked.
The dog came in through the back door.

senses.note: 비유적으로 '뒷거래·편법'의 뜻도 있지만 초급에서는 실제 문으로만 쓰면 충분.

senses.meaningEn: a bag that you carry on your back

examples.en: My backpack is so heavy today.
Put your lunch box in your backpack.

senses.note: 미국에서는 학생 책가방도 backpack. 한국식 '백(bag)' 하나로 말하면 무슨 가방인지 불분명.

senses.meaningEn: a container made of cloth or leather that you carry things in

examples.en: I left my bag on the bus.
What's in your bag? It looks heavy.

senses.note: 가방 종류: backpack(배낭), handbag/purse(핸드백), shopping bag. 책가방은 school bag.

senses.meaningEn: a thin paper or plastic container for carrying things you buy

examples.en: Do you need a bag for that?
I bought a bag of chips.

senses.note: plastic bag(비닐봉지), paper bag(종이봉지). a bag of ~ = ~ 한 봉지. 계산대에서 "봉투 드릴까요?"는 Do you need a bag?

senses.meaningEn: a packet of thin fried potato slices

examples.en: I ate a whole bag of chips while watching TV.
examples.ko: TV 보면서 감자칩 한 봉지를 다 먹었어.

examples.en: Grab a bag of chips for the party.
examples.ko: 파티에 가져갈 감자칩 한 봉지 집어 와.

senses.note: 미국에서 chips 는 감자칩, 영국에서는 감자튀김(미국의 fries). 영국식으로는 a packet of crisps. a bag of 는 봉지에 든 것 전반에 쓴다: a bag of rice/candy/popcorn.

senses.meaningEn: to cook bread, cakes, or cookies in an oven

examples.en: I'm going to bake cookies this weekend.
My mom bakes bread every Sunday.

senses.note: 오븐에 굽는 것이 bake. 불판·그릴에 고기를 굽는 것은 grill, 팬에 굽는 것은 fry, 토스터는 toast. baked potato = 오븐에 구운 감자.

senses.meaningEn: a shop where bread and cakes are made or sold

examples.en: There's a new bakery next to the station.
I bought some fresh bread at the bakery.
examples.ko: 빵집에서 갓 나온 빵을 좀 샀어.

senses.note: bakery 는 가게, baker 는 빵 굽는 사람. 한국식 '제과점'의 케이크·쿠키도 bakery 에서 판다.

senses.meaningEn: a long, curved fruit with a yellow skin

examples.en: I usually have a banana before I run.
examples.ko: 나는 보통 뛰기 전에 바나나를 하나 먹어.

examples.en: The bananas are still green.

senses.note: 발음은 [바나나]가 아니라 [버내너], 둘째 음절에 강세. 한 송이는 a bunch of bananas. go bananas = 미친 듯이 흥분하다(구어).

senses.meaningEn: a long piece of cloth you wrap around a hurt part of the body

examples.en: The nurse put a bandage on my arm.
examples.ko: 간호사가 내 팔에 붕대를 감아 줬어.

examples.en: Do you have a bandage? I cut my finger.

senses.note: 미국에서는 작은 일회용 밴드를 Band-Aid(상표명)라고 부르는 경우가 많다. 붕대를 감다 put on a bandage.

senses.meaningEn: to wrap a bandage around a part of the body

examples.en: She bandaged his knee carefully.
examples.ko: 그녀는 그의 무릎에 조심스럽게 붕대를 감았어.

examples.en: Let me bandage that cut for you.
examples.ko: 그 상처에 내가 붕대 감아 줄게.

senses.meaningEn: a container made of thin strips of wood or plastic, often with a handle

examples.en: She put the fruit in a basket.
Put your dirty clothes in the laundry basket.

senses.note: laundry basket(빨래 바구니), shopping basket(장바구니), picnic basket. 온라인 쇼핑의 장바구니는 미국에서 cart.

senses.meaningEn: the net in basketball, or a score made by throwing the ball through it

examples.en: He made the basket right before the end.
She shot the ball into the basket.

senses.note: make a basket = 골을 넣다. 농구는 basketball.

senses.meaningEn: washing your whole body while sitting in a tub of water

examples.en: I love a hot bath after a long day.
examples.ko: 긴 하루 끝에 뜨거운 물로 목욕하는 게 정말 좋아.

examples.en: Mom gave the baby a bath.

senses.note: 목욕하다 take a bath(미국) / have a bath(영국). 아기를 목욕시키다 give the baby a bath. 욕조 자체는 bathtub.

senses.meaningEn: a room in a house with a toilet, a sink, and a bath or shower

examples.en: I'll take a quick shower in the bathroom.
The bathroom is at the end of the hall.

senses.meaningEn: a room with a toilet in a public place, in American English

examples.en: Excuse me, where is the bathroom?
Can I use your bathroom, please?

senses.note: 미국에서는 식당·학교 화장실도 bathroom 또는 restroom. toilet 은 변기 자체를 가리키는 느낌이 강해 미국에서는 피함.

senses.meaningEn: a long container that you fill with water and sit in to wash

examples.en: I filled the bathtub with warm water.
The kids love playing in the bathtub.
examples.ko: 아이들은 욕조에서 노는 걸 정말 좋아해.

senses.note: 줄여서 tub 라고도 함. take a bath = 목욕하다.

senses.meaningEn: an area of sand or small stones next to the sea

examples.en: Let's go to the beach this weekend.
The kids played on the beach all day.

senses.note: '바다에 놀러 가다'는 go to the beach. on the beach(해변에서), at the beach(해변에 가 있는 상태) 둘 다 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: a seed from a plant that is cooked and eaten as food

examples.en: I added some beans to the rice.
Beans are a good source of protein.

senses.note: 주로 복수형 beans 로 씀. soybean = 대두, green beans = 껍질콩, coffee beans = 커피 원두.

senses.meaningEn: a large heavy wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws

examples.en: We saw a bear in the mountains last summer.
Bears sleep all winter long.

senses.note: teddy bear(곰 인형), polar bear(북극곰), panda bear(판다). 발음은 bare(벌거벗은)와 같음(/ber/). 맥주 beer /bɪr/ 와 구별.

senses.meaningEn: to accept or deal with something unpleasant

examples.en: I can't bear this hot weather anymore.
examples.ko: 이 더운 날씨 더는 못 참겠어.

examples.en: She bore the pain without crying.

senses.note: 주로 can't bear(참을 수 없다) 형태로 씀. 과거형 bore, 과거분사 borne. 비슷한 stand(can't stand)가 구어에서 더 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks

examples.en: My dad has a short gray beard.
examples.ko: 우리 아빠는 짧은 회색 턱수염이 있어.

examples.en: Are you growing a beard?

senses.note: 콧수염은 mustache. 수염을 기르다 = grow a beard, 수염을 깎다 = shave. 발음 /bɪrd/ (bird 와 비슷하지만 모음이 다름).

senses.meaningEn: very nice to look at

examples.en: What a beautiful dress!
Your garden is so beautiful in spring.

senses.note: pretty 보다 강한 칭찬. 사람·풍경·물건 모두 가능. 남성 외모에는 handsome, good-looking 을 더 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: very good or pleasant

examples.en: It's a beautiful day. Let's go outside.
That was a beautiful goal!

senses.note: 날씨·음악·경기 장면 등에 '훌륭하다'는 뜻으로 폭넓게 쓰임. 미국 구어로 Beautiful! 은 '좋아, 완벽해'라는 맞장구로도 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of furniture that you sleep on

examples.en: I go to bed around eleven every night.
Make your bed before you leave.

senses.note: go to bed(자러 가다), be in bed(누워 있다)는 관사 없이. make the bed = 이불·시트를 정리하다. 침대 '위에' 는 on the bed, 이불 속은 in bed.

senses.meaningEn: an area of ground in a garden where flowers or vegetables grow

examples.en: We planted roses in the flower bed.
The dog ran right through the vegetable bed.

senses.note: flower bed = 화단. 거의 항상 flower bed / vegetable bed 처럼 앞에 꾸밈말이 붙음.

senses.meaningEn: a room where you sleep

examples.en: My bedroom is upstairs on the left.
We're looking for a two-bedroom apartment.
examples.ko: 우리는 방 두 개짜리 아파트를 찾고 있어.

senses.note: 집 크기는 방 개수로 말함: a three-bedroom house = 방 세 개짜리 집.

senses.meaningEn: the meat from a cow

examples.en: I don't eat beef, but I eat chicken.
examples.ko: 나는 소고기는 안 먹지만 닭고기는 먹어.

examples.en: This beef is really tender.

senses.note: 동물은 cow, 고기는 beef. 셀 수 없는 명사: a beef (×). ground beef(다진 소고기), beef stew(소고기 스튜). 한국 음식 설명 시 bulgogi 는 marinated beef.

senses.meaningEn: earlier than a time or event

examples.en: Wash your hands before dinner.
Please come back before ten o'clock.

senses.note: before + 명사/동명사(before eating). 순서를 말할 때 Korea comes before Japan on the list(순서상 앞). 반대는 after. 장소의 '앞'은 보통 in front of 를 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: earlier than the time when something happens

examples.en: Brush your teeth before you go to bed.
Think before you speak.

senses.note: before 절은 미래라도 현재형을 쓴다(before you go, not before you will go).

senses.meaningEn: at an earlier time

examples.en: Have we met before?
I've never tried kimchi before.
examples.ko: 나는 전에 김치를 먹어 본 적이 없어.

senses.note: 문장 끝에 단독으로 쓰고 경험(현재완료)과 잘 어울린다. the day before = 그 전날.

senses.meaningEn: to start doing something, or to start happening

examples.en: Let's begin with page ten.
The class began five minutes ago.

senses.note: start 보다 약간 격식 있고 글말에서 더 자주 보임. begin with = ~부터 시작하다. 과거 began, 과거분사 begun 을 혼동하지 말 것. 명사는 beginning.

senses.meaningEn: a band of leather or cloth worn around the waist

examples.en: These pants are loose, so I need a belt.
He wears a brown belt with brown shoes.
examples.ko: 그는 갈색 구두에 갈색 벨트를 매.

senses.note: 벨트를 '매다'는 wear/put on. 태권도 '검은 띠'는 black belt.

senses.meaningEn: a strap in a car or plane that holds you in your seat

examples.en: Please fasten your seat belt.
Is your belt on? We're leaving now.

senses.note: 보통 seat belt 또는 safety belt 로 말함. 매다 = fasten/buckle up, 풀다 = unfasten.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of paper that shows how much you have to pay

examples.en: Can we have the bill, please?
I have to pay the electricity bill this week.
examples.ko: 이번 주에 전기 요금을 내야 해.

senses.note: 식당 계산서는 미국에서 check 를 더 자주 씀(Check, please!). 공과금은 bills: phone bill, gas bill. '계산은 내가 할게'는 I'll get the bill.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of paper money

examples.en: He paid with a twenty-dollar bill.
Can you change this bill into coins?
examples.ko: 이 지폐를 동전으로 바꿔 줄 수 있어?

senses.note: 미국식. 영국에서는 지폐를 note 라고 함. a ten-dollar bill 처럼 하이픈으로 연결.

senses.meaningEn: an animal with feathers and wings that usually can fly

examples.en: A bird is singing outside my window.
Those birds fly south in the winter.

senses.note: early bird = 아침형 인간. Birds fly, sing, build nests. 발음 주의: bird /bɜːrd/ 와 beard(수염) /bɪrd/ 를 구분.

senses.meaningEn: the day each year that is the same date as the day you were born

examples.en: Happy birthday! How old are you now?
My birthday is on March 3rd.

senses.note: birthday party(생일 파티), birthday cake(생일 케이크). 날짜는 on + 날짜, 월만 말할 땐 in March. 태어난 '날짜' 자체는 date of birth.

senses.meaningEn: to cut into food with your teeth

examples.en: Don't bite it. It's too hot.
She bit into the apple.
examples.ko: 그녀는 사과를 한 입 베어 물었어.

senses.note: bite into ~ = ~을 한 입 베어 물다. 과거 bit, 과거분사 bitten. 손톱 물어뜯는 것도 bite one's nails.

senses.meaningEn: when an animal or insect uses its teeth or mouth to hurt you

examples.en: Does your dog bite?
I got bitten by a mosquito last night.

senses.note: 벌레에 물린 자국은 a mosquito bite / bug bite. 벌에 '쏘이다'는 sting.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of food you bite off, or a small quick meal

examples.en: Can I have a bite of your sandwich?
examples.ko: 네 샌드위치 한 입 먹어도 돼?

examples.en: Let's grab a bite before the movie.
examples.ko: 영화 보기 전에 뭐 간단히 먹자.

senses.note: a bite of ~ = ~ 한 입. grab a bite (to eat) = 간단히 먹다. 아주 흔한 구어 표현.

senses.meaningEn: having a strong, sharp taste that is not sweet, like black coffee

examples.en: This coffee is too bitter for me.
The medicine tastes very bitter.
examples.ko: 그 약은 아주 쓴 맛이 나.

senses.meaningEn: angry and unhappy because of something unfair that happened

examples.en: He still feels bitter about losing the game.
examples.ko: 그는 경기에서 진 것에 대해 아직도 씁쓸해해.

examples.en: Don't be bitter. Just try again next time.
examples.ko: 억울해하지 마. 다음에 다시 해 보면 돼.

senses.note: bitter about ~ = ~에 대해 씁쓸해하다. 날씨가 '매섭게 추운' 것도 bitter cold.

senses.meaningEn: a dark board in a classroom that you write on with chalk

examples.en: The teacher wrote the date on the blackboard.
Can you read the blackboard from there?

senses.note: 미국에서는 chalkboard 도 흔히 씀. 흰 보드는 whiteboard.

senses.meaningEn: a thick, warm cover that you put on a bed or over your body

examples.en: It's cold. Can I have another blanket?
examples.ko: 추워. 담요 하나 더 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: She fell asleep under a warm blanket.

senses.note: 한국식 두꺼운 이불은 comforter(미) / duvet, 홑이불은 sheet. 담요를 '덮다'는 put a blanket over / get under a blanket.

senses.meaningEn: the red liquid that flows through your body

examples.en: There was some blood on his finger.
The nurse took some blood for a test.

senses.note: 발음 주의 /blʌd/ (블러드). 셀 수 없는 명사. blood test(혈액 검사), blood type(혈액형), blood pressure(혈압). 피가 나다 = bleed.

senses.meaningEn: the whole physical form of a person or animal

examples.en: Exercise is good for your body.
My whole body hurts after the hike.

senses.note: body 는 머리까지 포함한 '몸 전체'. 몸매는 figure, 체형은 body type.

senses.meaningEn: a dead person

examples.en: Police found a body near the river.
The body was taken to the hospital.

senses.note: 뉴스·드라마에서 매우 자주 나오는 뜻. dead body 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: to heat a liquid until it bubbles, or to reach that point

examples.en: Boil some water for the tea.
The water is boiling. Turn off the stove.
examples.ko: 물이 끓고 있어. 가스 불 꺼.

senses.note: 물이 끓는 상태는 boiling. '끓는 물'은 boiling water, '끓인 물(식은 것 포함)'은 boiled water.

senses.meaningEn: to cook food in boiling water

examples.en: Boil the eggs for ten minutes.
I boiled some potatoes for dinner.

senses.note: boiled egg = 삶은 달걀. hard-boiled(완숙) / soft-boiled(반숙). 국처럼 오래 끓이는 것은 simmer / stew.

senses.meaningEn: one of the hard white parts inside your body that make up your skeleton

examples.en: The doctor said no bones are broken.
Milk helps make your bones strong.

senses.note: break a bone(뼈가 부러지다). 생선 가시도 fish bone.

senses.meaningEn: a hard part inside meat or fish that you do not eat

examples.en: Be careful, this fish has lots of bones.
Chicken on the bone tastes better.

senses.note: 뼈 없는 = boneless (boneless chicken).

senses.meaningEn: a set of printed pages with a cover that you read

examples.en: I'm reading a really good book right now.
examples.ko: 지금 정말 좋은 책을 읽고 있어.

examples.en: Please open your books to page ten.

senses.meaningEn: to arrange to have a seat, room, or table at a future time

examples.en: I booked a hotel room for two nights.
Should we book a table for dinner?

senses.note: book a flight / book a table / book a room. 영국·미국 모두 흔히 씀.

senses.meaningEn: shoes that cover your foot and the lower part of your leg

examples.en: Wear your boots; it's snowing outside.
These boots are too tight.

senses.note: a pair of boots. rain boots(장화), hiking boots(등산화), snow boots. 영국에서 boot 는 자동차 트렁크라는 뜻도 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a container with a narrow neck, usually for liquids

examples.en: I always carry a water bottle with me.
Please put the empty bottles in the recycling bin.
examples.ko: 빈 병은 재활용 통에 넣어 주세요.

senses.meaningEn: the amount of liquid a bottle holds

examples.en: We shared a bottle of wine at dinner.
examples.ko: 우리는 저녁에 와인 한 병을 나눠 마셨어.

examples.en: Can you buy two bottles of milk?

senses.note: a bottle of water / wine / milk. 뚜껑은 bottle cap, 병따개는 bottle opener.

senses.meaningEn: water sold or kept in a bottle

examples.en: Can I get a bottle of water, please?
Bring a bottle of water to the gym.
examples.ko: 헬스장에 갈 때 물 한 병 가져가.

senses.note: a bottle of water = 병에 든 물 하나, bottled water = (수돗물이 아닌) 병에 든 물 자체. 두 병이면 two bottles of water(bottle 만 복수). 한국처럼 '물 하나'를 a water 라고도 구어에서 말하지만 격식에선 bottle of 를 붙인다.

senses.meaningEn: a deep round dish for food or liquid

examples.en: Put the soup in a big bowl.
I need a bowl for my cereal.

senses.meaningEn: the amount of food that a bowl holds

examples.en: I had a bowl of rice and some kimchi.
examples.ko: 밥 한 그릇에 김치 좀 먹었어.

examples.en: Would you like a bowl of soup?

senses.note: a bowl of rice / noodles / soup. 밥·국·면처럼 깊은 그릇에 담는 음식에 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a container with straight sides, often made of cardboard

examples.en: Put the books in this box.
I need a bigger box for these shoes.
examples.ko: 이 신발 넣을 더 큰 상자가 필요해.

senses.note: a box of ~ = ~ 한 상자 (a box of chocolates). cardboard box = 종이 상자, lunch box = 도시락통.

senses.meaningEn: a small square on a form or screen that you write in or tick

examples.en: Check the box if you agree.
Write your name in the box below.

senses.note: check the box(미) / tick the box(영) = 칸에 체크하다.

senses.meaningEn: breakfast cereal sold in a cardboard box

examples.en: We're out of cereal. Can you buy a box of cereal?
examples.ko: 시리얼이 다 떨어졌어. 시리얼 한 상자 사다 줄래?

examples.en: The kids finished a whole box of cereal in two days.
examples.ko: 아이들이 이틀 만에 시리얼 한 상자를 다 먹었어.

senses.note: a box of 는 상자 단위로 파는 것에 쓴다: a box of cereal/tissues/chocolates. 그릇에 담은 시리얼 한 그릇은 a bowl of cereal.

senses.meaningEn: a male child or young man

examples.en: The boy is riding his bike to school.
examples.ko: 그 남자아이가 자전거를 타고 학교에 가고 있어.

examples.en: There are twelve boys in my class.
examples.ko: 우리 반에는 남자아이가 열두 명 있어.

senses.note: 성인 남성을 boy 라고 부르면 무례할 수 있음. 아들을 뜻할 때 my boy 도 가능.

senses.meaningEn: used to show you are surprised, happy, or tired

examples.en: Boy, it's hot today!
Oh boy, I forgot my keys again.

senses.note: Oh boy! 는 기쁠 때도, 곤란할 때도 씀. 미국 구어.

senses.meaningEn: a man or boy that someone is in a romantic relationship with

examples.en: Do you have a boyfriend?
Her boyfriend bought her flowers.

senses.note: 연인만 뜻함. 그냥 남자인 친구는 a male friend / a guy friend. 한국어 '남친'과 똑같이 연애 상대.

senses.meaningEn: the organ inside your head that controls your body and lets you think

examples.en: The brain needs a lot of sleep to work well.
examples.ko: 뇌가 잘 돌아가려면 잠을 충분히 자야 해.

examples.en: Fish is good for your brain.

senses.note: brain 은 신체 기관. '머리가 좋다'는 He is smart. 또는 He has a good brain. 구어로 Use your brain!(머리 좀 써!).

senses.meaningEn: a part of a tree that grows out from the trunk

examples.en: A bird is sitting on that branch.
examples.ko: 새 한 마리가 저 나뭇가지에 앉아 있어.

examples.en: The branch broke in the strong wind.

senses.note: 작은 잔가지는 twig, 나무 몸통은 trunk.

senses.meaningEn: a local office or shop that is part of a bigger company

examples.en: Is there a bank branch near here?
The store opened a new branch downtown.
examples.ko: 그 가게가 시내에 새 지점을 열었어.

senses.note: 본사는 head office / headquarters.

senses.meaningEn: a basic food made from flour and water that is baked

examples.en: Can you buy some bread on your way home?
examples.ko: 집에 오는 길에 빵 좀 사 올 수 있어?

examples.en: I had bread and butter for breakfast.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: a bread (×) → a loaf of bread(한 덩이), a slice of bread(한 장), a piece of bread. 한국어 '빵'은 케이크·과자류까지 넓게 가리키지만 영어 bread 는 식빵·바게트 같은 식사용 빵만 뜻함.

senses.meaningEn: to separate into pieces, or damage something

examples.en: Be careful, don't break the glass.
These plates break very easily.

senses.meaningEn: to stop working

examples.en: My phone breaks every time I drop it.
examples.ko: 내 폰은 떨어뜨릴 때마다 고장 나.

examples.en: If you press too hard, it will break.
examples.ko: 너무 세게 누르면 고장 날 거야.

senses.note: 이미 고장 난 상태는 It's broken.

senses.meaningEn: a short rest from work or study

examples.en: Let's take a ten-minute break.
We have a lunch break at noon.

senses.note: take a break = 쉬다. coffee break, lunch break.

senses.meaningEn: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning

examples.en: What did you have for breakfast?
I never skip breakfast.

senses.note: have breakfast(관사 없음). eat a breakfast 라고 하지 않음. for breakfast = 아침으로. skip breakfast = 아침을 거르다.

senses.meaningEn: to take air into your body and let it out again

examples.en: Breathe in slowly, then breathe out.
It's hard to breathe with this cold.

senses.note: 동사 breathe /briːð/ 와 명사 breath /breθ/ 를 구분. breathe in(들이쉬다), breathe out(내쉬다), take a deep breath(심호흡하다).

senses.meaningEn: a brush with a long handle that you use to sweep the floor

examples.en: Grab the broom and sweep the floor.
The broom is behind the kitchen door.

senses.note: 쓰레받기는 dustpan. 걸레질용 막대 걸레는 mop.

senses.meaningEn: a boy or man who has the same parents as you

examples.en: My brother plays soccer every Saturday.
Do you have any brothers or sisters?

senses.note: 형/오빠/남동생 구분 없음. older brother / younger (little) brother. big brother 도 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to clean or make tidy using a brush

examples.en: Brush your teeth before bed.
She brushed her hair and left.

senses.note: brush my teeth(이를 닦다), brush my hair(머리를 빗다). wash my teeth 는 틀림.

senses.meaningEn: a tool with hairs or bristles used for cleaning, painting, or hair

examples.en: Where is my hair brush?
Use a soft brush to clean the shoes.

senses.note: 칫솔 toothbrush, 헤어브러시 hairbrush, 그림용 붓 paintbrush.

senses.meaningEn: a round open container with a handle, used for carrying water

examples.en: Fill the bucket with water, please.
I need a bucket to wash the car.

senses.note: a bucket of water = 물 한 양동이. 치킨 "한 통"도 a bucket of chicken.

senses.meaningEn: to make something by putting parts together

examples.en: They are building a new school near my house.
examples.ko: 우리 집 근처에 새 학교를 짓고 있어.

examples.en: We built a sandcastle on the beach.

senses.note: build - built - built. build a house / a bridge / a model. 명사 building = 건물.

senses.meaningEn: to make something such as trust or a relationship grow over time

examples.en: It takes time to build trust with someone.
examples.ko: 누군가와 신뢰를 쌓는 데는 시간이 걸려.

examples.en: We built a good friendship over the years.
examples.ko: 우리는 여러 해에 걸쳐 좋은 우정을 쌓았어.

senses.note: build trust / build a relationship / build confidence(자신감을 키우다). 근육도 build muscle.

senses.meaningEn: a soft yellow food made from cream that you spread on bread or cook with

examples.en: Can you pass me the butter, please?
Put some butter in the pan first.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: a stick of butter(한 덩이), a pat of butter(작은 조각). peanut butter(땅콩버터)도 자주 쓰임. 발음은 [버터]보다 [버러]에 가까움(미국식).

senses.meaningEn: to spread butter on something

examples.en: Butter the toast while it's still warm.
Do you want your bread buttered?

senses.note: butter up (someone) = 아부하다, 비위를 맞추다 (구어).

senses.meaningEn: a small round thing on clothes that you push through a hole to fasten them

examples.en: A button came off my shirt.
This coat has big black buttons.
examples.ko: 이 코트에는 큰 검은 단추가 달려 있어.

senses.meaningEn: a small part of a machine that you press to make it work

examples.en: Press the red button to start.
Which button turns on the TV?

senses.note: press/push a button = 버튼을 누르다. 화면 속 버튼도 button.

senses.meaningEn: to fasten clothes with buttons

examples.en: Button your coat; it's windy.
He buttoned his shirt to the top.

senses.note: button (up) = 채우다, unbutton = 풀다.

senses.meaningEn: to get something by paying money for it

examples.en: I bought some bread and eggs this morning.
examples.ko: 오늘 아침에 빵과 달걀을 좀 샀어.

examples.en: Where did you buy that jacket?

senses.note: buy A for B / buy B A = B에게 A를 사 주다(I bought her a book). 과거형 bought 발음 /bɔːt/. '사 오다'는 pick up 도 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to pay for food or a drink for someone else

examples.en: Let me buy you lunch today.
He bought everyone a drink after the game.
examples.ko: 경기 끝나고 그가 모두에게 한잔씩 샀어.

senses.note: '내가 살게'는 I'll buy. / It's on me. / My treat. 등으로 말함. 한국식 '밥 사 줘'는 Buy me lunch. 보다 Treat me to lunch. 가 부드러움.

senses.meaningEn: a large round vegetable with thick green or white leaves

examples.en: Kimchi is made from cabbage.
I had a cabbage salad for lunch.

senses.note: 배추는 napa cabbage 또는 Chinese cabbage 라고 구분해 말함.

senses.meaningEn: a small restaurant where you can buy coffee, drinks, and light meals

examples.en: Let's meet at the cafe on the corner.
I like studying at a quiet cafe.
examples.ko: 나는 조용한 카페에서 공부하는 게 좋아.

senses.note: café 로도 씀. 강세는 뒤(/kæˈfeɪ/). 미국에서는 coffee shop 도 흔히 씀. 영어 cafe 는 간단한 식사도 파는 곳.

senses.meaningEn: a restaurant in a school or office where you pick up your own food

examples.en: Let's eat lunch in the cafeteria.
The school cafeteria serves pizza on Fridays.

senses.note: cafe(카페)와 다름. 식판을 들고 음식을 받아 가는 셀프 식당. 미국 학교에서는 lunchroom 이라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: a sweet soft food made from flour, eggs, sugar, and butter, baked in an oven

examples.en: We're making a cake for her birthday.
examples.ko: 우리 그녀 생일 케이크를 만들 거야.

examples.en: Would you like a piece of cake?

senses.note: 케이크 한 조각은 a piece/slice of cake. a piece of cake = 아주 쉬운 일(관용구). 생일 케이크는 birthday cake.

senses.meaningEn: a chart or app that shows the days, weeks, and months of a year

examples.en: There's a calendar on the kitchen wall.
Let me check my calendar first.
examples.ko: 먼저 내 캘린더 좀 확인해 볼게.

senses.note: 요즘은 스마트폰 일정 앱도 calendar 라고 한다. put it on the calendar = 일정에 넣다. 철자 -dar(-der 아님)에 주의.

senses.meaningEn: to phone someone

examples.en: Call me when you get there.
I'll call you back in ten minutes.

senses.note: call back = 다시 전화하다. '전화하다'에 phone to 를 붙이지 않음.

senses.meaningEn: to say someone's name loudly, or to give a name

examples.en: Mom is calling you for dinner.
My friends call me Jay.

senses.note: What do you call this in English? = 이거 영어로 뭐라고 해?

senses.meaningEn: an act of talking to someone on the phone

examples.en: I got a call from my sister.
Sorry, I have to take this call.

senses.note: make a call = 전화를 걸다, take a call = 전화를 받다.

senses.meaningEn: a large desert animal with a long neck and one or two humps on its back

examples.en: We rode camels in the desert in Egypt.
A camel can go many days without water.
examples.ko: 낙타는 물 없이 여러 날을 버틸 수 있어.

senses.note: 낙타의 등 혹은 hump. 강세는 첫 음절, 두 번째 음절은 약하게(/ˈkæml/). camel 은 '낙타색(연한 황갈색)'을 뜻하는 색 이름으로도 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a device for taking photos or videos

examples.en: Don't forget to bring your camera on the trip.
examples.ko: 여행 갈 때 카메라 잊지 말고 가져가.

examples.en: My phone camera takes great pictures.
examples.ko: 내 폰 카메라는 사진이 정말 잘 나와.

senses.note: take a picture/photo = 사진을 찍다. on camera = 카메라에 찍힌. Smile for the camera! = 카메라 보고 웃어!

senses.meaningEn: a sweet fizzy drink in a metal can

examples.en: He opened a can of soda and sat down.
examples.ko: 그는 탄산음료 한 캔을 따고 자리에 앉았어.

examples.en: How much is a can of soda from the machine?

senses.note: soda 는 미국 일반 표현이고, 지역에 따라 pop, coke(브랜드 상관없이)라고도 한다. 영국은 fizzy drink. 한국어 '사이다'는 영어로 lemon soda/Sprite; 영어 cider 는 사과 음료·사과주다.

senses.meaningEn: a stick of wax with a string inside that you burn for light

examples.en: We lit a candle when the lights went out.
She blew out the candles on her cake.
examples.ko: 그녀는 케이크 위의 초를 불어서 꺼뜨렸어.

senses.note: light a candle = 초를 켜다, blow out a candle = 초를 불어 끄다. 생일 케이크 초도 candles.

senses.meaningEn: a sweet food made from sugar or chocolate

examples.en: Don't eat too much candy before dinner.
examples.ko: 저녁 먹기 전에 사탕 너무 많이 먹지 마.

examples.en: The kids got lots of candy on Halloween.

senses.note: 미국식. 영국식은 sweets. 보통 셀 수 없는 명사로 쓰고, 한 개는 a piece of candy.

senses.meaningEn: a soft flat hat with a curved part at the front

examples.en: He always wears a baseball cap.
Put your cap on before we go outside.

senses.note: baseball cap, swimming cap(수영모). 테가 둥글게 있는 모자는 hat.

senses.meaningEn: a small lid that covers the top of a bottle, pen, or tube

examples.en: Put the cap back on the toothpaste.
I can't open the cap of this bottle.

senses.note: 돌려서 닫는 작은 뚜껑은 cap, 냄비·상자처럼 큰 뚜껑은 lid.

senses.meaningEn: thick, soft material that covers a floor

examples.en: I spilled coffee on the carpet.
The bedroom has a soft gray carpet.
examples.ko: 침실에는 부드러운 회색 카펫이 깔려 있어.

senses.note: 바닥 전체를 덮는 것은 carpet, 일부만 깔린 작은 것은 rug. 카펫을 청소하다 = vacuum the carpet.

senses.meaningEn: a long orange vegetable that grows underground

examples.en: Rabbits love eating carrots.
examples.ko: 토끼는 당근 먹는 걸 아주 좋아해.

examples.en: Chop the carrots and put them in the soup.

senses.note: carrot and stick = 당근과 채찍(보상과 벌).

senses.meaningEn: a large metal basket on wheels that you push around a store

examples.en: Can you grab a cart at the entrance?
Our cart was full of snacks and drinks.

senses.note: 미국식 shopping cart. 영국은 trolley. 온라인 쇼핑의 '장바구니'도 cart(add to cart).

senses.meaningEn: a small vehicle with wheels that is pushed or pulled

examples.en: He pulled the heavy cart up the hill.
examples.ko: 그는 무거운 수레를 언덕 위로 끌었어.

examples.en: We bought hot dogs from a food cart.
examples.ko: 우리는 길거리 음식 카트에서 핫도그를 샀어.

senses.note: luggage cart(공항 수하물 카트), food cart(길거리 음식 수레), golf cart(골프 카트).

senses.meaningEn: money in the form of coins and bills, not cards

examples.en: Will you pay by cash or card?
I don't have any cash on me right now.

senses.note: 불가산 명사. pay in cash / pay cash = 현금으로 내다. 현금 인출기는 ATM 또는 cash machine. 한국의 '캐시(포인트)'와는 다름.

senses.meaningEn: a person whose job is to take money from customers in a store

examples.en: The cashier gave me the wrong change.
Please pay the cashier at the front.

senses.note: 강세가 뒤에 있음 /kæˈʃɪr/. 계산대는 cash register 또는 checkout. 셀프 계산대는 self-checkout.

senses.meaningEn: a small furry animal with whiskers and a long tail, often kept as a pet

examples.en: My cat sleeps on my bed every night.
examples.ko: 우리 고양이는 매일 밤 내 침대에서 자.

examples.en: Do you like cats or dogs more?
examples.ko: 고양이가 더 좋아, 개가 더 좋아?

senses.note: 새끼 고양이는 kitten. 고양이 소리 meow(야옹). 길고양이는 stray cat. cat person(고양이파) / dog person(개파).

senses.meaningEn: a large hole in the side of a hill or under the ground

examples.en: It's dark and cold inside the cave.
Bats live in this cave.

senses.note: 동굴 안으로 들어가다 = go into the cave. 동굴 탐험 = caving.

senses.meaningEn: the top inside surface of a room

examples.en: This room has a very high ceiling.
There's a small crack in the ceiling.

senses.note: roof(지붕)와 구분: 방 안에서 올려다보는 면이 ceiling. 철자 주의: cieling ✗.

senses.meaningEn: a small unit of money; there are 100 cents in a dollar

examples.en: The gum costs ninety-nine cents.
I found a few cents under the sofa.

senses.note: 기호 ¢. $1.50 은 one dollar fifty 또는 a dollar fifty 로 읽고 cents 는 보통 생략. percent(퍼센트)와 혼동 주의.

senses.meaningEn: a breakfast food made from grain, usually eaten with milk

examples.en: I usually have cereal for breakfast.
Pour some milk on your cereal.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. 종류를 말할 때만 cereals. serial(연속물)과 발음이 같음.

senses.meaningEn: a seat for one person, usually with a back and four legs

examples.en: Pull up a chair and join us.
We need two more chairs for the guests.
examples.ko: 손님용 의자가 두 개 더 필요해.

senses.note: 의자에 앉다 = sit on a chair, 안락의자처럼 푹 들어가는 의자는 sit in an armchair. 등받이 없는 의자는 stool, 긴 의자는 bench.

senses.meaningEn: a soft white stick used for writing on a blackboard

examples.en: We're out of chalk again.
The kids drew pictures with chalk on the sidewalk.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. '분필 한 개'는 a piece of chalk.

senses.meaningEn: to make or become different

examples.en: Can we change the meeting to Friday?
You've changed a lot since high school.
examples.ko: 너 고등학교 때 이후로 많이 변했다.

senses.note: change one's mind = 마음을 바꾸다.

senses.meaningEn: to put on different clothes

examples.en: Give me five minutes to change.
I need to change into something warmer.

senses.note: change clothes / change into + 옷.

senses.meaningEn: to get off one bus or train and get on another

examples.en: Change trains at the next station.
Do I have to change buses to get there?

senses.note: change trains / change buses 처럼 복수형을 씀.

senses.meaningEn: coins, or the money you get back when you pay too much

examples.en: Here's your change. Have a nice day.
examples.ko: 거스름돈 여기 있습니다. 좋은 하루 보내세요.

examples.en: Do you have change for a twenty?

senses.note: Keep the change. = 잔돈은 가지세요.

senses.meaningEn: costing little money

examples.en: These shoes were really cheap, only ten dollars.
examples.ko: 이 신발 정말 싸게 샀어, 10달러밖에 안 했어.

examples.en: Is there a cheap hotel near the station?

senses.note: cheap 은 '싸구려·질이 안 좋은' 느낌이 섞일 수 있음. 칭찬으로 말할 때는 inexpensive, affordable, a good price 가 안전.

senses.meaningEn: not willing to spend money

examples.en: Don't be so cheap. Buy her a nice gift.
examples.ko: 그렇게 짜게 굴지 마. 좋은 선물 하나 사 줘.

examples.en: My brother is too cheap to eat out.
examples.ko: 우리 형은 너무 짜서 외식을 안 해.

senses.note: 사람에게 쓰면 부정적인 뜻. 비슷한 말 stingy. 돈을 신중하게 쓰는 좋은 의미는 careful with money.

senses.meaningEn: to look at something to make sure it is correct or okay

examples.en: Let me check my schedule first.
Did you check the door is locked?

senses.note: check in = (호텔·공항) 체크인하다, check out = 퇴실하다.

senses.meaningEn: a bill in a restaurant

examples.en: Can we get the check, please?
I'll pay the check tonight.

senses.note: 미국식은 check, 영국식은 bill.

senses.meaningEn: the soft part of your face below your eye, on either side of your nose

examples.en: The baby has soft, round cheeks.
She kissed her grandma on the cheek.

senses.note: kiss someone on the cheek = 볼에 뽀뽀하다. 추워서 볼이 빨개지다 = My cheeks are red from the cold.

senses.meaningEn: a solid food made from milk, often yellow or white

examples.en: Would you like extra cheese on your pizza?
I had cheese and crackers as a snack.

senses.note: 보통 셀 수 없음: a cheese (×) → a slice of cheese, a piece of cheese. 종류를 말할 때만 cheeses. 사진 찍을 때 Say cheese! = 웃으세요!

senses.meaningEn: a professional cook, especially the main cook in a restaurant

examples.en: The chef at this restaurant is from Italy.
My brother wants to be a chef.
examples.ko: 내 동생은 요리사가 되고 싶어 해.

senses.note: chef 는 전문 요리사. 집에서 요리하는 사람은 cook. 발음은 /ʃef/ (셰프), '체프'가 아님.

senses.meaningEn: a small round red fruit with a hard seed in the middle

examples.en: Cherries are expensive in winter.
There's a cherry on top of the cake.
examples.ko: 케이크 위에 체리가 하나 올려져 있어.

senses.note: 복수형은 cherries. cherry blossom = 벚꽃.

senses.meaningEn: the upper front part of your body between your neck and stomach

examples.en: I have a pain in my chest.
He hit his chest and coughed.

senses.note: 신체 부위로서의 '가슴'은 chest. 여성의 가슴은 breast, 마음·감정의 '가슴'은 heart.

senses.meaningEn: a large strong box for keeping things in

examples.en: Put the blankets in the chest.
The kids found a treasure chest in the game.

senses.note: chest of drawers = 서랍장. treasure chest = 보물 상자. 일반적인 작은 상자는 box.

senses.meaningEn: to crush food with your teeth before swallowing it

examples.en: Chew your food slowly.
This meat is hard to chew.

senses.note: chewing gum = 껌. '껌을 씹다'는 chew gum. chewy = 질긴, 쫄깃한(떡의 식감 설명에 유용).

senses.meaningEn: the meat of a chicken, eaten as food

examples.en: I'll have the chicken, please.
We ordered fried chicken for the party.

senses.note: 고기를 뜻할 때는 셀 수 없음: some chicken, a piece of chicken. 한국어 '치킨'은 보통 튀긴 닭이지만 영어 chicken 은 조리법과 관계없는 닭고기 전체.

senses.meaningEn: a bird that is kept on farms for its eggs and meat

examples.en: My grandmother keeps chickens in her yard.
The chickens laid six eggs this morning.
examples.ko: 오늘 아침에 닭들이 알을 여섯 개 낳았어.

senses.note: 동물을 뜻할 때는 셀 수 있음: a chicken, two chickens. 수컷은 rooster, 암컷은 hen, 새끼는 chick.

senses.meaningEn: a person who is afraid to do something

examples.en: Don't be such a chicken, just try it!
examples.ko: 그렇게 겁먹지 말고 그냥 한번 해 봐!

examples.en: He's too chicken to ask her out.
examples.ko: 그는 그녀한테 데이트 신청할 용기가 없어.

senses.note: 친구 사이에서 장난스럽게 쓰는 표현. too chicken to ~ = ~할 용기가 없다. chicken out = 겁먹고 포기하다.

senses.meaningEn: a young person who is not yet an adult

examples.en: Every child needs love and care.
Tickets are free for children under five.

senses.note: 복수형은 childs 가 아니라 children. 구어에서는 kid 를 더 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: someone's son or daughter, at any age

examples.en: She is an only child.
My children are all grown up now.

senses.note: 나이와 상관없이 부모 입장에서 '자식'을 뜻함. only child = 외동.

senses.meaningEn: the plural of child; young people who are not yet adults

examples.en: The children are playing in the yard.
How many children do you have?

senses.note: childs 는 틀린 표현. children 은 이미 복수이므로 childrens 라고 쓰지 않음. 소유격은 children's.

senses.meaningEn: young people as a group, for example as readers or students

examples.en: This book is written for children.
The museum has a special program for children.
examples.ko: 그 박물관에는 어린이 특별 프로그램이 있어.

senses.note: children's book(어린이 책), children's hospital(어린이 병원).

senses.meaningEn: the part of your face below your mouth

examples.en: He has a little cut on his chin.
Keep your chin up and smile for the photo.

senses.note: chin 은 턱 끝(아래턱 앞부분), 턱뼈 전체·턱관절은 jaw. Chin up! = 기운 내!

senses.meaningEn: a sweet brown food made from cocoa beans

examples.en: I love dark chocolate.
She gave me a box of chocolates.

senses.note: 재료로 말하면 셀 수 없음(some chocolate), 낱개는 a chocolate / a box of chocolates. hot chocolate = 코코아 음료. 발음은 2음절 /ˈtʃɔːklət/.

senses.meaningEn: a pair of thin sticks used for eating food, especially in Asia

examples.en: Can you eat with chopsticks?
Could we get some chopsticks, please?

senses.note: 항상 복수 chopsticks. '젓가락 한 쌍'은 a pair of chopsticks. 한 짝은 a chopstick.

senses.meaningEn: a period of time when a teacher teaches a group of students

examples.en: I have an English class at nine.
Don't be late for class again.

senses.note: 수업에 가다는 go to class(관사 없음). in class = 수업 중에.

senses.meaningEn: a group of students who are taught together

examples.en: There are thirty students in my class.
examples.ko: 우리 반에는 학생이 서른 명 있어.

examples.en: She's the smartest girl in our class.
examples.ko: 그 애는 우리 반에서 가장 똑똑한 여자애야.

senses.note: classmate = 같은 반 친구. 한국의 '3학년 2반'은 class 2 처럼 표현.

senses.meaningEn: a person who is in the same class as you at school

examples.en: My classmate helped me with my homework.
We were classmates in high school.

senses.note: 친한 사이가 아니어도 같은 반이면 classmate. '동창'은 old classmate, 학교 전체 동기는 schoolmate.

senses.meaningEn: a room in a school where lessons happen

examples.en: Please be quiet in the classroom.
Our classroom is on the second floor.

senses.note: in the classroom = 교실 안에서. 한 단어로 붙여 씀(class room ✗).

senses.meaningEn: not dirty

examples.en: Your room looks really clean today.
examples.ko: 오늘 네 방 정말 깨끗해 보인다.

examples.en: Is this cup clean?

senses.note: clean clothes = 깨끗한(세탁한) 옷. clean water = 깨끗한 물.

senses.meaningEn: to remove dirt from something

examples.en: I clean my room every Sunday.
Can you help me clean the kitchen?

senses.note: clean up = 치우다, 정리하다 (Clean up your mess!). do the cleaning = 청소를 하다.

senses.meaningEn: a person who helps customers and sells things in a store

examples.en: The clerk helped me find the right size.
Ask the clerk if they have more in the back.
examples.ko: 뒤에 재고가 더 있는지 점원에게 물어봐.

senses.note: 미국식 발음 /klɜːrk/, 영국식은 /klɑːk/. sales clerk, store clerk 라고도 함. 호텔 프런트 직원은 front desk clerk.

senses.meaningEn: a person whose job is to keep records and do office work

examples.en: She works as a clerk at the city office.
The clerk asked me to fill out a form.

senses.note: bank clerk(은행 직원), office clerk(사무원). 미국에서는 cashier 와 clerk 를 섞어 쓰는 경우도 많음.

senses.meaningEn: quick to learn and understand things

examples.en: She's a clever student and learns fast.
My dog is clever. He opens doors by himself.
examples.ko: 우리 개는 영리해서 혼자 문을 열어.

senses.note: 영국식에서 흔하고 미국식은 smart 를 더 씀. 미국에서 clever 는 '재치 있는, 머리를 잘 쓴'의 느낌이 강함.

senses.meaningEn: showing a smart or unusual way of doing something

examples.en: What a clever idea!
That's a clever way to save money.

senses.note: too clever = 지나치게 머리를 쓰는(약간 부정적). Don't be too clever. = 너무 잘난 척하지 마.

senses.meaningEn: a device on a wall or table that shows the time

examples.en: The clock on the wall is five minutes fast.
Look at the clock. We're going to be late!

senses.note: 손목시계는 watch, 벽·탁상시계는 clock. 알람시계 = alarm clock. '시계 방향'은 clockwise. 한국어 '시계'를 전부 clock 으로 옮기지 않도록 주의.

senses.meaningEn: a small room or a space in a wall where you keep clothes or other things

examples.en: Hang your coat in the closet.
My closet is full, but I have nothing to wear.
examples.ko: 옷장은 꽉 찼는데 입을 게 없어.

senses.note: 미국식. 영국에서는 wardrobe. 서서 들어가는 큰 옷방은 walk-in closet. 가구형 옷장은 wardrobe.

senses.meaningEn: things such as shirts, pants, and dresses that you wear on your body

examples.en: I need to buy some new clothes for winter.
examples.ko: 겨울 옷을 몇 벌 새로 사야 해.

examples.en: Put your dirty clothes in the basket.

senses.note: 항상 복수형(a clothes 는 틀림). 한 점은 a piece of clothing, 셀 때는 some clothes. 발음은 close(닫다)와 같은 /kloʊz/. cloth 는 '천'.

senses.meaningEn: a white or gray shape in the sky made of tiny drops of water

examples.en: Look at that big white cloud!
Dark clouds mean rain is coming.

senses.note: 셀 수 있는 명사: a cloud, clouds. 비구름 = rain cloud. on cloud nine = 너무 행복해서 구름 위에 떠 있는 기분.

senses.meaningEn: a service that stores your files on the internet

examples.en: I save all my photos to the cloud.
Your files are backed up in the cloud.

senses.note: 항상 the cloud. in the cloud(클라우드에), cloud storage(클라우드 저장 공간).

senses.meaningEn: with many clouds in the sky

examples.en: It's cloudy, but I don't think it will rain.
examples.ko: 흐리긴 한데 비는 안 올 것 같아.

examples.en: The sky was cloudy all afternoon.

senses.note: 흐림 정도: partly cloudy(구름 조금) < cloudy(흐림) < overcast(잔뜩 흐림).

senses.meaningEn: not clear; hard to see through

examples.en: The water looks a little cloudy.
Don't drink it if the juice is cloudy.

senses.meaningEn: a group of people who meet regularly to share an interest or activity

examples.en: I'm in the art club at school.
Do you want to join our book club?

senses.note: 한국어 '클럽'은 주로 나이트클럽을 떠올리지만, 영어 club 의 기본 뜻은 '동호회'. join a club = 동아리에 들다.

senses.meaningEn: a stick used to hit the ball in golf, or a sports team and its organization

examples.en: He hit the ball with a golf club.
Which football club do you support?

senses.meaningEn: a place where people go at night to dance and drink

examples.en: They went dancing at a club last night.
examples.ko: 그 사람들 어젯밤에 클럽 가서 춤췄어.

examples.en: The club opens at ten.

senses.note: go clubbing = 클럽에 가다(놀러). nightclub 이라고 풀어 쓰면 뜻이 더 분명함.

senses.meaningEn: a long warm piece of clothing worn over other clothes when you go outside

examples.en: Put on your coat before you go out.
I lost a button on my winter coat.

senses.note: raincoat(비옷), winter coat. 짧은 겉옷은 jacket.

senses.meaningEn: a layer of paint or another liquid spread over a surface

examples.en: The wall needs another coat of paint.
examples.ko: 벽에 페인트를 한 번 더 칠해야 해.

examples.en: Give the door two coats of white paint.
examples.ko: 문에 흰 페인트를 두 번 칠해.

senses.note: a coat of paint = 페인트 한 겹. 동물의 '털'도 coat 라고 함(a dog's coat).

senses.meaningEn: a hot, dark brown drink made from roasted beans

examples.en: I can't start my day without coffee.
examples.ko: 커피 없이는 하루를 시작할 수 없어.

examples.en: How do you take your coffee?

senses.note: How do you take your coffee? = 커피에 뭐 넣어 드세요?(설탕·우유 여부). black coffee = 아무것도 안 넣은 커피.

senses.meaningEn: a cup of coffee, or a short meeting where people drink coffee together

examples.en: Two coffees, please.
Let's grab a coffee sometime this week.

senses.note: grab a coffee / get a coffee = 가볍게 커피 마시며 만나자는 표현. 잔 단위로는 a coffee, two coffees 처럼 셀 수 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a small, flat, round piece of metal used as money

examples.en: Do you have any coins for the parking meter?
I keep my coins in a small jar.

senses.note: 미국 동전: penny(1센트), nickel(5), dime(10), quarter(25). 지폐는 bill. 잔돈 전체는 change.

senses.meaningEn: a sweet, brown, bubbly drink

examples.en: I'll have a cola, no ice.
Cola has a lot of sugar in it.

senses.note: 일상에서는 cola 보다 Coke(코카콜라) 나 Pepsi 같은 상표명을 더 자주 말함. 미국 남부에서는 모든 탄산음료를 coke 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: having a low temperature

examples.en: It's so cold outside today.
Can I have a glass of cold water?

senses.note: '춥다'는 I'm cold, 날씨는 It's cold.

senses.meaningEn: a common illness that makes you sneeze and cough

examples.en: I think I'm catching a cold.
She has a bad cold and stayed home.

senses.note: catch a cold / have a cold. 관사 a 를 꼭 붙임.

senses.meaningEn: unfriendly and showing no emotion

examples.en: Why are you being so cold to me?
He gave me a cold look and walked away.
examples.ko: 그는 나를 차갑게 쳐다보고 가 버렸어.

senses.meaningEn: the quality of something that makes it red, blue, green, etc.

examples.en: What's your favorite color?
This shirt comes in three colors.
examples.ko: 이 셔츠는 세 가지 색으로 나와.

senses.note: color(미) / colour(영). 색을 물을 때 What color is it? (What color does it have? ✗).

senses.meaningEn: to put color on a picture with crayons or pencils

examples.en: Color the apple red and the leaf green.
My daughter loves coloring books.
examples.ko: 우리 딸은 색칠 공부 책을 좋아해.

senses.note: color in = (선 안을) 색칠하다. coloring book = 색칠 공부 책. 머리를 염색하다는 dye 또는 color one's hair.

senses.meaningEn: a flat tool with thin teeth used for making your hair tidy

examples.en: Do you have a comb I can borrow?
I keep a small comb in my bag.

senses.note: b 는 발음하지 않는다 [코움]. 솔 형태의 빗은 brush, 납작한 빗은 comb.

senses.meaningEn: to make your hair tidy using a comb

examples.en: Comb your hair before we go out.
He combed his hair back neatly.

senses.meaningEn: to move toward the speaker or a place

examples.en: Can you come here for a second?
The bus is coming. Hurry up!

senses.meaningEn: to go somewhere together with the listener

examples.en: We're going to lunch. Do you want to come?
examples.ko: 우리 점심 먹으러 가는데, 같이 갈래?

examples.en: Come with me, I'll show you the way.

senses.note: 듣는 사람 쪽으로 가는 건 go 가 아니라 come. I'm coming! = 지금 가요!

senses.meaningEn: to be available in a particular form, size, or color

examples.en: Does this shirt come in a smaller size?
examples.ko: 이 셔츠 더 작은 사이즈도 나와요?

examples.en: The phone comes in three colors.
examples.ko: 이 폰은 세 가지 색상으로 나와.

senses.note: come in + 사이즈/색상. 쇼핑할 때 매우 유용한 표현.

senses.meaningEn: used to tell someone to hurry or to encourage them

examples.en: Come on, we're going to be late!
Come on, you can do it!

senses.meaningEn: used to show you do not believe or agree with someone

examples.en: Come on, that's not true.
Oh, come on. Don't be like that.

senses.note: 말투에 따라 '설마', '왜 이래', '제발' 등으로 뜻이 달라짐.

senses.meaningEn: to start working, especially a light or machine

examples.en: The lights come on at seven every evening.
The heater comes on when it gets cold.

senses.meaningEn: an electronic machine that stores information and runs programs

examples.en: I use my computer for work every day.
My computer is really slow today.

senses.note: on the computer = 컴퓨터로. 데스크톱은 desktop, PC 라고도 함. computer game, computer science.

senses.meaningEn: to prepare food by heating it

examples.en: I usually cook dinner for my family.
Can you cook Korean food?

senses.note: cook 은 불을 써서 조리할 때. 샐러드처럼 불 없이 '만들다'는 make 를 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to become ready to eat by being heated

examples.en: The rice is still cooking.
Cook the eggs for about five minutes.

senses.meaningEn: a person who cooks food

examples.en: My dad is a really good cook.
She works as a cook at a school.

senses.note: '요리사'를 cooker 라고 하면 틀림. cooker 는 영국식으로 '조리 기구(가스레인지)'. 사람은 cook 또는 chef.

senses.meaningEn: a small, flat, sweet cake that is baked until crisp

examples.en: Grandma baked chocolate chip cookies.
Can I have one more cookie?

senses.note: 미국식 cookie = 영국식 biscuit. 미국에서 biscuit 은 부드러운 빵 종류.

senses.meaningEn: a small file a website saves on your computer to remember you

examples.en: This website asks me to accept cookies.
Try clearing your cookies and logging in again.

senses.note: accept/clear cookies. 거의 항상 복수형 cookies 로 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a little cold, in a pleasant way

examples.en: It's nice and cool in the morning.
Keep the juice in a cool place.

senses.note: cold(추운)보다 약하고 긍정적인 느낌. 날씨·음료·방 온도에 두루 씀.

senses.meaningEn: very good, fashionable, or impressive

examples.en: Your new bike is really cool!
Is it okay if I come late? — Yeah, that's cool.

senses.note: 구어에서 가장 많이 쓰는 뜻. 대답으로 Cool! 하면 '좋아, 알겠어'. 어른이 격식 있는 자리에서는 great 가 더 안전.

senses.meaningEn: to become or make something less hot

examples.en: Let the soup cool for a few minutes.
Cool the cake before you cut it.

senses.note: cool down = (몸·화가) 가라앉다, 식다. cool off = 더위를 식히다.

senses.meaningEn: a tall plant with yellow seeds that are eaten as a vegetable

examples.en: We grilled some corn at the picnic.
Do you want butter on your corn?

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. 옥수수 한 개는 an ear of corn. 팝콘은 popcorn.

senses.meaningEn: to have a particular price

examples.en: How much does this bag cost?
The tickets cost twenty dollars each.

senses.note: 주어는 물건: It costs 5 dollars. 사람 주어로는 쓰지 않음(I cost... ✗). 과거형도 cost. cost a lot = 돈이 많이 들다.

senses.meaningEn: the amount of money needed to buy, do, or make something

examples.en: The cost of living here is very high.
We need to cut costs this year.

senses.note: price 는 '판매 가격', cost 는 '들어가는 비용' 느낌. the cost of ~ = ~의 비용. at no cost = 무료로.

senses.meaningEn: to push air out of your throat with a sudden loud sound

examples.en: He coughed all night and couldn't sleep.
examples.ko: 그는 밤새 기침해서 잠을 못 잤어.

examples.en: Please cover your mouth when you cough.

senses.note: 발음 주의 /kɔːf/ (코프). -gh 가 /f/ 소리.

senses.meaningEn: an illness or an act of coughing

examples.en: I've had a bad cough for a week.
This syrup is good for a dry cough.

senses.note: have a cough(기침이 있다). cough syrup / cough drops(기침약·목캔디).

senses.meaningEn: to say numbers in order or find out how many there are

examples.en: My son can count to one hundred.
examples.ko: 우리 아들은 백까지 셀 수 있어.

examples.en: Let's count how many chairs we need.
examples.ko: 의자가 몇 개 필요한지 세어 보자.

senses.note: count to 10 = 10까지 세다. count on one's fingers = 손가락으로 세다. 셀 수 있는 명사는 countable noun.

senses.meaningEn: to be important, or to be included

examples.en: Every vote counts.
That doesn't count. You were cheating!
examples.ko: 그건 인정 안 돼. 너 반칙했잖아!

senses.note: It doesn't count. = 그건 무효야/셈에 안 들어가. count on someone = ~를 믿다, 의지하다.

senses.meaningEn: a long flat surface in a store or bank where customers are served

examples.en: Please take your items to the counter.
I left my bag on the counter at the bank.

senses.note: check-in counter(공항 체크인 카운터), ticket counter(매표소). '카운터에서 계산하세요'는 Pay at the counter.

senses.meaningEn: a flat surface in a kitchen where you prepare food

examples.en: The keys are on the kitchen counter.
Don't leave the milk on the counter.

senses.note: 미국식. 영국에서는 worktop 이라고 함. countertop 도 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: a child of your aunt or uncle

examples.en: My cousin and I are the same age.
All my cousins came to the party.

senses.note: 남녀 구분 없음. 'u' 발음에 주의: /ˈkʌzn/ (커즌).

senses.meaningEn: a large farm animal kept for its milk or meat

examples.en: The cows are eating grass in the field.
This milk comes from cows on a local farm.
examples.ko: 이 우유는 근처 농장의 소에서 나온 거야.

senses.note: 엄밀히는 암소. 수소는 bull, 송아지는 calf, 소고기는 beef. 소 울음소리는 moo.

senses.meaningEn: a sea animal with a hard shell, eight legs, and two large claws, often eaten as food

examples.en: We caught a crab on the beach today.
examples.ko: 오늘 해변에서 게를 한 마리 잡았어.

examples.en: I'd like the crab soup, please.

senses.note: 게의 집게발은 claw. crab meat(게살), crab cake(게살 완자). 게는 옆으로 걷는다 = walk sideways. 비격식으로 crabby = 짜증 난, 까칠한.

senses.meaningEn: a colored stick of wax that children draw with

examples.en: My son loves drawing with crayons.
examples.ko: 우리 아들은 크레용으로 그리는 걸 좋아해.

examples.en: Pass me the red crayon, please.

senses.note: 한국어 '크레파스'는 일본식 상표명. 영어로는 crayon. 색연필은 colored pencil.

senses.meaningEn: a small plastic card that lets you buy things and pay for them later

examples.en: Can I pay with a credit card?
I lost my credit card at the airport.

senses.note: pay by credit card / pay with a credit card 둘 다 가능. 체크카드는 debit card. 가게에서 '카드 되나요?'는 Do you take cards? 가 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to have tears coming from your eyes because you are sad or hurt

examples.en: The baby cried all night.
Don't cry, everything will be okay.

senses.note: 과거형 cried. 울음을 터뜨리다 burst into tears, 펑펑 울다 cry my eyes out.

senses.meaningEn: to shout something loudly

examples.en: "Help!" she cried.
He cried out in pain when he fell.

senses.note: 주로 이야기·소설에서 쓰는 용법. 일상 대화에서는 shout 이 더 흔하다. cry out = 큰 소리로 외치다.

senses.meaningEn: a long green vegetable with a cool, watery taste, often eaten raw

examples.en: Slice the cucumber for the salad.
I like cucumber in my sandwich.
examples.ko: 나는 샌드위치에 오이 들어간 게 좋아.

senses.note: as cool as a cucumber = 아주 침착한.

senses.meaningEn: a small round container with a handle, used for hot drinks

examples.en: Can I have a cup of coffee, please?
She put the cups in the sink.

senses.note: 뜨거운 음료는 cup, 찬 음료나 유리잔은 glass. a cup of tea / coffee.

senses.meaningEn: a unit for measuring food in cooking

examples.en: Add two cups of water to the pot.
The recipe needs one cup of sugar.
examples.ko: 이 레시피에는 설탕 한 컵이 필요해.

senses.note: 미국 요리 레시피의 1 cup 은 약 240ml.

senses.meaningEn: a prize shaped like a large cup, or the competition for it

examples.en: Our team won the cup this year.
Are you watching the World Cup tonight?

senses.meaningEn: an amount of coffee served in a cup

examples.en: I need a cup of coffee before work.
examples.ko: 출근 전에 커피 한 잔 마셔야 해.

examples.en: Do you want to grab a cup of coffee with me?

senses.note: grab/get a cup of coffee = 가볍게 커피 마시러 가다(만남 제안으로 자주 씀). 카페에서 주문할 때는 보통 A coffee, please. 또는 사이즈만 말한다. 홍차는 a cup of tea.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of cloth that hangs over a window

examples.en: Close the curtains. The sun is too bright.
I open the curtains as soon as I wake up.

senses.note: 보통 복수형 curtains. 커튼을 '치다'는 close/draw the curtains, '걷다'는 open the curtains. 블라인드는 blinds.

senses.meaningEn: a person who buys things or services from a store or business

examples.en: The store was full of customers on Saturday.
She is one of our regular customers.
examples.ko: 그분은 우리 단골 손님 중 한 분이에요.

senses.note: 가게·회사의 손님은 customer, 집에 온 손님은 guest, 변호사·의사의 고객은 client, 식당·호텔 손님도 guest/customer. customer service = 고객 서비스.

senses.meaningEn: to divide something into pieces using a knife or scissors

examples.en: Cut the onion into small pieces.
Can you cut the cake for everyone?
examples.ko: 모두에게 줄 케이크 좀 잘라 줄래?

senses.note: 과거·과거분사도 cut (불규칙). cut into pieces(조각으로 자르다). 얇게 썰면 slice, 다지면 chop.

senses.meaningEn: to injure your skin with something sharp

examples.en: I cut my finger while cooking.
Be careful not to cut yourself.

senses.note: cut oneself = 베이다. 다친 상처(명사)도 cut: I have a cut on my hand.

senses.meaningEn: to make something shorter by cutting

examples.en: I need to get my hair cut.
He cuts the grass every weekend.

senses.note: '머리 잘랐어'는 I got a haircut. / I got my hair cut. (남이 잘라 줌). I cut my hair. 는 내가 직접 자른 것.

senses.meaningEn: pretty and pleasing in a small or young way

examples.en: Your puppy is so cute!
The baby made a cute little sound.

senses.note: 아기·동물·작은 물건에 가장 많이 씀. 미국 구어에서는 성인에게 '매력 있고 잘생긴/예쁜'이라는 뜻으로도 쓴다(He's cute.).

senses.meaningEn: attractive in a friendly, charming way

examples.en: I think the new teacher is kind of cute.
examples.ko: 새로 온 선생님 좀 괜찮은 것 같아.

examples.en: He's cute, but he talks too much.
examples.ko: 그 사람 매력은 있는데 말이 너무 많아.

senses.note: handsome(남성, 격식)·pretty(여성)보다 가볍고 친근한 느낌. 한국어 '귀엽다'와 달리 이성적 매력도 포함할 수 있다.

senses.meaningEn: an informal word for father

examples.en: Dad, can you help me with my homework?
My dad drives me to school every day.
examples.ko: 우리 아빠가 매일 학교에 차로 데려다 주셔.

senses.note: 직접 부를 때는 대문자 Dad. 어린아이는 daddy. 미국 구어로 pops 도 있음.

senses.meaningEn: happening or done every day

examples.en: Walking the dog is part of my daily routine.
examples.ko: 강아지 산책은 내 하루 일과 중 하나야.

examples.en: I read the daily news on my phone.

senses.note: daily routine(하루 일과), daily life(일상생활), daily newspaper(일간지)처럼 명사 앞에 붙여 씀.

senses.meaningEn: every day

examples.en: Take this medicine twice daily.
examples.ko: 이 약을 하루에 두 번 복용하세요.

examples.en: The store is open daily from nine to six.

senses.note: every day 와 같은 뜻이지만 약 설명서·안내문 같은 글에 더 자주 보임. everyday(한 단어)는 형용사 "일상의"라는 뜻이니 띄어쓰기에 주의.

senses.meaningEn: a particular day of the month or year

examples.en: What's the date today?
Please write the date at the top.

senses.note: 요일을 물을 때는 What day is it?, 날짜는 What's the date? 미국식 날짜 표기는 월/일/년(10/27/2026) 순서. due date = 마감일, expiration date = 유효기간.

senses.meaningEn: a romantic meeting, or the person you meet

examples.en: I have a date with Mina tonight.
How was your first date?

senses.note: go on a date = 데이트하러 가다. 동사로도 쓴다: They're dating(사귀는 중이야). 한국어 '데이트'보다 뜻이 넓어 사귀는 사람 자체를 가리킬 수도 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a sweet, sticky brown fruit that grows on a palm tree

examples.en: These dates are very sweet.
She put dates in the cake instead of sugar.
examples.ko: 그녀는 설탕 대신 케이크에 대추야자를 넣었어.

senses.note: 한국 대추(jujube)와는 다른 과일. 중동 음식점이나 건강식 이야기에서 등장.

senses.meaningEn: a person's female child

examples.en: Our daughter is studying in Canada.
She has two daughters and one son.
examples.ko: 그녀는 딸 둘에 아들 하나가 있어.

senses.note: 철자에 gh 가 있지만 소리 나지 않음: /ˈdɔːtər/ (도-터).

senses.meaningEn: a period of twenty-four hours

examples.en: There are seven days in a week.
I'll see you in a few days.

senses.note: every day(매일, 두 단어) vs everyday(일상의, 형용사). all day = 하루 종일, the other day = 며칠 전에, day off = 휴일. 날짜를 말할 때는 What day is it today?(요일) vs What's the date today?(날짜).

senses.meaningEn: the time when it is light, between morning and evening

examples.en: It was a hot day, so we stayed inside.
Cats sleep during the day and play at night.

senses.note: during the day = 낮 동안. Have a nice day! 는 헤어질 때 인사(특히 점원이 손님에게). 24시간 '하루'와 밝은 '낮' 둘 다 day 라서 문맥으로 구분한다.

senses.meaningEn: the twelfth and last month of the year

examples.en: Christmas is on December 25th.
We have a family party every December.

senses.note: 줄임말 Dec. 연말(the end of the year)과 겨울 휴가(the holidays) 이야기와 자주 나온다. 가운데 음절 강세.

senses.meaningEn: a large wild animal with long thin legs that runs fast; the male has horns called antlers

examples.en: We saw three deer near the camping site.
examples.ko: 캠핑장 근처에서 사슴 세 마리를 봤어.

examples.en: Be careful, deer often cross this road at night.
examples.ko: 조심해, 밤에 이 길로 사슴이 자주 건너다녀.

senses.note: 단수·복수 모두 deer(deers 는 틀림). 수컷은 buck/stag, 암컷은 doe, 새끼는 fawn. 발음이 dear(사랑하는) /dɪr/ 와 같음.

senses.meaningEn: a unit for measuring temperature or angles

examples.en: It's thirty degrees today. So hot!
Turn the oven to 180 degrees.

senses.note: 숫자 뒤에 복수형: 20 degrees(1도만 one degree). 영하 5도 = minus five degrees / five below zero. 섭씨 = Celsius, 화씨 = Fahrenheit. 기호 ° 는 degree sign.

senses.meaningEn: a qualification you get when you finish university

examples.en: She has a degree in English.
He got his degree last year.

senses.note: a bachelor's degree(학사), a master's degree(석사), a PhD(박사). 학위를 받다 = get/earn a degree, 전공 = a degree in + 분야.

senses.meaningEn: having a very pleasant taste or smell

examples.en: This soup is delicious!
Thank you, the dinner was delicious.

senses.note: 이미 '아주' 의 뜻이 들어 있어 very delicious 는 어색함. really / absolutely delicious 는 가능.

senses.meaningEn: a doctor who takes care of your teeth

examples.en: I go to the dentist twice a year.
The dentist said I have two cavities.
examples.ko: 치과 의사가 충치가 두 개 있다고 했어.

senses.note: '치과에 간다'는 go to the dentist(사람으로 표현). dental clinic 도 가능. 충치 = cavity.

senses.meaningEn: a large store that sells many different kinds of things in separate sections

examples.en: I bought this bag at a department store.
The department store has a big sale this weekend.
examples.ko: 그 백화점에서 이번 주말에 큰 세일을 해.

senses.note: department = 매장 구역·부서. 백화점 안의 '층별 매장'은 the shoe department 처럼 말함. 줄여서 그냥 store 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: a large, dry area of land with very little rain and few plants

examples.en: It gets very cold in the desert at night.
Camels can live in the desert for a long time.
examples.ko: 낙타는 사막에서 오래 살 수 있어.

senses.note: desert(사막, /ˈdezərt/)와 dessert(디저트, /dɪˈzɜːrt/)를 혼동하지 말 것. 철자 s 가 하나면 사막, 둘이면 디저트.

senses.meaningEn: a table that you sit at to write, study, or work

examples.en: I do my homework at my desk.
Your keys are on the desk by the window.
examples.ko: 네 열쇠는 창가 책상 위에 있어.

senses.note: 책상'에서' 일하다는 at the desk(on 은 책상 '위에' 물건이 있을 때). 사무실 책상도 desk.

senses.meaningEn: a place in a hotel, airport, or office where you can get information or help

examples.en: Please leave your key at the front desk.
Ask at the information desk over there.

senses.note: front desk = 호텔 프런트(한국식 '프런트'는 영어로 front desk / reception). check-in desk = 공항 탑승 수속 카운터.

senses.meaningEn: sweet food eaten at the end of a meal

examples.en: What's for dessert tonight?
I'm too full for dessert, thanks.

senses.note: desert(사막, /ˈdezərt/)와 철자·강세가 다름. dessert 는 뒤에 강세. for dessert = 후식으로.

senses.meaningEn: a book or app that lists words and explains their meanings

examples.en: Look it up in the dictionary.
I use an online dictionary on my phone.

senses.note: look up a word in a dictionary = 사전에서 단어를 찾다. 영한사전은 English-Korean dictionary.

senses.meaningEn: not easy to do or understand

examples.en: This question is too difficult for me.
It's difficult to wake up early in winter.

senses.note: 구어에서는 hard 를 더 자주 쓰고, difficult 는 조금 더 격식적. 비교급은 more difficult(difficulter 는 틀림). 명사는 difficulty.

senses.meaningEn: not easy to please or to deal with

examples.en: My boss is a difficult person.
Don't be difficult. Just pick one.

senses.note: a difficult child/customer = 다루기 힘든 아이/손님. 사람 성격에 hard 를 쓰면 '냉정한'의 뜻이 되므로 difficult 가 맞음.

senses.meaningEn: a room in a home where people eat meals

examples.en: Dinner is ready. Everyone to the dining room!
The dining room table seats six people.
examples.ko: 식당 테이블에는 여섯 명이 앉을 수 있어.

senses.note: 밖의 '식당(음식점)'은 restaurant. dining room 은 집·호텔 안의 식사 공간.

senses.meaningEn: the main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening

examples.en: Dinner is ready, come and sit down.
We're having chicken for dinner.

senses.note: have dinner(관사 없음). 하루 중 가장 큰 식사라는 뜻이라 일부 지역에선 점심을 dinner 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: a formal evening meal or social event with food

examples.en: They invited us to dinner on Saturday.
examples.ko: 그들이 토요일 저녁 식사에 우리를 초대했어.

examples.en: We had a nice dinner with my parents.
examples.ko: 부모님과 좋은 저녁 식사 자리를 가졌어.

senses.note: dinner party = 저녁 파티. go out for dinner = 저녁 외식하다. 사람을 초대할 때 invite someone to dinner.

senses.meaningEn: covered with dirt or marks; not clean

examples.en: My shoes got dirty in the rain.
Don't put dirty dishes on the table.
examples.ko: 더러운 접시를 식탁에 올려 두지 마.

senses.note: get dirty = 더러워지다. dirty clothes = 빨랫감. 비교급 dirtier, 최상급 dirtiest.

senses.meaningEn: an amount of money taken off the usual price

examples.en: Can I get a discount if I buy two?
Students get a ten percent discount here.

senses.note: get/give a discount, a 20% discount on + 물건. 한국어 '디씨'는 영어로 통하지 않음. '깎아 주세요'는 Can you give me a discount? 가 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: food prepared in a particular way as part of a meal

examples.en: Bibimbap is my favorite Korean dish.
examples.ko: 비빔밥은 내가 가장 좋아하는 한국 요리야.

examples.en: What's the most popular dish here?
examples.ko: 여기서 가장 인기 있는 요리가 뭐예요?

senses.note: a Korean dish = 한국 요리 한 가지. main dish(메인 요리), side dish(반찬).

senses.meaningEn: the plates, bowls, and cups that need to be washed after a meal

examples.en: Can you wash the dishes tonight?
examples.ko: 오늘 밤 설거지 좀 해 줄래?

examples.en: I'll do the dishes after dinner.

senses.note: 설거지하다 = wash the dishes / do the dishes (항상 복수). dishwasher = 식기세척기.

senses.meaningEn: feeling as if everything is spinning and you might fall

examples.en: I feel dizzy when I stand up too fast.
She got dizzy after the roller coaster.

senses.note: feel dizzy / get dizzy. 병원에서 '어지러워요'는 I feel dizzy. 머리가 아픈 건 headache 로 따로 말한다.

senses.meaningEn: a person whose job is to treat people who are sick or hurt

examples.en: You should see a doctor about that cough.
examples.ko: 그 기침은 의사한테 진찰받아 봐야 해.

examples.en: The doctor told me to rest for a few days.

senses.note: 병원에 가다 = go to the doctor / see a doctor(큰 병원이 아니면 hospital 보다 이렇게 말함). 호칭은 Dr. Kim. 박사 학위도 doctor.

senses.meaningEn: a common animal with four legs that people keep as a pet or to guard a house

examples.en: I walk my dog every morning before work.
examples.ko: 출근 전에 매일 아침 개를 산책시켜.

examples.en: Is your dog friendly with kids?

senses.note: 강아지는 puppy. walk the dog = 개를 산책시키다. hot dog 는 음식! 사람에게 dog 라고 하면 비속어가 되니 주의.

senses.meaningEn: the unit of money used in the US, Canada, Australia, and some other countries

examples.en: This T-shirt is only five dollars.
Can you lend me a few dollars for lunch?
examples.ko: 점심 먹을 몇 달러만 빌려줄 수 있어?

senses.note: 기호 $ 는 숫자 앞에 씀($5), 읽을 때는 five dollars. 구어로 bucks(a few bucks)도 매우 흔함. 1달러 = 100 cents.

senses.meaningEn: a smart sea animal that looks like a large fish and breathes air

examples.en: We saw dolphins jumping next to our boat!
examples.ko: 우리 배 옆에서 돌고래들이 점프하는 걸 봤어!

examples.en: Dolphins are very smart and friendly animals.

senses.note: 돌고래는 물고기(fish)가 아니라 포유류(mammal). 발음은 '달핀'(/ˈdɑːlfɪn/)에 가깝고 '돌핀'이 아님. dolphin watching = 돌고래 관찰 투어.

senses.meaningEn: a small round sweet cake, often with a hole in the middle, fried in oil

examples.en: I grabbed a donut and coffee on the way.
examples.ko: 오는 길에 도넛이랑 커피를 하나 샀어.

examples.en: These donuts are still warm!

senses.note: doughnut 으로도 씀(원래 철자). 미국에서는 donut 이 더 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: a flat piece of wood or metal that you open to go into or out of a room or building

examples.en: Can you close the door, please?
Someone is knocking at the door.

senses.note: open/close/shut the door. 문을 '잠그다'는 lock the door. 옆집은 next door. answer the door = (초인종 소리에) 문을 열어 주다.

senses.meaningEn: to or on a lower floor of a building

examples.en: Come downstairs, dinner is ready!
The kitchen is downstairs on the first floor.

senses.note: go/come downstairs 에 to 를 붙이지 않음. 미국식 first floor = 1층(한국과 같음), 영국식은 ground floor.

senses.meaningEn: a group of twelve

examples.en: Can you buy a dozen eggs on your way home?
examples.ko: 집에 오는 길에 달걀 한 판(12개) 사 올 수 있어?

examples.en: The donuts are five dollars a dozen.

senses.note: a dozen eggs(of 없이 씀). half a dozen = 6개. 미국 마트에서 달걀·도넛·베이글은 12개 단위로 자주 판다.

senses.meaningEn: a lot of people or things

examples.en: I've told you a dozen times to clean your room.
There were dozens of people waiting outside.

senses.note: dozens of = 수십 개의(정확히 12의 배수는 아님). a dozen times = 여러 번(과장).

senses.meaningEn: to make a picture with a pencil or pen

examples.en: I like to draw cats and dogs.
examples.ko: 나는 고양이랑 강아지 그리는 걸 좋아해.

examples.en: She drew a map to her house for me.
examples.ko: 그녀가 나한테 자기 집까지 가는 지도를 그려 줬어.

senses.note: draw 는 선으로, paint 는 물감으로 그림. 그림(명사)은 drawing. 과거형 drew, 과거분사 drawn.

senses.meaningEn: to pull something such as curtains open or closed

examples.en: Can you draw the curtains? It's too bright.
examples.ko: 커튼 좀 쳐 줄래? 너무 밝아.

examples.en: She drew the blinds and went to bed.

senses.note: draw the curtains 는 열다·닫다 둘 다 가능하므로 open/close 로 분명히 말해도 좋음.

senses.meaningEn: to finish a game with the same score as the other team

examples.en: The two teams drew 1–1.
We drew with the best team in the league!

senses.note: 미국에서는 tie 를 더 많이 씀. 명사로도 a draw = 무승부.

senses.meaningEn: a box-shaped part of a desk or cupboard that you pull out to open

examples.en: The scissors are in the top drawer.
Open the drawer and take out a spoon.

senses.note: 발음 주의: /drɔːr/ 한 음절처럼 읽음. 서랍장은 chest of drawers / dresser.

senses.meaningEn: pictures and events you see in your mind while you sleep

examples.en: I had a strange dream last night.
Sweet dreams! See you tomorrow.

senses.note: 꿈을 꾸다 have a dream. 악몽은 nightmare, bad dream.

senses.meaningEn: something you want very much to happen in the future

examples.en: My dream is to travel around the world.
examples.ko: 내 꿈은 세계 여행을 하는 거야.

examples.en: Her dream came true last year.

senses.note: a dream come true = 꿈이 이루어진 것. dream job, dream house 처럼 형용사처럼도 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: to see things in your sleep, or to hope for something

examples.en: I dreamed about my old school last night.
I've always dreamed of living by the sea.
examples.ko: 나는 항상 바닷가에 사는 걸 꿈꿔 왔어.

senses.note: dream about(꿈에 나오다) / dream of(소망하다). 과거형은 dreamed 와 dreamt 둘 다 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of clothing for women that covers the body and part of the legs in one piece

examples.en: She bought a red dress for the wedding.
examples.ko: 그녀는 결혼식에 입을 빨간 드레스를 샀어.

examples.en: That dress looks great on you.
examples.ko: 그 원피스 너한테 정말 잘 어울려.

senses.note: 한국어 '원피스'는 영어로 dress. one-piece 는 영어에서 주로 수영복을 말함. wedding dress, summer dress.

senses.meaningEn: to put clothes on yourself or someone else

examples.en: Get dressed, we're leaving in ten minutes.
She dresses her little son every morning.
examples.ko: 그녀는 매일 아침 어린 아들에게 옷을 입혀.

senses.note: get dressed = 옷을 입다, dress up = 차려입다·변장하다, dress warmly = 따뜻하게 입다. 일상에서 '입다'는 put on/wear 가 더 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it
