examples.en: Drink lots of water when it's hot.
I drank two cups of coffee this morning.
examples.ko: 오늘 아침에 커피 두 잔 마셨어.

senses.note: 과거형 drank, 과거분사 drunk. 약을 먹는 것은 take medicine(drink 가 아님). 국을 먹는 것도 eat soup.

senses.meaningEn: a liquid that you drink

examples.en: Would you like a drink with your meal?
Can I get you a cold drink?

senses.note: soft drink = 탄산음료·청량음료.

senses.meaningEn: an alcoholic drink

examples.en: Let's go for a drink after work.
He had a few drinks at the party.
examples.ko: 그는 파티에서 술을 몇 잔 마셨어.

senses.note: go for a drink / have a drink 는 보통 술을 뜻한다. 술에 취하다 get drunk.

senses.meaningEn: a bird with short legs and a wide flat beak that lives near water

examples.en: Let's feed the ducks at the pond.
A duck is swimming with her five babies.
examples.ko: 오리 한 마리가 새끼 다섯 마리와 헤엄치고 있어.

senses.note: 새끼 오리는 duckling. 오리 소리는 quack. 식당 메뉴의 duck 은 오리고기(roast duck).

senses.meaningEn: to lower your head or body quickly so you are not hit or seen

examples.en: Duck! The ball is coming this way!
He ducked just before the door hit him.
examples.ko: 문에 부딪히기 직전에 그가 몸을 숙였어.

senses.note: 오리가 물속에 머리를 쏙 넣는 모습에서 나온 동사. duck out (of) = 슬쩍 빠져나가다(비격식).

senses.meaningEn: through the whole of a period, or at some point in it

examples.en: Please turn off your phone during class.
It rained a lot during our trip.
examples.ko: 우리 여행 중에 비가 많이 왔어.

senses.note: during 뒤에는 명사(during the movie), for 뒤에는 기간 길이(for two hours). 한국어 '~동안' 을 둘 다로 옮기므로 가장 흔한 실수: during two hours(X) → for two hours(O). while 은 뒤에 절(주어+동사)이 온다.

senses.meaningEn: very small dry pieces of dirt that cover surfaces

examples.en: There is a lot of dust on the shelf.
The dust made me sneeze.

senses.note: 불가산(a dust ✗). 미세먼지 = fine dust, 황사 = yellow dust. 먼지 많은 = dusty.

senses.meaningEn: to clean the dust off something

examples.en: I dust the furniture once a week.
examples.ko: 나는 일주일에 한 번 가구 먼지를 닦아.

examples.en: Can you dust the shelves before the guests come?
examples.ko: 손님 오기 전에 선반 먼지 좀 닦아 줄래?

senses.meaningEn: a very large strong bird with a curved beak that hunts small animals

examples.en: An eagle was flying high above the mountains.
examples.ko: 독수리 한 마리가 산 위로 높이 날고 있었어.

examples.en: Eagles have very strong eyes and can see far away.
examples.ko: 독수리는 눈이 아주 좋아서 멀리까지 볼 수 있어.

senses.note: 미국의 상징 새는 bald eagle(흰머리수리). 한국어 '독수리'는 영어로 vulture(죽은 동물을 먹는 새)인 경우가 많으니 주의 — eagle 은 살아 있는 먹이를 잡는 '수리'. eagle eye = 날카로운 관찰력.

senses.meaningEn: one of the two parts of your head that you hear with

examples.en: My ears hurt on the plane.
She whispered something in my ear.

senses.note: 귀앓이 = earache, 이어폰 = earphones, 귀걸이 = earrings. 귀 기울여 듣다 = listen carefully(ear 를 쓰지 않음).

senses.meaningEn: before the usual or expected time

examples.en: You're early! The movie starts at seven.
I have an early class tomorrow.

senses.note: 형용사·부사 모두 early. 비교급 earlier(더 일찍, 조금 전에). early bird = 아침형 인간. Is it too early? = 너무 이른가요?

senses.meaningEn: before the usual time, or near the beginning of a period

examples.en: I get up early every morning.
We left early to avoid the traffic.

senses.note: early in the morning = 아침 일찍, early next week = 다음 주 초에. fast(빠른 속도)와 혼동 금지 — 시간상 '일찍'은 early.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of jewelry that you wear on your ear

examples.en: I lost one earring at the party.
These earrings match your necklace.
examples.ko: 이 귀걸이는 네 목걸이랑 잘 어울려.

senses.note: 보통 복수 earrings, 한 쌍은 a pair of earrings. 한국어 '피어싱'은 영어로 piercing(뚫은 구멍) 또는 그냥 earring.

senses.meaningEn: the planet we live on

examples.en: The Earth goes around the Sun.
There are eight billion people on Earth.

senses.note: 행성 이름일 때는 보통 대문자 Earth, 앞에 the 를 붙이기도 하고 빼기도 함. on earth 는 '도대체'라는 강조 표현(What on earth?).

senses.meaningEn: the soil that plants grow in

examples.en: Cover the seeds with a little earth.
The earth was wet after the rain.
examples.ko: 비가 온 뒤 땅이 젖어 있었어.

senses.note: 흙은 일상적으로 soil, dirt(미)를 더 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: not hard to do or understand

examples.en: The test was easy for me.
English is easier than math for her.

senses.note: It's easy to do = ~하기 쉽다. 부사는 easily(쉽게). 비교급 easier, 최상급 easiest (y → i).

senses.meaningEn: relaxed and not worried

examples.en: Take it easy and get some rest.
We had an easy weekend at home.

senses.note: Take it easy. = 진정해/쉬어 가면서 해/잘 가(헤어질 때). easy-going = 성격이 느긋한. Easy! = 조심해, 살살!

senses.meaningEn: to put food in your mouth, chew it, and swallow it

examples.en: What do you want to eat for lunch?
I ate too much at dinner.

senses.note: 과거 ate /eɪt/, 과거분사 eaten. 한국어 '먹다'와 달리 약은 take medicine, 음료는 drink. 국은 eat soup(숟가락으로 먹으므로).

senses.meaningEn: to have a meal

examples.en: Have you eaten yet?
Let's eat out tonight.

senses.note: eat out = 외식하다, eat in = 집에서 먹다. 인사말 '밥 먹었어?'는 Have you eaten? 으로 번역되지만 영어권에선 인사로 잘 쓰지 않음.

senses.meaningEn: a chicken's egg used as food

examples.en: How do you want your eggs, fried or boiled?
examples.ko: 계란 어떻게 해 줄까, 프라이 아니면 삶은 거?

examples.en: I eat two eggs every morning.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 아침 계란 두 개를 먹어.

senses.note: 조리법 표현: fried egg(계란 프라이), boiled egg(삶은 계란), scrambled eggs(스크램블), sunny-side up(한쪽만 익힌 프라이). 한 판은 a dozen eggs(12개) 또는 a carton of eggs.

senses.meaningEn: a round object with a shell that a baby bird or animal grows inside

examples.en: The bird laid three eggs in the nest.
examples.ko: 새가 둥지에 알을 세 개 낳았어.

examples.en: Look, the eggs are starting to hatch!

senses.note: lay an egg = 알을 낳다, hatch = 부화하다.

senses.meaningEn: the number 8

examples.en: My daughter is eight years old.
I usually sleep about eight hours.
examples.ko: 나는 보통 여덟 시간 정도 자.

senses.note: ate(먹었다)와 발음이 같음(/eɪt/). gh 는 소리 나지 않음. 서수는 eighth(8th, /eɪtθ/). eighteen(18), eighty(80).

senses.meaningEn: the number 18

examples.en: You can vote when you turn eighteen.
examples.ko: 열여덟 살이 되면 투표할 수 있어.

examples.en: The ticket costs eighteen dollars.

senses.note: eight + teen 에서 t 가 하나로 합쳐짐(eighteen). 미국·영국에서 18세는 법적 성인이 되는 나이.

senses.meaningEn: the number 80

examples.en: This phone was about eighty dollars.
My grandpa is eighty and very healthy.

senses.note: eight + y 에서 t 가 하나(eighty). 서수는 eightieth(80th). in his eighties = 80대에.

senses.meaningEn: the joint in the middle of your arm where it bends

examples.en: I bumped my elbow on the table.
Don't put your elbows on the table while eating.
examples.ko: 먹을 때 탁자에 팔꿈치 올리지 마.

senses.note: 다리의 무릎(knee)에 대응하는 팔의 관절. 식탁 예절: no elbows on the table.

senses.meaningEn: a very large gray animal with big ears and a long nose called a trunk

examples.en: An elephant can drink with its long nose.
examples.ko: 코끼리는 긴 코로 물을 마실 수 있어.

examples.en: The baby elephant stayed close to its mother.
examples.ko: 새끼 코끼리가 어미 곁에 바짝 붙어 있었어.

senses.note: 코끼리의 코는 trunk, 긴 이빨은 tusk. 강세는 첫 음절(/ˈel-/). 중급에서 배우는 the elephant in the room 은 '모두 알지만 말하지 않는 문제'.

senses.meaningEn: a machine that carries people up and down inside a building

examples.en: Take the elevator to the tenth floor.
The elevator is out of order again.

senses.note: 미국식. 영국에서는 lift. 엘리베이터를 '타다'는 take/get in the elevator. 에스컬레이터는 escalator.

senses.meaningEn: the number 11

examples.en: The meeting starts at eleven.
A soccer team has eleven players.

senses.note: 11, 12는 -teen 이 붙지 않는 예외. 강세는 두 번째 음절(e-LEV-en). 서수는 eleventh(11th).

senses.meaningEn: the language spoken in the UK, the US, and many other countries

examples.en: I study English for an hour every day.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 한 시간씩 영어를 공부해.

examples.en: How do you say this in English?

senses.note: 항상 대문자 E(English). speak English(관사 없음). in English = 영어로. 영어 수업은 English class.

senses.meaningEn: from or relating to England

examples.en: We had a traditional English breakfast.
My new friend is English, from London.
examples.ko: 내 새 친구는 런던 출신의 영국 사람이야.

senses.note: English 는 '잉글랜드'의. 영국 전체(UK)는 British. 스코틀랜드 사람에게 English 라고 하면 실례.

senses.meaningEn: a small piece of rubber used to remove pencil marks

examples.en: I need an eraser to fix this mistake.
Can I use your eraser for a second?

senses.note: 미국식 eraser, 영국식 rubber. 미국에서 rubber 는 전혀 다른 뜻이 되므로 주의. 칠판 지우개도 eraser.

senses.meaningEn: the part of the day from the end of the afternoon until you go to bed

examples.en: We usually eat dinner at seven in the evening.
What are you doing this evening?

senses.note: evening 은 대략 6시~취침 전, night 은 어두운 밤 전체(혹은 잠자는 시간). 만났을 때 인사는 Good evening, 헤어질 때·잘 때 인사는 Good night. 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: 저녁 7시 약속을 at night 이라고 하면 어색함 → in the evening.

senses.meaningEn: every person in a group

examples.en: Hi, everybody! How are you today?
Everybody loves this song.

senses.note: everyone 과 뜻이 같고 조금 더 구어적. 글에서는 everyone 이 약간 더 흔함. 단수 동사(loves)와 함께 씀.

senses.meaningEn: every person in a group

examples.en: Everyone is here, so let's start.
Thank you, everyone, for coming today.
examples.ko: 오늘 와 주신 모든 분들, 감사합니다.

senses.note: 뜻은 복수지만 문법은 단수: Everyone is(○) Everyone are(×). every one(띄어쓰기)은 '하나하나 전부'로 다른 말.

senses.meaningEn: an important test at the end of a course or school year

examples.en: My final exams start next week.
Did you pass your driving exam?

senses.note: examination 의 줄임말. take an exam(시험을 보다), pass/fail an exam. 수능처럼 큰 시험은 exam, 쪽지시험은 quiz.

senses.meaningEn: something that shows what a kind of thing is like

examples.en: Can you give me an example?
examples.ko: 예를 하나 들어 줄 수 있어요?

examples.en: For example, apples and pears are fruit.

senses.note: give an example(예를 들다), for example = 예를 들어(e.g. 로 축약). 'give me a sample' 은 물건의 견본을 달라는 뜻이니 구분.

senses.meaningEn: a person or action that is good and that others should copy

examples.en: Parents should set a good example.
She's a good example for her little brother.

senses.note: set an example = 본보기를 보이다. follow someone's example = ~를 본받다.

senses.meaningEn: physical activity you do to stay healthy

examples.en: I need more exercise. I sit all day.
examples.ko: 운동이 더 필요해. 하루 종일 앉아 있거든.

examples.en: Walking is good exercise for everyone.

senses.note: '운동하다'는 do exercise 또는 exercise(동사). play exercise 는 틀림. 특정 스포츠는 play soccer 처럼 play 를 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: to do physical activity to stay healthy

examples.en: I try to exercise every morning.
Do you exercise at the gym or at home?

senses.meaningEn: a short piece of work you do to practice something

examples.en: Do exercises one to five for homework.
This grammar exercise is really hard.
examples.ko: 이 문법 연습 문제 정말 어렵다.

senses.note: 교과서의 '연습 문제'는 exercise. 시험 문제는 question.

senses.meaningEn: costing a lot of money

examples.en: That restaurant is too expensive for us.
Why are these headphones so expensive?

senses.note: '가격이 비싸다'는 The price is high. 라고 해야 함(expensive price 는 어색). 구어로는 pricey 도 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: one of the two parts of your face that you see with

examples.en: Close your eyes and count to ten.
My eyes are tired from the screen.

senses.note: She has brown eyes. 눈 색을 말할 때는 복수. eye doctor(안과 의사), eye drops(안약).

senses.meaningEn: used in phrases about watching something carefully

examples.en: Can you keep an eye on my bag?
Keep an eye on the kids, please.

senses.note: keep an eye on ~ = ~를 지켜보다, 신경 써서 보다. catch my eye = 눈에 띄다.

senses.meaningEn: the front of your head with your eyes, nose, and mouth

examples.en: Go wash your face before breakfast.
She had a big smile on her face.

senses.note: make a face = 얼굴을 찡그리다. face to face = 얼굴을 마주 보고, 직접.

senses.meaningEn: to have the front toward something

examples.en: My room faces the park.
examples.ko: 내 방은 공원 쪽을 향해 있어.

examples.en: Please face the camera and smile.

senses.note: face the window / face south(남향). 뒤에 to 를 붙이지 않음.

senses.meaningEn: to deal with a difficult situation

examples.en: We have to face the problem now.
I can't face another exam this week.
examples.ko: 이번 주에 시험 하나 더는 못 견디겠어.

senses.note: Let's face it. = 인정하자, 현실을 보자.

senses.meaningEn: to drop down to the ground, often by accident

examples.en: Be careful, don't fall on the ice!
He fell off his bike and hurt his knee.

senses.note: fall down(넘어지다), fall off(~에서 떨어지다), fall asleep(잠들다), fall in love(사랑에 빠지다). 불규칙 변화 fall-fell-fallen.

senses.meaningEn: to become lower in number, price, or level

examples.en: Prices usually fall after the holidays.
The temperature fell below zero last night.

senses.meaningEn: the season between summer and winter, when leaves change color

examples.en: I love the colors of fall.
Classes start again in the fall.

senses.note: 미국에서는 fall, 영국에서는 autumn 을 주로 쓴다. 미국에서도 autumn 은 알아듣지만 조금 문어적으로 들림. fall semester = 가을 학기.

senses.meaningEn: a group of people who are related, such as parents and their children

examples.en: I have a big family with three brothers.
We eat dinner together as a family.
examples.ko: 우리는 가족이 다 함께 저녁을 먹어.

senses.note: family 는 집합명사. 미국식은 My family is..., 영국식은 My family are... 둘 다 가능.

senses.meaningEn: made for or shared by a whole family

examples.en: It's a family movie, so the kids can watch.
examples.ko: 가족 영화라서 아이들도 볼 수 있어.

examples.en: We're going on a family trip this weekend.

senses.note: family dinner, family car, family name(성) 처럼 명사 앞에서 형용사처럼 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: a machine with blades that turn to move air and keep you cool

examples.en: Turn on the fan, it's so hot in here.
The fan is making a strange noise.

senses.note: electric fan(선풍기), ceiling fan(천장 선풍기). 부채(손으로 흔드는 것)도 fan.

senses.meaningEn: someone who likes a team, singer, or thing very much

examples.en: I'm a big fan of this band.
The fans cheered when the team scored.

senses.note: I'm a big fan of ~ = ~를 정말 좋아해 (사람뿐 아니라 음식·영화에도 씀). I'm not a fan of ~ = ~는 별로 안 좋아해.

senses.meaningEn: an area of land and buildings where people grow food and keep animals

examples.en: My grandparents live on a farm.
We saw pigs and chickens at the farm.

senses.note: 농장에 산다는 on a farm (in ✗). 농부 = farmer, 농사 = farming.

senses.meaningEn: to grow crops or keep animals on land to make money

examples.en: His family has farmed this land for 100 years.
examples.ko: 그의 가족은 100년 동안 이 땅에서 농사를 지어 왔어.

examples.en: They farm rice and vegetables.

senses.meaningEn: a style of clothes or hair that is popular at a certain time

examples.en: My sister loves fashion and reads about it every day.
examples.ko: 내 여동생은 패션을 좋아해서 매일 관련 글을 읽어.

examples.en: Short hair is in fashion again this year.

senses.note: in fashion = 유행하는, out of fashion = 유행이 지난. fashion show(패션쇼), fashion model(패션모델). 한국어 '패션 감각'은 a sense of style 또는 fashion sense.

senses.meaningEn: hot food like burgers and fries that is served quickly

examples.en: I eat fast food maybe once a week.
examples.ko: 패스트푸드는 일주일에 한 번 정도 먹어.

examples.en: Let's grab some fast food on the way home.
examples.ko: 집에 가는 길에 패스트푸드 좀 사 가자.

senses.note: 불가산명사. a fast food 라고 하지 않음. '패스트푸드점'은 fast food restaurant.

senses.meaningEn: having too much flesh on the body

examples.en: My cat is getting fat because he eats too much.
examples.ko: 우리 고양이는 너무 많이 먹어서 살이 찌고 있어.

examples.en: I feel fat after the holidays.

senses.note: 사람에게 직접 fat 이라고 하면 매우 무례하다. 완곡하게는 overweight, heavy, big 을 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: the oily substance in food or under the skin

examples.en: This milk has no fat in it.
Cut the fat off the meat before cooking.
examples.ko: 요리하기 전에 고기에서 기름을 떼어 내.

senses.note: low-fat(저지방), fat-free(무지방). 요리용 기름은 oil.

senses.meaningEn: a male parent

examples.en: My father likes to fish on weekends.
examples.ko: 우리 아버지는 주말에 낚시하는 걸 좋아하셔.

examples.en: His father is a teacher at my school.

senses.note: 격식적·중립적 표현. 직접 부를 때는 Dad. Father's Day = 아버지의 날.

senses.meaningEn: the second month of the year, with 28 or 29 days

examples.en: February is the shortest month.
We're going skiing in February.

senses.note: 첫 r 을 발음하지 않는 사람이 많아 /ˈfebjueri/ 처럼 들리기도 한다. 철자 Feb-ru-ary 의 r 을 빼먹기 쉬움. 줄임말 Feb.

senses.meaningEn: the plural of foot: the parts of your body at the ends of your legs

examples.en: My feet hurt after walking all day.
Please take off your shoes; your feet must be tired.

senses.note: 항상 복수 취급: My feet are cold. (is 아님). 발 하나는 foot.

senses.meaningEn: a body temperature that is higher than normal because you are sick

examples.en: The baby has a high fever.
Her fever went down after she took the medicine.
examples.ko: 약을 먹고 나서 그녀의 열이 내렸어.

senses.note: have / run a fever(열이 나다). 열이 내리다 = the fever goes down / breaks. 한국어 '열' 그대로 heat 라고 하지 않도록 주의.

senses.meaningEn: an open area of land, often used for growing crops or keeping animals

examples.en: Cows are eating grass in the field.
The farmer works in the rice field every day.

senses.note: rice field = 논, wheat field = 밀밭. 꽃이 핀 들판은 a field of flowers.

senses.meaningEn: an area of ground where sports are played

examples.en: The players ran onto the field.
Our school has a big soccer field.

senses.note: soccer/baseball/football field. 농구·테니스는 court, 골프는 course.

senses.meaningEn: a subject or area of work or study

examples.en: What field do you want to work in?
She is an expert in the field of music.

senses.note: in the field of ~ = ~ 분야에서. field trip 은 '현장 학습(소풍)'.

senses.meaningEn: a trip that students take with their class to learn about something outside school

examples.en: We're going on a field trip to the zoo on Friday.
Don't forget your lunch for the field trip.
examples.ko: 현장 학습 갈 때 점심 도시락 잊지 마.

senses.note: go on a field trip = 현장 학습을 가다. 한국의 '소풍·수학여행'을 설명할 때 picnic 보다 field trip / school trip 이 맞음(picnic 은 야외에서 밥 먹는 것). 일상에서 '우리 어디 나갔다 오자'를 농담처럼 field trip 이라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: the number 15

examples.en: Let's take a fifteen-minute break.
The bus comes every fifteen minutes.

senses.note: five 의 v 가 f 로 바뀜(fif-). a quarter = 15분: It's a quarter past three = 3시 15분. fifTEEN vs FIFty 강세 구분.

senses.meaningEn: coming after the fourth one

examples.en: She lives on the fifth floor.
It's the fifth day of our trip.

senses.note: 5th. 철자 주의: five → fifth(v 가 f 로 바뀜). 발음은 /fɪfθ/, 끝의 fθ 가 어렵다면 천천히.

senses.meaningEn: one of five equal parts of something

examples.en: I only finished a fifth of the book.
One fifth of the class was absent.

senses.meaningEn: the number 50

examples.en: Fifty people work at our office.
Can you break a fifty for me?
examples.ko: 50달러짜리 좀 잔돈으로 바꿔 줄 수 있어?

senses.note: fifty-fifty = 반반, 50 대 50. fifty percent = 50%, half 와 같은 뜻. 미국에서 a fifty 는 50달러 지폐.

senses.meaningEn: okay, acceptable, or in good health

examples.en: I'm fine, thanks. How are you?
Is seven o'clock fine with you?

senses.note: That's fine. = 괜찮아요. 말투에 따라 '됐어, 그만해'라는 뉘앙스가 될 수도 있음.

senses.meaningEn: sunny and not raining

examples.en: It's a fine day for a picnic.
The weather will be fine this weekend.

senses.meaningEn: money you must pay for breaking a rule

examples.en: I got a fine for parking here.
The fine for speeding is pretty high.

senses.note: pay a fine = 벌금을 내다.

senses.meaningEn: one of the long thin parts at the end of your hand

examples.en: I cut my finger while cooking.
Don't point your finger at people.

senses.note: 보통 thumb(엄지)은 finger 에 넣지 않아 '손가락 네 개 + 엄지'로 셈. 발가락은 toe(foot finger ×). cross your fingers = 행운을 빌다.

senses.meaningEn: to complete something you are doing

examples.en: Did you finish your homework?
I'll finish this book tonight.
examples.ko: 오늘 밤에 이 책 다 읽을 거야.

senses.note: finish 뒤에는 -ing: finish eating(먹기를 끝내다). finish to eat 은 틀림. I'm finished. = 다 끝났어.

senses.meaningEn: to eat or drink all of something

examples.en: Finish your vegetables, please.
He finished his coffee and left.

senses.note: Are you finished? 는 식당에서 '다 드셨어요?(접시 치워도 될까요)'의 뜻으로 자주 들림.

senses.meaningEn: to come to an end, or to end a race in a particular place

examples.en: The movie finishes at nine.
She finished second in the race.

senses.note: finish first/second = 1등/2등으로 끝내다. 행사가 끝나는 것은 end 도 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: the heat, light, and flames made when something burns

examples.en: We sat around the fire and talked.
There was a fire in the building last night.

senses.note: 불을 피우다 = make/start a fire, 불을 끄다 = put out a fire. '불이 났다'는 There's a fire! / on fire(불타는 중). 모닥불 = campfire.

senses.meaningEn: to make someone leave their job

examples.en: He was fired last week.
The boss fired two workers for being late.
examples.ko: 사장이 지각 때문에 직원 두 명을 해고했어.

senses.note: 직설적인 표현. 좀 더 부드럽게는 let someone go, 회사 사정으로 자르면 lay off.

senses.meaningEn: coming before all others in order or time

examples.en: This is my first time in Korea.
Take the first street on the left.

senses.note: 1st 로 줄여 씀. the first floor 는 미국에서 1층, 영국에서 2층.

senses.meaningEn: before anything or anyone else

examples.en: Wash your hands first, then eat.
Who wants to go first?

senses.note: At first = 처음에는(나중에 바뀜). First of all = 우선 첫째로. first 와 at first 를 혼동하지 말 것.

senses.meaningEn: the meat of a fish, eaten as food

examples.en: I'd like the grilled fish, please.
We eat fish twice a week.
examples.ko: 우리는 일주일에 두 번 생선을 먹어.

senses.note: 음식일 때는 셀 수 없음: some fish, a piece of fish. 한국어는 '물고기'와 '생선'을 구분하지만 영어는 둘 다 fish.

senses.meaningEn: an animal that lives and swims in water

examples.en: Look, there are so many fish in the pond!
My son wants a pet fish.

senses.note: 복수형도 보통 fish: two fish, many fish. fishes 는 여러 '종류'를 말할 때만 가끔 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to try to catch fish

examples.en: My dad fishes every Sunday morning.
We went fishing at the lake last weekend.

senses.note: '낚시하러 가다'는 go fishing. '낚시'라는 취미는 fishing, 낚싯대는 fishing rod.

senses.meaningEn: to be the right size and shape for someone

examples.en: These shoes don't fit me; they're too small.
examples.ko: 이 신발은 나한테 안 맞아, 너무 작아.

examples.en: Does this jacket fit well?

senses.note: fit 은 크기가 맞는 것, suit 는 색·스타일이 어울리는 것, match 는 두 가지가 서로 어울리는 것. 과거형은 미국식 fit, 영국식 fitted.

senses.meaningEn: to be small enough or the right shape to go into a space

examples.en: The box won't fit in the car.
Can we fit one more person in?
examples.ko: 한 명 더 탈 수 있을까?

senses.meaningEn: healthy and strong, especially because you exercise

examples.en: He runs every day to stay fit.
She looks really fit these days.
examples.ko: 그녀 요즘 몸이 정말 좋아 보여.

senses.note: keep/stay fit = 몸 관리를 하다. fitness = 체력, 피트니스. 반대말은 unfit, out of shape.

senses.meaningEn: the number 5

examples.en: Give me five minutes to get ready.
I work from nine to five.

senses.note: 서수는 fifth(5th), fifteen(15), fifty(50)에서는 v 가 f 로 바뀜. high five = 손바닥 마주치기, nine to five = 보통 직장인 근무 시간.

senses.meaningEn: to repair something that is broken or not working

examples.en: Can you fix my bike this weekend?
examples.ko: 이번 주말에 내 자전거 고쳐 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: Dad fixed the broken chair yesterday.

senses.note: fix a problem = 문제를 해결하다. repair 보다 구어적. get it fixed = 고치게 하다(남에게 맡겨서).

senses.meaningEn: to prepare food or a drink for someone

examples.en: I'll fix you a sandwich.
Let me fix dinner tonight.

senses.note: 미국 구어. fix dinner / fix a drink / fix someone a snack. 고장 난 걸 고친다는 뜻이 아님에 주의.

senses.meaningEn: the flat surface in a room that you walk on

examples.en: Don't leave your clothes on the floor.
I dropped my phone on the floor.

senses.note: 실내 바닥은 floor, 실외 땅은 ground. '바닥에' 는 on the floor.

senses.meaningEn: a level of a building

examples.en: Our office is on the third floor.
Which floor do you live on?

senses.note: 미국에서 first floor = 1층(한국과 같음). 영국은 ground floor = 1층, first floor = 2층. '층에' 는 on the ~ floor.

senses.meaningEn: the colorful part of a plant that often smells nice

examples.en: He gave me flowers on my birthday.
The flowers in the garden are so pretty.

senses.note: 꽃 한 송이 = a flower, 꽃다발 = a bouquet(of flowers), 꽃집 = flower shop/florist. flower(꽃)와 flour(밀가루)는 발음이 같음. 꽃이 피다 = flowers bloom/come out.

senses.meaningEn: an illness like a bad cold, with a fever and body aches

examples.en: I think I have the flu. Everything hurts.
examples.ko: 독감 걸린 것 같아. 온몸이 아파.

examples.en: Did you get a flu shot this year?

senses.note: 보통 the flu 로 씀(have / get the flu). 가벼운 감기는 a cold. flu shot = 독감 예방 주사. influenza 의 줄임말.

senses.meaningEn: a thick cloud near the ground that makes it hard to see

examples.en: There was thick fog on the road this morning.
The fog lifted around noon.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: a fog ✗ → thick/heavy fog(짙은 안개). 안개가 걷히다 = the fog lifts/clears. mist 는 더 옅은 안개. fog 와 smog(스모그) 구별.

senses.meaningEn: with thick fog, so it is hard to see

examples.en: It was so foggy that I couldn't see the road.
examples.ko: 안개가 너무 짙어서 길이 안 보였어.

examples.en: Flights were late because of the foggy weather.

senses.note: I don't have the foggiest idea. = 전혀 모르겠다(구어). 비슷한 말 misty 는 안개가 더 얇음.

senses.meaningEn: things that people and animals eat

examples.en: The food at that restaurant is really good.
We need to buy some food for the weekend.
examples.ko: 주말에 먹을 음식을 좀 사야 해.

senses.note: 보통 셀 수 없는 명사(a food 가 아니라 some food). 종류를 말할 때만 foods(Korean foods). 반려동물 사료는 dog food, cat food.

senses.meaningEn: the part of your body at the end of your leg that you stand on

examples.en: My right foot is a little swollen.
Can you stand on one foot?
examples.ko: 한 발로 서 있을 수 있어?

senses.note: 복수형은 foots 가 아니라 feet.

senses.meaningEn: used in the phrase on foot, meaning by walking

examples.en: We went to the park on foot.
Is the station far on foot?

senses.note: on foot 은 단수. by foot 보다 on foot 이 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: a unit for measuring length, equal to 12 inches or about 30 centimeters

examples.en: He is about six feet tall.
The room is ten feet wide.

senses.note: 키를 말할 때 six foot two 처럼 단수를 쓰기도 함.

senses.meaningEn: a statement about what the weather will be like

examples.en: Did you check the weather forecast?
The forecast says it will rain tomorrow.

senses.note: the weather forecast = 일기예보. 예보에 따르면 = according to the forecast. 일기예보를 하는 사람 = weather forecaster/weatherman.

senses.meaningEn: to say what will probably happen in the future

examples.en: They forecast snow for the weekend.
Heavy rain is forecast for tonight.

senses.note: 과거형·과거분사는 forecast(그대로) 또는 forecasted 둘 다 가능. ~이 예보되었다 = ... is forecast (수동태).

senses.meaningEn: a large area of land covered with trees

examples.en: Many animals live in the forest.
We got lost in the forest for an hour.
examples.ko: 우리는 숲에서 한 시간 동안 길을 잃었어.

senses.note: forest 는 넓고 깊은 숲, woods 는 그보다 작은 숲. 열대우림은 rainforest.

senses.meaningEn: to not remember something

examples.en: I forgot her phone number.
Don't forget to call your grandma.

senses.note: forget to + 동사 = 할 일을 잊다. 과거 forgot, 과거분사 forgotten. '깜빡했다' = I forgot. / It slipped my mind.

senses.meaningEn: to leave something behind by mistake

examples.en: Oh no, I forgot my umbrella!
He forgot his lunch on the kitchen table.
examples.ko: 그는 도시락을 식탁 위에 두고 갔어.

senses.note: 장소를 말할 때는 forget ✗ → leave: I left my bag at home. (I forgot my bag at home 은 비문법적으로 여기는 경우가 많음).

senses.meaningEn: used to tell someone not to worry about something

examples.en: Forget it. It's not a big deal.
Forget about the test and enjoy the weekend.

senses.note: Forget it. = 신경 쓰지 마 / 됐어. 말투에 따라 '그만해' 식의 짜증으로 들릴 수 있음. forget about + 명사.

senses.meaningEn: a tool with a handle and sharp points, used for eating food

examples.en: Can I have a fork, please?
The fork goes on the left side of the plate.

senses.note: a knife and fork 순서로 함께 말함. 포크·나이프·숟가락을 통틀어 silverware(미)·cutlery(영).

senses.meaningEn: a place where a road or path divides into two

examples.en: Turn left at the fork in the road.
We stopped at the fork and checked the map.

senses.meaningEn: the number 40

examples.en: My mom is forty this year.
The train ride takes about forty minutes.

senses.note: 철자 주의: four, fourteen 에는 u 가 있지만 forty 에는 없음(fourty ✗). 서수는 fortieth(40th).

senses.meaningEn: the number 4

examples.en: We need four chairs for the guests.
The class ends at four.

senses.note: for 와 발음이 같음. 서수는 fourth(4th)지만 forty(40)에는 u 가 없으니 철자 주의. fourteen = 14.

senses.meaningEn: the number 14

examples.en: I'll be on vacation for fourteen days.
She started learning English at fourteen.
examples.ko: 그녀는 열네 살에 영어를 배우기 시작했어.

senses.note: 철자에 u 가 있음(fourteen). forty(40)에는 없음. 발음은 fourTEEN, FORty 로 강세가 다름. two weeks = fourteen days.

senses.meaningEn: coming after the third one

examples.en: My son is in the fourth grade.
Today is the fourth of July.

senses.note: 4th. 미국에서 the Fourth of July = 독립기념일. fourth(4번째)와 forth(앞으로)는 발음이 같으니 철자 주의.

senses.meaningEn: one of four equal parts of something

examples.en: Add a fourth of a cup of sugar.
A fourth of the students were late.

senses.note: 일상에서는 a quarter 를 더 많이 씀(a quarter of an hour = 15분).

senses.meaningEn: a wild animal like a small dog with red-brown fur, a pointed face, and a thick tail

examples.en: A fox ran across the road in front of us.
examples.ko: 여우 한 마리가 우리 앞에서 길을 가로질러 달려갔어.

examples.en: Foxes come out mostly at night.

senses.note: 복수형은 foxes. 여우는 영어에서도 '영리하고 교활한' 이미지(as sly as a fox). 사람에게 fox/foxy 는 '매력적인'이라는 속어이니 주의.

senses.meaningEn: costing no money

examples.en: Kids under five get in free.
The coffee is free with breakfast.

senses.note: for free = 무료로. free of charge 도 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: not busy

examples.en: Are you free this Saturday?
I'm free after six today.

senses.note: free time = 여가 시간.

senses.meaningEn: not being used by anyone

examples.en: Excuse me, is this seat free?
There's a free table by the window.

senses.meaningEn: extremely cold

examples.en: It's freezing outside! Close the window.
examples.ko: 밖이 얼어 죽을 만큼 추워! 창문 닫아.

examples.en: My hands are freezing.

senses.note: cold 보다 훨씬 강한 말. 이미 '매우'라는 뜻이 들어 있어서 very freezing ✗ → absolutely freezing ✓. 반대말은 boiling(푹푹 찌는).

senses.meaningEn: the temperature at which water becomes ice, 0°C

examples.en: It will drop below freezing tonight.
examples.ko: 오늘 밤 기온이 영하로 떨어질 거야.

examples.en: The temperature is just above freezing.

senses.note: below freezing = 영하, above freezing = 영상. 영하 5도 = five below zero / minus five.

senses.meaningEn: long, thin pieces of potato that are fried in oil

examples.en: Would you like french fries with that?
These french fries are too salty.

senses.note: 항상 복수형. 미국에서는 흔히 fries 로 줄여 말함. 영국에서는 chips 라고 하며, 영국의 crisps 가 미국의 chips(감자칩).

senses.meaningEn: recently made, picked, or caught, and not old or frozen

examples.en: The bread is fresh from the oven.
I buy fresh vegetables every morning.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 아침 신선한 채소를 사.

senses.note: fresh fruit / fresh fish / fresh bread. 빵이 오래되어 딱딱해진 것은 stale.

senses.meaningEn: clean and cool, pleasant to breathe or feel

examples.en: Let's open the window for some fresh air.
examples.ko: 창문 열어서 맑은 공기 좀 들이자.

examples.en: I feel fresh after a good night's sleep.

senses.note: get some fresh air = 바람 좀 쐬다. fresh water 는 '민물'(바닷물 salt water 의 반대).

senses.meaningEn: the day of the week after Thursday and before Saturday

examples.en: See you on Friday night!
We have a test next Friday.
examples.ko: 우리 다음 주 금요일에 시험 있어.

senses.note: 요일 앞에는 on 을 쓴다(on Friday). 요일은 항상 대문자로 시작. Fridays = 매주 금요일. TGIF(Thank God It's Friday)는 '불금'에 가까운 표현.

senses.meaningEn: a refrigerator

examples.en: There's some leftover pizza in the fridge.
Can you grab me a drink from the fridge?
examples.ko: 냉장고에서 마실 것 하나 꺼내 줄래?

senses.note: refrigerator 의 줄임말로 일상 대화에서 훨씬 많이 씀. 철자에 d 가 들어감(frige ✗). in the fridge = 냉장고 '안에'.

senses.meaningEn: cooked in hot oil or fat

examples.en: I'd like fried chicken and a cola, please.
Fried rice is easy to make at home.

senses.note: fried egg(달걀 프라이), fried rice(볶음밥), fried chicken(치킨), French fries(감자튀김). 기름에 푹 담가 튀기면 deep-fried, 살짝 볶으면 stir-fried.

senses.meaningEn: a person you know well and like, who is not family

examples.en: I'm meeting a friend for coffee this afternoon.
examples.ko: 오늘 오후에 친구랑 커피 마시러 만나.

examples.en: She has been my best friend since school.
examples.ko: 그녀는 학교 때부터 내 가장 친한 친구야.

senses.note: make friends = 친구를 사귀다. 나이가 같아야 친구인 한국어와 달리, 영어 friend 는 나이 상관없음. 'i' 가 묵음: /frend/.

senses.meaningEn: a person you are connected with on social media

examples.en: I have about 500 friends on Facebook.
He sent me a friend request yesterday.
examples.ko: 그가 어제 나한테 친구 요청을 보냈어.

senses.note: friend request = 친구 요청. 동사로 friend / unfriend 도 SNS 에서 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: a small green or brown animal with long back legs that jumps and lives near water

examples.en: We heard frogs singing by the pond at night.
The frog jumped into the water.

senses.note: 개구리는 jump/hop. 두꺼비는 toad, 올챙이는 tadpole. have a frog in your throat = 목이 쉬어 쇳소리가 난다.

senses.meaningEn: the main door at the front of a house

examples.en: Someone is knocking at the front door.
Leave your shoes by the front door, please.

senses.note: at the front door = 현관문에서. 한국의 '현관'은 보통 front door 또는 entrance 로 표현.

senses.meaningEn: the sweet part of a plant that has seeds, such as an apple or banana

examples.en: I eat fruit every day after lunch.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 점심 후에 과일을 먹어.

examples.en: What's your favorite fruit?

senses.note: 보통 셀 수 없음: some fruit, a piece of fruit(과일 한 개). 종류를 말할 때만 fruits(tropical fruits). 과일 가게·코너는 fruit section, 과일 샐러드는 fruit salad.

senses.meaningEn: to cook food in hot oil or fat

examples.en: Fry the onions until they turn brown.
I fried two eggs for breakfast.

senses.note: fry 는 기름 요리 전반. 팬에 살짝 볶는 것 stir-fry, 기름에 푹 담가 튀기는 것 deep-fry. 프라이팬은 frying pan.

senses.meaningEn: long thin pieces of fried potato

examples.en: Can I get a burger with fries?
examples.ko: 버거에 감자튀김 추가해 주실 수 있어요?

examples.en: Do you want fries with that?

senses.note: 미국에서는 fries / French fries, 영국에서는 chips. 미국에서 chips 는 감자칩.

senses.meaningEn: having eaten enough and not wanting more food

examples.en: No more cake for me, I'm full.
I'm too full to eat dessert.

senses.note: 식사 후 '배불러요'는 I'm full. 격식 있는 자리에서는 I've had enough, thank you 도 좋다.

senses.meaningEn: containing as much as possible, with no empty space

examples.en: The bus was full, so we waited for the next one.
examples.ko: 버스가 꽉 차서 다음 버스를 기다렸어.

examples.en: My bag is full of books.
examples.ko: 내 가방은 책으로 가득 차 있어.

senses.note: full of + 명사 = ~로 가득한. a full glass of water = 물 한 잔 가득.

senses.meaningEn: a building or part of a house where you keep a car

examples.en: Please park the car in the garage.
We keep our bikes in the garage.

senses.note: garage sale = 집에서 안 쓰는 물건을 파는 벼룩시장. parking garage = 주차 건물.

senses.meaningEn: a place where cars are repaired

examples.en: My car is at the garage for repairs.
examples.ko: 내 차는 수리 때문에 정비소에 있어.

examples.en: I took the car to the garage this morning.

senses.note: 미국에서는 정비소를 auto shop / mechanic 이라고도 많이 함. 영국 발음은 /ˈɡærɑːʒ/ 또는 /ˈɡærɪdʒ/.

senses.meaningEn: waste such as food and paper that you throw away

examples.en: The garbage smells really bad today.
Just throw it in the garbage.

senses.note: trash 와 거의 같지만 garbage 는 음식물 쓰레기 느낌이 조금 더 강함. garbage truck(쓰레기차), garbage bag(쓰레기봉투). 셀 수 없는 명사.

senses.meaningEn: an area next to a house where flowers, trees, or grass grow

examples.en: My grandmother has a beautiful garden.
examples.ko: 우리 할머니는 아름다운 정원을 갖고 있어.

examples.en: Let's have lunch out in the garden.

senses.note: 미국에서는 집 옆 잔디밭은 yard, 꽃·채소를 키우는 곳이 garden. 영국에서는 집 뒤 뜰 전체를 garden 이라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of land where you grow vegetables or fruit

examples.en: We grow tomatoes in our vegetable garden.
Dad waters the garden every morning.
examples.ko: 아빠는 매일 아침 텃밭에 물을 주셔.

senses.note: vegetable garden = 텃밭. '정원을 가꾸다'는 동사 garden 또는 do some gardening.

senses.meaningEn: a plant like a small onion with a strong taste, used in cooking

examples.en: Korean food uses a lot of garlic.
Add some garlic to the pan.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. 마늘 한 쪽은 a clove of garlic.

senses.meaningEn: a polite word for a man

examples.en: This gentleman is waiting for a table.
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the show!
examples.ko: 신사 숙녀 여러분, 공연에 오신 것을 환영합니다!

senses.note: 복수는 gentlemen. 안내 방송·공연에서 Ladies and gentlemen. 이름 모르는 남성을 가리킬 때 that man 보다 정중함.

senses.meaningEn: a man who is polite and treats people well

examples.en: He opened the door for me. What a gentleman!
examples.ko: 그가 문을 열어 줬어. 정말 신사야!

examples.en: Be a gentleman and help her with the bags.
examples.ko: 신사답게 그녀 가방 좀 들어 줘.

senses.meaningEn: to receive, obtain, or buy something

examples.en: Did you get my text message last night?
I need to get some milk on the way home.
examples.ko: 집에 가는 길에 우유 좀 사야 해.

senses.meaningEn: to arrive at a place

examples.en: What time do we get to the airport?
Call me when you get home, okay?

senses.note: get to + 장소. 단, get home / get there 는 to 없이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to become or change to a certain state

examples.en: It gets cold here at night.
Don't get angry, I was just joking.

senses.note: get + 형용사: get tired, get hungry, get better. become 보다 훨씬 구어적.

senses.meaningEn: to understand something

examples.en: Sorry, I don't get it. Can you explain again?
examples.ko: 미안, 이해가 안 돼. 다시 설명해 줄래?

examples.en: Oh, now I get what you mean.

senses.meaningEn: to get out of bed

examples.en: What time do you usually get up?
I get up at six on weekdays.

senses.note: wake up 은 눈을 뜨는 것, get up 은 실제로 침대에서 나오는 것.

senses.meaningEn: to stand up after sitting or lying

examples.en: Everyone, please get up and stretch.
Don't get up, I'll get the door.
examples.ko: 일어나지 마, 내가 문 열어 줄게.

senses.meaningEn: something you give to someone on a special day or to say thank you

examples.en: I need to buy a birthday gift for my mom.
Thank you for the lovely gift!

senses.note: gift 와 present 는 거의 같은 뜻. gift 는 약간 더 격식 있고 가게·포장 관련(gift shop, gift card, gift wrap)에 많이 씀. 선물을 '주다'는 give, '받다'는 get/receive.

senses.meaningEn: a natural ability to do something well

examples.en: She has a real gift for languages.
Cooking is his gift.

senses.note: have a gift for + 분야. gifted = 재능 있는(gifted children).

senses.meaningEn: a tall African animal with a very long neck and long legs

examples.en: A giraffe is the tallest animal in the world.
examples.ko: 기린은 세계에서 가장 키가 큰 동물이야.

examples.en: The giraffe ate leaves from the top of the tree.

senses.note: 강세는 두 번째 음절(/dʒəˈræf/), '지래프'에 가깝게 발음. 복수형은 giraffes. 목이 길다 = has a long neck.

senses.meaningEn: a female child or young woman

examples.en: The little girl is holding a red balloon.
examples.ko: 그 여자아이가 빨간 풍선을 들고 있어.

examples.en: My daughter is a very smart girl.

senses.note: 성인 여성을 girl 이라고 부르는 건 무례할 수 있음. 직장에서는 woman 을 쓰는 게 안전.

senses.meaningEn: a woman's female friends, used in a friendly way

examples.en: I'm going out with the girls tonight.
examples.ko: 오늘 밤 여자 친구들이랑 놀러 나가.

examples.en: Hey girls, are you ready to go?

senses.note: the girls = 여자인 친구 무리. 여성끼리 서로 부를 때 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: a woman or girl that someone is in a romantic relationship with

examples.en: He's going to the movies with his girlfriend.
I met my girlfriend at work.

senses.note: 연인 관계일 때 씀. 여성이 자기 여자인 친구를 my girlfriend 라고 부르기도 하지만, 오해를 피하려면 a friend of mine 이 안전.

senses.meaningEn: to stop trying to do something

examples.en: Don't give up. You can do it!
examples.ko: 포기하지 마. 넌 할 수 있어!

examples.en: I almost wanted to give up on learning English.

senses.note: give up on + 사람/일 = ~을 포기하다, 단념하다.

senses.meaningEn: to stop doing or having something, especially a habit

examples.en: My dad is trying to give up smoking.
examples.ko: 우리 아버지는 담배를 끊으려고 노력 중이셔.

examples.en: I'm trying to give up sugar.

senses.note: give up + 동명사: give up smoking (O), give up to smoke (X).

senses.meaningEn: a container made of glass that you drink cold drinks from

examples.en: Can I get a glass of water?
He dropped the glass and it broke.

senses.note: a glass of water / juice / wine. 찬 음료는 glass, 뜨거운 음료는 cup.

senses.meaningEn: a hard clear material used for windows and bottles

examples.en: The table is made of glass.
Careful, there's broken glass on the floor.

senses.note: 재료로 쓸 때는 셀 수 없는 명사(a glass 아님).

senses.meaningEn: two lenses in a frame that you wear to see better

examples.en: I can't read without my glasses.
Where did I put my glasses?

senses.note: 안경은 항상 복수 glasses. '안경 하나'는 a pair of glasses. sunglasses = 선글라스.

senses.meaningEn: an amount of milk served in a glass

examples.en: Drink a glass of milk before bed.
examples.ko: 자기 전에 우유 한 잔 마셔.

examples.en: He poured himself a tall glass of milk.
examples.ko: 그는 큰 유리잔에 우유를 가득 따랐어.

senses.note: 찬 음료(우유·물·주스·와인)는 glass, 뜨거운 음료(커피·차)는 cup 을 쓴다. 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: a cup of milk 는 요리 계량(1컵)으로 들린다.

senses.meaningEn: two lenses in a frame that you wear to see better

examples.en: I can't read this without my glasses.
Where did I put my glasses?

senses.note: 항상 복수형. '안경 하나'는 a pair of glasses. 안경을 쓰다 wear glasses, 쓰고 있다 have glasses on. 단수 glass 는 '유리, 유리잔'.

senses.meaningEn: more than one glass for drinking

examples.en: Two glasses of water, please.
Put the glasses on the table.

senses.note: a glass of water = 물 한 잔. 문맥에 따라 '안경'인지 '잔들'인지 구분.

senses.meaningEn: a round model of the Earth that you can turn

examples.en: There's a globe on the teacher's desk.
Find Korea on the globe.

senses.note: 교실 안의 '둥근 지구 모형'을 가리킴.

senses.meaningEn: the world

examples.en: People all over the globe watched the game.
examples.ko: 전 세계 사람들이 그 경기를 봤어.

examples.en: The news traveled around the globe in minutes.
examples.ko: 그 소식은 몇 분 만에 전 세계로 퍼졌어.

senses.note: the globe = 세계(약간 격식). around the globe = around the world. 형용사 global(세계적인), 명사 globalization(세계화).

senses.meaningEn: pieces of clothing that cover your hands, with a separate part for each finger

examples.en: Wear gloves; your hands will get cold.
I lost one of my gloves on the bus.

senses.note: 보통 복수형, a pair of gloves. 한 짝은 a glove. 손가락이 나뉘지 않은 손모아장갑은 mittens. 장갑을 '끼다'도 영어로는 wear/put on.

senses.meaningEn: a sticky liquid used for joining things together

examples.en: Put some glue on the back of the picture.
Do you have a glue stick?

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. 딱풀은 glue stick, 순간접착제는 super glue.

senses.meaningEn: to stick things together with glue

examples.en: Glue the two pieces together.
I glued the handle back on the cup.

senses.note: glue A to B / glue A and B together.

senses.meaningEn: to move or travel to a place

examples.en: I go to the gym after work.
Where are you going this weekend?

senses.note: go to school / go home(to 없음) / go shopping(동명사).

senses.meaningEn: to change to a worse state

examples.en: The milk will go bad if you leave it out.
My hair is going gray already.

senses.note: go bad / go wrong / go crazy 처럼 주로 나쁜 변화에 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to happen or progress in a certain way

examples.en: How did your interview go?
Everything is going well so far.

senses.note: How's it going? 은 '잘 지내?'라는 인사.

senses.meaningEn: a farm animal with horns and a short tail, kept for its milk and meat

examples.en: The goat is eating my mom's flowers again.
examples.ko: 염소가 또 엄마 꽃을 먹고 있어.

examples.en: Goats can climb almost anywhere.
examples.ko: 염소는 거의 어디든 올라갈 수 있어.

senses.note: goat cheese(염소 치즈), goat milk(염소젖). 요즘 인터넷에서 GOAT 는 Greatest Of All Time(역대 최고)의 약자로 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: a letter or number that shows how good a student's work is

examples.en: I got a good grade in science.
She always gets the best grades in class.
examples.ko: 그 애는 항상 반에서 최고 성적을 받아.

senses.note: get/receive a grade. 영국식은 mark. 숫자 점수는 score, 등급(A, B, C)은 grade.

senses.meaningEn: a level of school in the US, numbered 1 to 12

examples.en: My little brother is in the third grade.
What grade are you in?

senses.note: 미국식. in the 3rd grade = 3학년. 영국식은 Year 3. 대학생의 학년은 year(first-year, sophomore 등).

senses.meaningEn: the father of your mother or father

examples.en: My grandfather is eighty years old.
Her grandfather taught her how to fish.

senses.note: 친/외 구분 없음. 격식적 표현이며 부를 때는 Grandpa.

senses.meaningEn: an informal word for grandmother

examples.en: Grandma, can you tell me a story?
We're having lunch at Grandma's house today.

senses.note: 직접 부를 때는 대문자 Grandma. 어린아이는 granny, nana 도 씀.

senses.meaningEn: the mother of your mother or father

examples.en: My grandmother lives with us.
I visit my grandmother every Sunday.

senses.note: 친할머니/외할머니 구분이 없음. 필요하면 my mom's mother 처럼 설명.

senses.meaningEn: an informal word for grandfather

examples.en: Grandpa likes to read the newspaper every morning.
examples.ko: 할아버지는 매일 아침 신문 읽는 걸 좋아하셔.

examples.en: I made a card for Grandpa's birthday.

senses.note: 직접 부를 때는 대문자 Grandpa. granddad, gramps 도 구어로 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: the parent of your mother or father

examples.en: My grandparents live in the countryside.
She was raised by her grandparents.

senses.note: 보통 복수 grandparents 로 씀. Grandparents' Day 도 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a small, round green or purple fruit that grows in bunches and is used to make wine

examples.en: I bought some grapes for the picnic.
These green grapes have no seeds.

senses.note: 한국어 '포도'는 송이 전체를 말하지만 영어 grape 는 알 하나. 그래서 보통 복수형 grapes, 한 송이는 a bunch of grapes. 건포도는 raisin, 포도주는 wine.

senses.meaningEn: a common plant with thin green leaves that covers the ground

examples.en: Please don't walk on the grass.
Dad cuts the grass every Saturday morning.

senses.note: 보통 불가산명사. '잔디 깎다'는 cut/mow the grass. 잔디밭 자체는 lawn 이라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: a number of people or things that are together or connected

examples.en: A group of kids was playing in the park.
examples.ko: 아이들 한 무리가 공원에서 놀고 있었어.

examples.en: Please work in groups of four.

senses.note: a group of + 복수명사. 수업에서는 '모둠'이 자연스러운 번역. group chat = 단체 채팅.

senses.meaningEn: a small number of musicians or singers who perform together

examples.en: My favorite group is playing in Seoul next month.
examples.ko: 내가 좋아하는 그룹이 다음 달 서울에서 공연해.

examples.en: The group has four singers.

senses.note: 록·재즈는 band, 아이돌·보컬 팀은 group 이 더 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: to put people or things together in groups

examples.en: Group the words by their first letter.
The teacher grouped us by age.

senses.meaningEn: to give an answer when you are not sure it is right

examples.en: Guess how old I am.
I guessed the answer and got it right.

senses.note: I guess so. = 그런 것 같아(확신 없음, 미국 구어). Guess what! = 있잖아, 맞혀 봐!(놀라운 소식 꺼낼 때).

senses.meaningEn: an answer you give when you are not sure

examples.en: Take a guess. What's in the box?
examples.ko: 한번 맞혀 봐. 상자 안에 뭐가 있을까?

examples.en: That was a good guess!

senses.note: make a guess / take a guess = 추측해 보다. My guess is... = 내 짐작으로는...

senses.meaningEn: a person who is invited to your home or to an event

examples.en: We have guests coming for dinner tonight.
examples.ko: 오늘 밤 저녁 식사에 손님들이 와.

examples.en: Please make our guest feel welcome.

senses.note: 가게 손님은 customer, 집·파티 손님은 guest. Be my guest. = 그러세요, 마음껏 하세요.

senses.meaningEn: a person who is staying at a hotel

examples.en: Breakfast is free for hotel guests.
Are you a guest at this hotel?

senses.meaningEn: a room or building for doing exercise or sports

examples.en: I go to the gym three times a week.
examples.ko: 나는 일주일에 세 번 헬스장에 가.

examples.en: The basketball game is in the school gym.

senses.note: 한국어 '헬스'는 영어로 통하지 않음 → go to the gym / work out. gymnasium 의 줄임말.

senses.meaningEn: a sports class at school

examples.en: We have gym after lunch today.
examples.ko: 오늘 점심 후에 체육 수업 있어.

examples.en: I forgot my gym clothes again!

senses.note: 체육 수업은 gym 또는 P.E.(physical education). gym class = 체육 시간.

senses.meaningEn: the thin threads that grow on your head

examples.en: I need to get my hair cut.
She has long black hair.

senses.note: 머리 전체를 말할 때는 셀 수 없는 명사: hairs(×). 머리 자르러 가다 = get a haircut. 염색하다 = dye my hair.

senses.meaningEn: one thread of hair, or the hair on an animal's body

examples.en: There's a hair in my soup!
The dog's hair is all over the sofa.
examples.ko: 소파에 개 털이 잔뜩 묻어 있어.

senses.note: 한 가닥은 a hair / two hairs 로 셀 수 있음. 동물 털은 hair 또는 fur.

senses.meaningEn: one of two equal parts of something

examples.en: Can I have half of your sandwich?
Cut the apple in half.

senses.note: l 은 발음하지 않는다(/hæf/). 복수형은 halves. half an hour = 30분, half past two = 2시 30분. half of + 명사 또는 half + 명사(half the class) 둘 다 가능.

senses.meaningEn: being one of two equal parts

examples.en: Kids pay half price on Tuesdays.
I only drank a half cup of coffee.
examples.ko: 나는 커피 반 잔밖에 안 마셨어.

senses.note: half price(반값), half day(반일), half-brother(이복/이부 형제).

senses.meaningEn: a round piece of cooked meat served in a bread bun

examples.en: I'll have a hamburger and a cola.
This place makes the best hamburgers in town.
examples.ko: 이 집 햄버거가 이 동네에서 최고야.

senses.note: 일상에서는 줄여서 burger 라고 더 많이 말함. ham(햄)과는 관계없고 독일 도시 Hamburg 에서 온 이름. 치즈가 들어가면 cheeseburger.

senses.meaningEn: beef that has been cut into very small pieces (US)

examples.en: Buy a pound of hamburger for the tacos.
examples.ko: 타코 만들 다진 소고기 1파운드 사 와.

examples.en: The hamburger is on sale this week.
examples.ko: 이번 주에 다진 소고기가 할인 중이야.

senses.note: 미국 마트에서 hamburger 또는 hamburger meat 는 '다진 소고기(ground beef)' 를 뜻함. 셀 수 없는 명사로 씀.

senses.meaningEn: the part of your body at the end of your arm

examples.en: Wash your hands before you eat.
Raise your hand if you have a question.

senses.note: shake hands = 악수하다, hold hands = 손을 잡다. by hand = 손으로 직접.

senses.meaningEn: to give something to someone with your hand

examples.en: Could you hand me the salt, please?
She handed him the keys and left.

senses.note: hand + 사람 + 물건 / hand + 물건 + to + 사람. hand in = 제출하다, hand out = 나눠 주다.

senses.meaningEn: help with doing something

examples.en: Can you give me a hand with these boxes?
Do you need a hand with the dishes?

senses.note: give someone a hand = 도와주다. give someone a big hand = 큰 박수를 보내다(공연·발표에서).

senses.meaningEn: a small bag, usually carried by women, for money and personal things

examples.en: She carries a small black handbag.
examples.ko: 그녀는 작은 검은색 핸드백을 들고 다녀.

examples.en: My handbag is too heavy today.

senses.note: 영국에서 일상어, 미국에서는 purse 가 더 흔하고 handbag 은 패션·매장 용어로 들림.

senses.meaningEn: difficult to do or understand

examples.en: The math test was really hard.
It's hard to wake up early in winter.

senses.meaningEn: firm and not easy to bend or break

examples.en: This bread is too hard to eat.
examples.ko: 이 빵은 너무 딱딱해서 못 먹겠어.

examples.en: I can't sleep on a hard bed.
examples.ko: 나는 딱딱한 침대에서는 잠을 못 자.

senses.meaningEn: with a lot of effort or force

examples.en: She works very hard every day.
It's raining really hard outside right now.
examples.ko: 지금 밖에 비가 정말 세게 와.

senses.note: hardly 는 '거의 ~않다'로 뜻이 전혀 다름. work hard (O), work hardly (X).

senses.meaningEn: a piece of clothing you wear on your head

examples.en: Wear a hat; the sun is strong today.
He took off his hat when he came in.

senses.note: hat 은 모자 전반(특히 테 있는 모자). 야구모자는 cap. 모자를 '쓰다'는 wear/put on, '벗다'는 take off.

senses.meaningEn: to own or possess something

examples.en: I have two brothers and one sister.
examples.ko: 나는 남동생 둘에 여동생 하나 있어.

examples.en: Do you have a pen I can borrow?

senses.note: 소유의 have 는 진행형으로 쓰지 않음. I'm having a car (X).

senses.meaningEn: to eat or drink something

examples.en: What do you want to have for lunch?
I usually have coffee in the morning.

senses.note: have breakfast / have a drink. eat 보다 부드러운 표현.

senses.meaningEn: to experience or suffer from something

examples.en: I have a bad headache today.
I think I have a fever. I feel hot.
examples.ko: 열이 있는 것 같아. 몸이 뜨거워.

senses.note: have a cold / have a headache / have a problem.

senses.meaningEn: to enjoy yourself

examples.en: Did you have a good time at the party?
Have a good time on your trip!

senses.note: 작별 인사로 Have a good time! / Have fun! 을 자주 씀. have a great time 은 더 강한 표현.

senses.meaningEn: the top part of your body with your eyes, ears, and brain

examples.en: I hit my head on the door.
My head hurts. Do you have any medicine?

senses.note: '머리카락'은 hair. 머리가 아프다 = I have a headache / My head hurts.

senses.meaningEn: the person in charge of a group or organization

examples.en: She is the head of the sales team.
The head of our school is Mr. Lee.

senses.note: head of the family(가장), head teacher(교장, 영국), head office(본사).

senses.meaningEn: to go in a particular direction

examples.en: Let's head home. It's getting late.
We're heading to the beach this weekend.

senses.note: head home / head to the station / head back(돌아가다). home 앞에는 to 를 쓰지 않음.

senses.meaningEn: a pain in your head

examples.en: I have a terrible headache today.
Take this pill if your headache doesn't go away.
examples.ko: 두통이 안 가라앉으면 이 약을 먹어.

senses.note: 항상 have a headache(a 필수). 발음 /ˈhedeɪk/ — ache 는 '에이크'. 골치 아픈 일도 a headache 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: the condition of your body and how well you are

examples.en: Smoking is bad for your health.
My grandmother is in good health for her age.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사(a health 아님). in good/bad health, health problems, health insurance(건강 보험). 형용사는 healthy.

senses.meaningEn: strong and well; not sick

examples.en: The baby is happy and healthy.
I want to stay healthy, so I exercise every day.

senses.note: th 는 /θ/ 로 발음. stay healthy(건강을 유지하다), keep healthy.

senses.meaningEn: good for your health

examples.en: Vegetables are a healthy choice for dinner.
Try to eat a healthy breakfast every morning.
examples.ko: 매일 아침 건강에 좋은 아침밥을 먹으려고 해 봐.

senses.note: healthy food(건강에 좋은 음식), a healthy diet(건강한 식단), healthy habits.

senses.meaningEn: the organ in your chest that pumps blood around your body

examples.en: My heart was beating really fast.
Exercise is good for your heart.

senses.note: heart attack(심장 마비), heart rate(심박수).

senses.meaningEn: the center of your feelings and emotions

examples.en: She has a very kind heart.
He broke my heart when he left.
examples.ko: 그가 떠났을 때 내 마음이 찢어졌어.

senses.note: learn by heart(암기하다), from the bottom of my heart(진심으로). 하트 모양도 heart.

senses.meaningEn: a machine that makes a room or water warm

examples.en: Can you turn on the heater? I'm cold.
The heater in my room is broken.

senses.note: water heater = 온수기. 건물 전체 난방은 heating 이라고 함 (The heating is on).

senses.meaningEn: weighing a lot and hard to lift or move

examples.en: This box is too heavy for me to carry.
examples.ko: 이 상자는 내가 들기엔 너무 무거워.

examples.en: How heavy is your suitcase?

senses.note: 무게가 무거우면 heavy, 가벼우면 light. 사람의 체중을 완곡하게 말할 때도 heavy 를 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: great in amount or force

examples.en: We had heavy rain all day yesterday.
examples.ko: 어제는 하루 종일 비가 많이 왔어.

examples.en: I was late because of heavy traffic.

senses.note: heavy rain / heavy snow / heavy traffic. '비가 강하다'를 strong rain 이라고 하지 않는다.

senses.meaningEn: how tall someone or something is

examples.en: The nurse measured my height and weight.
We are about the same height.

senses.note: 발음은 [하이트]. weight 와 달리 ei 가 /aɪ/ 로 소리 난다. 키가 크다는 I have a big height 가 아니라 I'm tall.

senses.meaningEn: an adult female chicken

examples.en: The hens lay eggs every morning.
My grandma keeps six hens in her yard.
examples.ko: 할머니는 마당에서 암탉 여섯 마리를 키우셔.

senses.note: 수탉은 rooster(미) / cock(영), 병아리는 chick, 통칭은 chicken. lay eggs = 알을 낳다. 영국에서 hen party 는 신부 측 결혼 전 파티.

senses.meaningEn: an area of high land that is smaller than a mountain

examples.en: Our school is on top of a hill.
It's hard to ride a bike up this hill.

senses.note: up the hill(언덕 위로) / down the hill(언덕 아래로). 한국의 '동네 뒷산'은 보통 hill 로 말하면 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: the study of things that happened in the past

examples.en: We have a history test tomorrow.
My favorite subject is history.

senses.note: 과목으로 쓸 때는 관사 없음. Korean history = 한국사, world history = 세계사. 형용사는 historical.

senses.meaningEn: all the things that happened in the past

examples.en: This building has a long history.
The museum tells the history of the city.
examples.ko: 이 박물관은 도시의 역사를 보여 줘.

senses.note: a long history = 오랜 역사. '이야기(story)'와 철자가 비슷하지만 다른 단어.

senses.meaningEn: a special day when most people do not go to work or school

examples.en: Monday is a national holiday, so no school.
Chuseok is a big holiday in Korea.

senses.note: 미국식에서 holiday 는 '공휴일·명절' 하나하나를 뜻함. Happy holidays! = 연말(크리스마스~새해) 인사. public holiday = 공휴일.

senses.meaningEn: time off from work or school, often spent traveling (British English)

examples.en: We're going on holiday to Spain in July.
The kids are on holiday until September.

senses.note: 영국·호주에서는 holiday 가 미국의 vacation 역할. 미국인에게 I'm on holiday. 라고 하면 알아듣긴 하지만 영국식으로 들림.

senses.meaningEn: the place where you live, especially with your family

examples.en: There's no place like home.
I usually work from home on Fridays.

senses.note: house 는 건물, home 은 '사는 곳·가정'의 느낌. at home = 집에(서).

senses.meaningEn: to or at the place where you live

examples.en: I'm going home now. See you tomorrow!
examples.ko: 나 이제 집에 가. 내일 봐!

examples.en: What time did you get home last night?

senses.note: go home, come home, get home — 앞에 to 를 붙이지 않음(go to home ✗).

senses.meaningEn: the classroom and short daily meeting where students check in with their main teacher

examples.en: We have homeroom at eight every morning.
Ms. Lee is my homeroom teacher.

senses.note: homeroom teacher = 담임 선생님. 미국 중·고등학교 용어로, 한국의 '우리 반 교실/조회'에 가장 가까운 말.

senses.meaningEn: schoolwork that a student does at home

examples.en: Have you finished your homework yet?
We have a lot of math homework tonight.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: homeworks ✗, a homework ✗. '숙제 하나'는 a piece of homework 또는 an assignment. do homework(하다), hand in homework(제출하다).

senses.meaningEn: a sweet, sticky, golden food made by bees

examples.en: I put honey in my tea instead of sugar.
examples.ko: 나는 차에 설탕 대신 꿀을 넣어.

examples.en: This honey is from my uncle's farm.
examples.ko: 이 꿀은 우리 삼촌 농장에서 온 거야.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: a jar of honey. 벌은 bee, 벌집은 honeycomb.

senses.meaningEn: a name you call someone you love, such as a partner or child

examples.en: Honey, I'm home!
Are you okay, honey? You look tired.

senses.note: 연인·배우자·아이에게 쓰는 다정한 호칭. 비슷한 말: sweetie, dear, babe. 가게 점원이 손님에게 쓰면 지역에 따라 친근하거나 무례하게 들릴 수 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a large animal with four legs that people ride or use to pull things

examples.en: I rode a horse for the first time yesterday.
The horses are running across the field.

senses.note: ride a horse = 말을 타다. horse racing(경마), horseback riding(승마). 조랑말은 pony. 발음 주의: horse /hɔːrs/ 와 house /haʊs/ 구별.

senses.meaningEn: a large building where sick or injured people are treated and stay

examples.en: He is in the hospital after the accident.
examples.ko: 그는 사고 후 병원에 입원해 있어.

examples.en: My mom works at a hospital near our house.
examples.ko: 엄마는 우리 집 근처 병원에서 일하셔.

senses.note: 한국어 '병원 가다'는 가벼운 진료면 see a doctor / go to the doctor. hospital 은 입원·응급 등 큰 병원 느낌. 미국은 in the hospital, 영국은 in hospital.

senses.meaningEn: a bed in a hospital for a patient to lie in

examples.en: Grandma was lying in a hospital bed for a week.
examples.ko: 할머니는 일주일 동안 병원 침대에 누워 계셨어.

examples.en: The hospital bed goes up and down with a button.
examples.ko: 병원 침대는 버튼으로 올리고 내릴 수 있어.

senses.note: in a hospital bed = 입원해서 누워 있는 상태. 입원하다는 be in the hospital, 뉴스에서 '병상 수'는 hospital beds.

senses.meaningEn: having a high temperature

examples.en: Careful, the coffee is very hot.
I want to take a hot shower.

senses.note: 음식·물·사물이 뜨거울 때. 미지근한 것은 warm.

senses.meaningEn: having hot weather

examples.en: It's so hot today!
Summer in Korea is hot and humid.

senses.note: 날씨는 It's hot. 사람이 더울 때 I'm hot. 도 가능하지만 상황에 따라 '매력적이다'로 들릴 수 있어 I'm feeling hot. 또는 I'm so warm. 이 안전.

senses.meaningEn: having a strong burning taste from spices

examples.en: Is this sauce hot?
This kimchi is too hot for me.

senses.note: '뜨겁다'와 '맵다'가 모두 hot 이라 헷갈릴 수 있음. 명확히 하려면 spicy hot / temperature hot.

senses.meaningEn: a long, thin sausage served in a long piece of bread

examples.en: We ate hot dogs at the baseball game.
Do you want ketchup on your hot dog?

senses.note: 미국의 hot dog 는 긴 빵 사이에 소시지를 끼운 음식. 한국식 '핫도그'(막대에 꽂아 튀긴 것)는 영어로 corn dog 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: a period of sixty minutes

examples.en: The movie is about two hours long.
examples.ko: 그 영화는 두 시간 정도 돼.

examples.en: I waited for an hour at the bus stop.

senses.note: h 가 묵음이라 관사는 an hour. half an hour = 30분, an hour and a half = 1시간 30분. 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: '2시간'은 two hours(복수 s 필수).

senses.meaningEn: the time when a shop or office is open or when people work

examples.en: What are your opening hours on Sunday?
I work long hours during the busy season.

senses.note: office hours(근무/상담 시간), opening hours(영업시간), rush hour(출퇴근 혼잡 시간), after hours(영업 종료 후).

senses.meaningEn: a building where people live, usually for one family

examples.en: We live in a small house near the park.
examples.ko: 우리는 공원 근처 작은 집에 살아.

examples.en: Their house has a big backyard.

senses.note: 복수형 houses 는 /ˈhaʊzɪz/ 로 발음. 아파트에 살면 house 가 아니라 apartment.

senses.meaningEn: the people who live in a house, or someone's place

examples.en: Come over to my house after school.
The whole house was asleep by ten.
examples.ko: 열 시쯤엔 집안 사람들이 모두 잠들었어.

senses.note: my house = 우리 집(에). 친구를 초대할 때 Come to my house / Come over 를 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: the number 100

examples.en: This jacket costs a hundred dollars.
There were about two hundred people there.

senses.note: 앞에 a 나 one 이 꼭 붙음: a hundred / one hundred. 숫자 뒤에서는 복수 -s 를 붙이지 않음(two hundred, two hundreds ✗).

senses.meaningEn: a very large number of people or things

examples.en: I've told you hundreds of times!
Hundreds of people waited in line.

senses.note: hundreds of + 복수 명사 = 수백의. 정확한 수가 아니라 '아주 많다'는 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: wanting or needing to eat

examples.en: I'm so hungry. Let's get lunch.
Are you hungry? I can make some pasta.
examples.ko: 배고파? 내가 파스타 만들어 줄 수 있어.

senses.note: '배고프다'는 I'm hungry. I have hunger 라고 하지 않는다. 아주 배고플 때는 starving.

senses.meaningEn: wanting something very much

examples.en: The new players are hungry to win.
examples.ko: 새로 온 선수들은 이기고 싶어 안달이야.

examples.en: She is hungry for a new challenge.

senses.note: hungry for + 명사 / hungry to + 동사. 긍정적인 열의를 나타낼 때 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: to feel pain in a part of your body

examples.en: My throat hurts when I swallow.
Does it hurt when I press here?

senses.note: 주어가 신체 부위: My head hurts. (I hurt 가 아님). 과거·과거분사도 hurt(불규칙).

senses.meaningEn: to injure yourself or someone else

examples.en: I hurt my hand while cooking.
Be careful or you'll hurt yourself.

senses.note: hurt + 신체 부위 = 다치다. 다친 상태는 be hurt / get hurt: Nobody got hurt.(아무도 안 다쳤어)

senses.meaningEn: to make someone feel sad or upset

examples.en: Your words really hurt me.
I didn't mean to hurt your feelings.
examples.ko: 네 마음 상하게 하려던 건 아니었어.

senses.note: hurt someone's feelings = 마음을 상하게 하다. 상처받은 상태 = be hurt.

senses.meaningEn: the man that a person is married to

examples.en: My husband cooks dinner on weekends.
Her husband works for a bank.

senses.note: 's' 는 /z/ 로 발음: /ˈhʌzbənd/. husband and wife = 부부. 격식 없는 자리에서는 my hubby 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: frozen water that is hard and cold

examples.en: Can I have some water with ice, please?
Do you want ice in your drink?

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: an ice ✗ → an ice cube(얼음 한 개), some ice. 아이스 아메리카노 = an iced Americano(iced 에 -d 가 붙음). no ice = 얼음 빼고.

senses.meaningEn: a layer of frozen water on a road, lake, or ground

examples.en: Be careful, there's ice on the road.
I slipped on the ice and fell.

senses.note: black ice = 잘 안 보이는 도로 빙판. break the ice = 처음 만난 자리에서 어색함을 깨다.

senses.meaningEn: a sweet frozen food made from milk or cream

examples.en: Let's get some ice cream after lunch.
What's your favorite ice cream flavor?

senses.note: 두 단어로 띄어 씀. 셀 수 없는 명사라서 '하나'는 an ice cream cone / a scoop of ice cream.

senses.meaningEn: a thought or plan that you think of

examples.en: I have an idea. Let's go to the beach!
That's a great idea!

senses.note: have/get an idea = 생각이 떠오르다. Good idea! = 좋은 생각이야. 발음에 주의: 아이'디'어, 강세는 두 번째 음절.

senses.meaningEn: what you know or understand about something

examples.en: I have no idea what this means.
Do you have any idea where he is?

senses.note: I have no idea. = 전혀 모르겠어(I don't know 보다 강함). 'any idea' 는 의문문에서 '혹시 알아?'의 뉘앙스.

senses.meaningEn: not healthy; suffering from a disease

examples.en: My grandfather is very ill in the hospital.
She felt ill and went home early.
examples.ko: 그녀는 몸이 안 좋아서 일찍 집에 갔어.

senses.note: sick 보다 조금 격식 있고 영국에서 더 흔함. 보통 be/feel 뒤에 쓰고 명사 앞에는 잘 안 씀(an ill man 보다 a sick man). 심각한 병에 seriously ill.

senses.meaningEn: in or into the inner part of something

examples.en: Your keys are inside the bag.
Please wait inside the house, it's cold.

senses.meaningEn: in or into a building or room

examples.en: It's raining. Let's go inside.
Is anyone inside? The door is open.
examples.ko: 안에 누구 있어요? 문이 열려 있는데.

senses.note: go inside 뒤에 to 를 쓰지 않음. inside of 는 구어에서만.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of land with water all around it

examples.en: Jeju is the biggest island in Korea.
We took a boat to a small island.
examples.ko: 우리는 배를 타고 작은 섬에 갔어.

senses.note: s 는 발음하지 않음: /ˈaɪlənd/. 섬에 있다는 on the island (in ✗).

senses.meaningEn: a short coat worn over other clothes

examples.en: Take a jacket; it's cold outside.
He left his jacket on the chair.

senses.note: 무릎 아래까지 오는 긴 외투는 coat. 정장 상의도 jacket(suit jacket). 한국어 '점퍼'는 영어로 jacket 이 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: a sweet, soft food made by cooking fruit with sugar, spread on bread

examples.en: I like strawberry jam on my toast.
examples.ko: 나는 토스트에 딸기 잼 발라 먹는 걸 좋아해.

examples.en: We made apple jam at home last weekend.
examples.ko: 지난 주말에 집에서 사과 잼을 만들었어.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: a jar of jam(잼 한 병). 미국에서는 jelly 라고도 함(과육 없이 맑은 것). 오렌지 등 감귤류 잼은 marmalade.

senses.meaningEn: a situation where cars cannot move because the road is too full

examples.en: Sorry I'm late, there was a huge traffic jam.
We got stuck in a jam for an hour.
examples.ko: 한 시간 동안 차 막히는 데 갇혀 있었어.

senses.note: 거의 항상 traffic jam 으로 씀. be stuck in a traffic jam = 교통 체증에 갇히다. 기계가 걸려서 안 움직일 때도 jam(the printer is jammed).

senses.meaningEn: the first month of the year

examples.en: My birthday is in January.
It snows a lot here in January.

senses.note: 월 이름 앞에는 in 을 쓰고(in January), 날짜까지 말하면 on 을 쓴다(on January 5th). 줄여서 Jan. 로 쓴다. 월 이름은 항상 대문자.

senses.meaningEn: pants made of strong blue cotton cloth called denim

examples.en: She wears jeans almost every day.
I bought a new pair of jeans on sale.
examples.ko: 세일할 때 청바지 하나 새로 샀어.

senses.note: 항상 복수형. 한 벌은 a pair of jeans. 소재는 denim, 색이 아니어도 jeans 라고 부름(black jeans).

senses.meaningEn: a drink made from the liquid of fruit or vegetables

examples.en: Can I get an orange juice, please?
The kids drink juice with breakfast.

senses.note: 주스 종류는 과일 이름을 앞에 붙임: orange juice, apple juice, grape juice. 음식점에서 한 잔을 셀 때는 an orange juice 처럼 셀 수 있음.

senses.meaningEn: the liquid that comes out of fruit or meat

examples.en: Squeeze the juice out of the lemon.
This steak has so much juice in it.

senses.note: 형용사는 juicy(즙이 많은): a juicy peach, a juicy burger.

senses.meaningEn: the seventh month of the year

examples.en: It's really hot in July.
We're flying to Jeju in July.

senses.note: 강세가 두 번째 음절에 있다(ju-LY). 미국 독립기념일은 the Fourth of July. 줄임말 Jul.

senses.meaningEn: the sixth month of the year

examples.en: Summer vacation starts in June.
My parents' wedding was in June.

senses.note: 줄임말은 Jun. 미국 학교는 보통 6월에 학년이 끝나고 여름 방학이 시작된다. 발음은 '준'에 가깝게.

senses.meaningEn: a very short time ago

examples.en: I just got home.
She has just left the office.

senses.note: 미국식은 과거형(I just ate), 영국식은 현재완료(I've just eaten)를 선호. 둘 다 맞음.

senses.meaningEn: only; nothing more than

examples.en: I'm just looking, thanks.
It's just a small gift.

senses.note: 쇼핑할 때 점원에게 I'm just looking. 은 필수 표현. Just a moment. = 잠시만요. just kidding = 농담이야.

senses.meaningEn: exactly

examples.en: This shirt is just my size.
That's just what I wanted.

senses.note: just right = 딱 좋다, just in time = 딱 맞춰서. just like = ~와 똑같이.

senses.meaningEn: a large Australian animal that jumps on its strong back legs and carries its baby in a pocket on its front

examples.en: We saw kangaroos jumping in a field in Australia.
The baby kangaroo is sleeping in its mother's pouch.
examples.ko: 새끼 캥거루가 엄마 주머니 안에서 자고 있어.

senses.note: 강세는 마지막 음절(/-ˈruː/). 새끼 캥거루는 joey, 배 주머니는 pouch. 복수형은 kangaroos. 호주의 상징 동물.

senses.meaningEn: a small piece of metal that you use to open or lock a door

examples.en: I can't find my keys anywhere!
Here's the key to the front door.

senses.note: '~의 열쇠'는 the key to the door(of ✗). car keys, house keys 처럼 복수로 자주 말함.

senses.meaningEn: one of the buttons you press on a keyboard or a piano

examples.en: Press the Enter key to continue.
Some keys on my laptop don't work.
examples.ko: 내 노트북 키 몇 개가 안 먹어.

senses.note: 키보드 = keyboard. 피아노 건반도 key.

senses.meaningEn: very important

examples.en: Practice is the key to speaking English well.
Sleep is a key part of staying healthy.

senses.note: the key to success = 성공의 비결. 명사 앞에서 key point, key word 처럼 형용사로도 씀.

senses.meaningEn: an informal word for a child or young person

examples.en: There are a lot of kids at the park today.
When I was a kid, I loved cartoons.
examples.ko: 어릴 때 나는 만화를 정말 좋아했어.

senses.note: 일상 대화에서 child 보다 훨씬 자주 씀. 글이나 격식 상황에서는 child.

senses.meaningEn: someone's son or daughter

examples.en: How are your kids doing?
My kids are both in high school.

senses.note: the kids = 우리 아이들. 어른이 된 자식에게도 쓸 수 있음.

senses.meaningEn: to say something as a joke, not seriously

examples.en: I'm just kidding, don't be upset.
Are you kidding me? That's amazing!

senses.note: Just kidding! = 농담이야. You're kidding! / No kidding? = 설마! / 진짜?

senses.meaningEn: friendly and caring about other people

examples.en: Thank you, that's very kind of you.
My teacher is kind to everyone.

senses.note: be kind to + 사람.

senses.meaningEn: a type or group of things

examples.en: What kind of music do you like?
They sell all kinds of cheese here.

senses.meaningEn: a little, somewhat

examples.en: I'm kind of tired today.
This soup is kind of salty.

senses.note: 구어에서 kinda 로 줄여 말함. 글에서는 피함.

senses.meaningEn: the room in a house where you cook food

examples.en: Mom is in the kitchen making dinner.
Our kitchen is small but very clean.
examples.ko: 우리 집 부엌은 작지만 아주 깨끗해.

senses.note: in the kitchen (전치사 in). kitchen table, kitchen sink 처럼 명사 앞에도 자주 옴.

senses.meaningEn: a young cat

examples.en: Look at this tiny kitten!
examples.ko: 이 조그만 새끼 고양이 좀 봐!

examples.en: The kitten is playing with a ball of yarn.
examples.ko: 새끼 고양이가 털실 뭉치를 갖고 놀고 있어.

senses.note: 줄여서 kitty 라고도 하고, 아이들은 다 큰 고양이도 kitty 라고 부름. puppy(강아지)와 짝으로 익힐 것.

senses.meaningEn: a small fruit with brown fuzzy skin and green flesh

examples.en: I eat a kiwi every morning.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 아침 키위를 하나 먹어.

examples.en: Kiwis have a lot of vitamin C.

senses.note: kiwi fruit 라고도 함. 뉴질랜드 사람을 Kiwi 라고 부르기도 함.

senses.meaningEn: the joint in the middle of your leg where it bends

examples.en: I fell and hurt my knee.
Bend your knees a little when you lift it.

senses.note: k 는 발음하지 않음(/niː/). 무릎을 꿇다 = kneel.

senses.meaningEn: a tool with a sharp blade and a handle, used for cutting

examples.en: This knife is not sharp enough.
Please put the knives and forks on the table.

senses.note: k 는 묵음 /naɪf/. 복수는 knives(f→v). 요리용 큰 칼은 kitchen knife.

senses.meaningEn: to hit a door with your hand to get attention

examples.en: Someone is knocking on the door.
Please knock before you come in.

senses.note: knock on the door (at 도 가능). 한국어 "노크하다"는 knock 만 쓰면 됨 (do a knock X).

senses.meaningEn: to hit something so that it falls or moves

examples.en: I knocked the cup off the table.
The wind knocked over the chair.

senses.note: knock over(넘어뜨리다), knock off(쳐서 떨어뜨리다), knock down(쳐서 쓰러뜨리다/건물을 철거하다).

senses.meaningEn: the sound of someone hitting a door

examples.en: I heard a knock at the door.
There was a loud knock late at night.
examples.ko: 밤늦게 문을 크게 두드리는 소리가 났어.

senses.note: a knock at/on the door. Knock knock! = 똑똑!

senses.meaningEn: to have information or facts in your mind

examples.en: Do you know what time it is?
I didn't know the store closed so early.
examples.ko: 가게가 그렇게 일찍 닫는 줄 몰랐어.

senses.note: I know. = 알아, 그렇지. I don't know. = 모르겠어. k 는 묵음, no 와 발음이 같음. 진행형(I'm knowing ✗)으로 쓰지 않음.

senses.meaningEn: to be familiar with a person or place

examples.en: I've known her since high school.
Do you know this neighborhood well?

senses.note: get to know someone = ~와 알게 되다. '처음 알게 되다'는 meet(I knew him yesterday ✗ → I met him yesterday).

senses.meaningEn: to have learned a skill, language, or how to do something

examples.en: Do you know how to swim?
She knows a little Spanish.

senses.note: know how to + 동사 = ~하는 법을 알다. know by heart = 외우고 있다.

senses.meaningEn: a polite word for a woman

examples.en: The lady at the counter was very kind.
An old lady asked me for help.
examples.ko: 할머니 한 분이 나에게 도움을 청하셨어.

senses.note: 복수는 ladies. 아는 여성을 가리킬 때는 이름을, 모르면 that lady(그 여자분). that woman 은 조금 딱딱하게 들릴 수 있음.

senses.meaningEn: used for things that are for women, or a women's restroom

examples.en: Where is the ladies' room, please?
The ladies' shoes are on the second floor.

senses.note: the ladies = 여자 화장실(the ladies' room). 남자 화장실은 the men's room.

senses.meaningEn: a large area of water with land all around it

examples.en: We went swimming in the lake.
The lake is frozen in winter.

senses.note: 호수 이름은 Lake Michigan 처럼 Lake 가 앞에 옴(강과 반대). 작은 연못은 pond.

senses.meaningEn: a light that you can move, usually with a shade over the bulb

examples.en: Turn on the lamp. It's getting dark.
There's a small lamp next to my bed.
examples.ko: 내 침대 옆에 작은 램프가 있어.

senses.note: 한국의 '스탠드'는 영어로 desk lamp / floor lamp(stand 라고 하지 않음). 천장 등은 ceiling light, 가로등은 street light/lamp.

senses.meaningEn: the part of the earth that is not covered by water, or an area of ground

examples.en: After two days at sea, we finally saw land.
examples.ko: 바다에서 이틀을 보낸 뒤 드디어 육지가 보였어.

examples.en: My uncle bought some land to build a house.
examples.ko: 우리 삼촌은 집을 지으려고 땅을 좀 샀어.

senses.note: 불가산명사(a land ✗, some land ○). by land = 육로로, on land = 육지에서.

senses.meaningEn: to come down onto the ground, especially from the air

examples.en: Our plane lands in Tokyo at noon.
The bird landed on my window.

senses.note: 이륙은 take off. 착륙 = landing.

senses.meaningEn: a small computer that you can carry and use on your lap

examples.en: I take my laptop to the café to work.
My laptop battery dies really fast.
examples.ko: 내 노트북 배터리가 너무 빨리 닳아.

senses.note: 한국어 '노트북'은 영어로 laptop. 영어의 notebook 은 필기용 노트를 뜻함.

senses.meaningEn: big in size or amount

examples.en: They have a large garden behind the house.
examples.ko: 그 집 뒤에는 넓은 정원이 있어.

examples.en: A large number of people came to the show.

senses.note: big 보다 약간 격식 있는 느낌. 사람 몸집에는 big 을 더 많이 쓰고, large 는 '뚱뚱하다'를 돌려 말하는 느낌이 날 수 있음.

senses.meaningEn: the biggest of the standard sizes of clothes or drinks

examples.en: Can I get a large fries with that?
The large is a little too big for me.

senses.note: 음료·음식 사이즈는 small / medium / large. 옷은 L, 그 위는 XL(extra large).

senses.meaningEn: coming after all the others

examples.en: This is the last question on the test.
I was the last person to leave.

senses.meaningEn: the most recent one before now

examples.en: I saw that movie last week.
What did you do last weekend?

senses.note: last week / last night 앞에는 전치사를 쓰지 않음. in last week (X).

senses.meaningEn: to continue for a period of time

examples.en: The movie lasts about two hours.
examples.ko: 그 영화는 두 시간 정도 돼.

examples.en: How long does the battery last?

senses.meaningEn: arriving or happening after the expected time

examples.en: Sorry I'm late. The bus was slow.
Don't be late for school tomorrow.

senses.note: be late for + 행사/장소(late for class). 비교급 later(나중에)는 부사로 See you later. 와 같이 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: near the end of a day or a period of time

examples.en: It's late. Let's go home.
I went to bed late last night.

senses.note: late at night = 밤늦게, in the late afternoon = 오후 늦게. 여기서는 부사로도 쓰임(work late = 늦게까지 일하다). lately 는 '최근에'로 뜻이 전혀 다름.

senses.meaningEn: at a time after now or after the time you are talking about

examples.en: I'll call you back later.
See you later!

senses.note: later on = 나중에(조금 더 구어적). 시간 길이 뒤에 붙여 '~후에' 를 만든다: two hours later(두 시간 뒤), a week later. 과거 이야기에서는 after 가 아니라 later 를 쓴다는 점이 한국인에게 헷갈림.

senses.meaningEn: coming after something else in time

examples.en: Can we take a later bus?
examples.ko: 더 늦은 버스를 타면 안 될까?

examples.en: We'll talk about that in a later lesson.

senses.note: late 의 비교급. 반대는 earlier. latter(후자)와 철자 혼동 주의.

senses.meaningEn: to make sounds with your voice because something is funny

examples.en: We laughed so hard at his joke.
examples.ko: 그의 농담에 우리는 정말 많이 웃었어.

examples.en: Don't laugh at me, I'm serious.
examples.ko: 나 비웃지 마, 진지하게 말하는 거야.

senses.note: 발음은 [래프], gh 가 f 소리. laugh at someone 은 '비웃다'로 들릴 수 있으니 주의. 함께 웃는 것은 laugh with.

senses.meaningEn: the sound or act of laughing

examples.en: He has a really loud laugh.
We had a good laugh about it later.

senses.note: have a good laugh = 한바탕 웃다. for a laugh = 재미로.

senses.meaningEn: one of the flat green parts that grow on a plant or tree

examples.en: A yellow leaf fell on my head.
examples.ko: 노란 나뭇잎 하나가 내 머리에 떨어졌어.

examples.en: The leaves turn red in October.

senses.note: 복수형은 leafs 가 아니라 leaves. 가을 단풍은 fall leaves / autumn leaves.

senses.meaningEn: to get knowledge or a skill by studying or practicing

examples.en: I'm learning English with an app.
My daughter learned to swim last summer.

senses.note: learn to + 동사 / learn how to + 동사. study 는 공부하는 과정, learn 은 익혀서 알게 되는 결과. 과거형은 learned(미) / learnt(영).

senses.meaningEn: to find out about something

examples.en: I just learned that she is moving away.
examples.ko: 그녀가 이사 간다는 걸 방금 알았어.

examples.en: We learned about the party from a friend.

senses.note: learn that... / learn about... = ~을 알게 되다.

senses.meaningEn: to memorize something so you can remember it

examples.en: We have to learn ten new words a day.
examples.ko: 하루에 새 단어 열 개를 외워야 해.

examples.en: Did you learn your lines for the play?

senses.note: learn something by heart = 완전히 외우다.

senses.meaningEn: to go away from a place

examples.en: What time does the train leave?
I'm leaving the office now. See you soon.

senses.note: leave for + 목적지: leave for Busan = 부산으로 떠나다.

senses.meaningEn: to let something stay in a place, or forget to take it

examples.en: Oh no, I think I'm leaving my keys at home again.
examples.ko: 이런, 또 열쇠를 집에 두고 가는 것 같아.

examples.en: Just leave the dishes. I'll do them later.
examples.ko: 설거지는 그냥 둬. 내가 나중에 할게.

senses.note: Leave me alone. = 나 좀 내버려 둬.

senses.meaningEn: to give a message for someone who is not there

examples.en: Would you like to leave a message?
Please leave your name and number.

senses.meaningEn: the plural form of leaf: the flat green parts of a plant

examples.en: The leaves are falling from the trees.
We raked the leaves in the yard.

senses.note: leaf → leaves 처럼 -f 로 끝나는 명사는 복수에서 -ves 가 됨(knife → knives, wolf → wolves).

senses.meaningEn: the he/she/it form of the verb leave: to go away from a place

examples.en: The bus leaves at eight.
She leaves for work very early.

senses.note: 철자가 똑같지만 뜻이 다름. 문장에서 주어 뒤 동사 자리에 오면 leave 의 변화형.

senses.meaningEn: one of the long parts of your body that you stand and walk on

examples.en: He broke his leg playing soccer.
My legs are tired after the long walk.

senses.note: 한국어 '다리'는 leg, 발은 foot. 다리 전체를 feet 라고 하지 않도록 주의. 가구의 다리도 leg(a table leg).

senses.meaningEn: a yellow fruit with a very sour taste

examples.en: Can I get some lemon with my tea?
examples.ko: 차에 레몬 좀 넣어 주실 수 있나요?

examples.en: Squeeze a lemon over the fish.

senses.note: lemonade(레모네이드)는 레몬으로 만든 음료. 발음은 '레몬'이 아니라 /ˈlemən/.

senses.meaningEn: a period of teaching, or one part of a textbook

examples.en: Today's lesson is about the weather.
Open your book to Lesson Five.

senses.note: class 는 '수업 시간·학급', lesson 은 '수업 내용·단원'에 초점. 영국에서는 수업 자체도 lesson 이라 함.

senses.meaningEn: a time when someone teaches you a skill like music or sport

examples.en: I take piano lessons on Saturdays.
My dad is giving me driving lessons.
examples.ko: 아빠가 나한테 운전을 가르쳐 주고 있어.
