senses.note: take lessons(받다) / give lessons(해 주다). 한국어 '레슨'과 쓰임이 거의 같음.

senses.meaningEn: one of the signs used to write words, such as A or B

examples.en: The English alphabet has 26 letters.
Start the name with a capital letter.

senses.note: capital letter = 대문자, small/lowercase letter = 소문자. 한글의 '글자'도 letter 또는 character.

senses.meaningEn: a written message you send to someone, usually in an envelope

examples.en: I wrote a letter to my grandmother.
Did you get my letter?

senses.note: write/send/get a letter. 이메일은 e-mail, 문자는 text(message). cover letter = 자기소개서(입사 지원용).

senses.meaningEn: a place where you can read or borrow books

examples.en: Let's study at the library after school.
I need to return these books to the library.

senses.note: library 는 책을 빌리는 곳, bookstore 는 책을 사는 곳. 발음 /ˈlaɪbreri/ 에서 r 두 번 모두 발음.

senses.meaningEn: brightness, or a lamp that produces it

examples.en: Please turn off the light when you leave.
There's not enough light to read here.

senses.note: traffic light = 신호등.

senses.meaningEn: not heavy

examples.en: This bag is really light and easy to carry.
examples.ko: 이 가방은 정말 가볍고 들고 다니기 편해.

examples.en: I only had a light lunch today.

senses.note: light meal = 가벼운 식사, light rain = 가랑비.

senses.meaningEn: pale in color

examples.en: Do you have this in light blue?
She painted the room a light green.

senses.meaningEn: the glass part of a lamp that gives light

examples.en: The light bulb in the kitchen burned out.
Can you change the light bulb for me?

senses.note: change a light bulb = 전구를 갈다. burn out = (전구가) 나가다. 그냥 bulb 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: a bright flash of light in the sky during a storm

examples.en: Lightning hit the tree in our yard.
Stay inside when you see lightning.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: a lightning ✗ → a flash of lightning(번개 한 번). 철자 주의: lightning(번개)에는 e 가 없음. lightening = 밝아지는 것. 벼락 맞다 = be struck by lightning.

senses.meaningEn: to enjoy or find something pleasant

examples.en: I really like this song.
Do you like spicy food?

senses.note: I'd like... = ~을 원해요 (주문·요청할 때 정중한 표현).

senses.meaningEn: similar to something or someone

examples.en: She looks like her mother.
It smells like fresh bread in here.
examples.ko: 여기 갓 구운 빵 냄새가 나.

senses.note: look like / sound like / feel like + 명사.

senses.meaningEn: used to ask for a description of something

examples.en: What's the weather like today?
What's your new teacher like?

senses.note: How is...? 와 비슷하지만 성격·특징을 물을 때 더 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: a long thin mark on a surface

examples.en: Draw a line under the title.
Write your name on the first line.

senses.note: straight line = 직선, dotted line = 점선. 글의 '한 줄'도 line (read line 5 = 5행을 읽어).

senses.meaningEn: a row of people waiting for something

examples.en: There was a long line at the bakery.
Are you in line for the ticket?

senses.note: 미국식 line, 영국식 queue. stand in line / wait in line = 줄 서다. cut in line = 새치기하다.

senses.meaningEn: a telephone connection, or a train or bus route

examples.en: Take Line 2 and get off at City Hall.
Hold the line, please.

senses.note: 지하철 2호선 = Line 2. 전화에서 Hold the line. / The line is busy.(통화 중). online 의 line 도 여기서 온 말.

senses.meaningEn: a large wild cat with yellow-brown fur that lives in Africa

examples.en: The lion is called the king of the jungle.
We heard a lion roar at the safari park.
examples.ko: 사파리 공원에서 사자가 으르렁거리는 소리를 들었어.

senses.note: 암사자는 lioness, 새끼 사자는 cub. 사자는 roar(으르렁거리다). 두 음절(/ˈlaɪ-ən/)로 발음할 것.

senses.meaningEn: one of the two soft edges of your mouth

examples.en: My lips are dry in winter.
She bit her lip and said nothing.
examples.ko: 그녀는 입술을 깨물고 아무 말도 하지 않았어.

senses.note: 보통 복수 lips 로 씀. 립밤 = lip balm, 립스틱 = lipstick. 윗입술 upper lip, 아랫입술 lower lip.

senses.meaningEn: a set of names or things written one below the other

examples.en: Is my name on the list?
I made a list of things to pack.

senses.note: make/write a list, on the list(목록에 있음). to-do list(할 일 목록), waiting list(대기자 명단), shopping list(쇼핑 목록).

senses.meaningEn: to write things one after another in a list

examples.en: List three things you like about your city.
examples.ko: 네 도시에서 좋은 점 세 가지를 적어 봐.

examples.en: The ingredients are listed on the back of the box.

senses.note: 시험·수업 지시문에 자주 나옴: List the reasons... 부동산 '매물로 내놓다'도 list.

senses.meaningEn: to pay attention to a sound or to what someone says

examples.en: Listen carefully and repeat after me.
I listen to music on the bus.

senses.note: 목적어 앞에 to 필수: listen to music (listen music ✗). hear 는 저절로 들리는 것, listen 은 의식적으로 듣는 것. t 는 묵음.

senses.meaningEn: to accept someone's advice or do what they say

examples.en: You never listen to me!
examples.ko: 넌 내 말을 전혀 안 들어!

examples.en: Listen, we need to talk about this.
examples.ko: 들어 봐, 이 문제 얘기 좀 해야겠어.

senses.note: 문장 첫머리의 Listen, = '이봐, 들어 봐'로 주의를 끄는 표현. listen to one's parents = 부모 말을 잘 듣다.

senses.meaningEn: to have your home in a particular place

examples.en: Where do you live?
I live with my parents in Busan.

senses.note: live in + 도시/나라, live with + 사람, live on + 층/거리 (live on the third floor). live in Seoul 에서 in 을 빠뜨리지 않기.

senses.meaningEn: to be alive or to stay alive

examples.en: My grandfather lived to be ninety.
You can't live without water.

senses.note: live a happy life = 행복하게 살다. live on + 음식 = ~만 먹고 살다.

senses.meaningEn: broadcast or performed at the same time as it happens

examples.en: The concert is live on TV tonight.
examples.ko: 그 콘서트는 오늘 밤 TV로 생중계돼.

examples.en: We watched a live baseball game.

senses.note: 발음이 다름: 동사 live /lɪv/, 형용사·부사 live /laɪv/. live music = 라이브 음악, go live = 생방송을 시작하다.

senses.meaningEn: the main room in a home where people sit, relax, and talk

examples.en: We watched a movie in the living room.
There's a big sofa in the living room.

senses.note: 영국식으로는 sitting room / lounge 도 씀. family room 은 TV 보는 편한 방.

senses.meaningEn: bread baked in one large piece that you cut into slices

examples.en: We need a loaf of bread for breakfast.
examples.ko: 아침 먹을 식빵 한 봉지가 필요해.

examples.en: I bought two loaves of bread at the bakery.

senses.note: bread 는 셀 수 없는 명사라서 한 덩이는 a loaf of bread, 한 장은 a slice of bread 로 센다. 복수는 loaves(/loʊvz/). 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: a bread (X), two breads (X).

senses.meaningEn: to close something with a key so it cannot be opened

examples.en: Did you lock the door when you left?
Always lock your bike outside the school.
examples.ko: 학교 밖에서는 항상 자전거를 잠가 둬.

senses.note: lock the door / lock the car. 반대는 unlock. '나 자신이 밖에 갇혔다'는 I locked myself out.

senses.meaningEn: a device that keeps a door or box closed and is opened with a key

examples.en: The lock on the front door is broken.
Put a lock on your suitcase, just in case.

senses.meaningEn: to take care of a person or animal

examples.en: Can you look after the baby for an hour?
examples.ko: 한 시간만 아기 좀 봐 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: Who looks after your dog when you travel?
examples.ko: 여행 갈 때 강아지는 누가 돌봐?

senses.note: 미국에서는 take care of 를 더 많이 쓰고, look after 는 영국에서 더 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: to be responsible for something

examples.en: Could you look after my bag for a minute?
examples.ko: 잠깐 내 가방 좀 봐 줄래?

examples.en: She looks after the shop when the owner is away.
examples.ko: 사장님이 없을 때는 그녀가 가게를 맡아.

senses.meaningEn: to try to find something

examples.en: I'm looking for my keys. Have you seen them?
Are you looking for anything special today?

senses.note: '찾고 있다'(과정)는 look for, '찾았다'(결과)는 find.

senses.meaningEn: to try to get a job or find a person for a role

examples.en: My brother is looking for a new job.
examples.ko: 내 동생은 새 일자리를 구하고 있어.

examples.en: They're looking for a part-time cook.

senses.meaningEn: a meal eaten in the middle of the day

examples.en: Let's have lunch together tomorrow.
I usually bring my lunch to work.
examples.ko: 나는 보통 회사에 점심 도시락을 가져가.

senses.note: have/eat lunch(관사 없음). lunch break = 점심시간. 도시락은 packed lunch / lunch box.

senses.meaningEn: a container you carry your lunch in, or the lunch inside it

examples.en: Don't forget your lunch box today.
Mom packed a sandwich in my lunch box.
examples.ko: 엄마가 내 도시락에 샌드위치를 넣어 주셨어.

senses.note: 한국식 '도시락'은 lunch box 또는 packed lunch. 통 자체와 내용물 둘 다 가리킬 수 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a polite way to speak to a woman whose name you do not know

examples.en: Good evening, madam. Table for two?
This way, please, madam.

senses.note: 실제 대화에서는 줄인 ma'am(맘)이 훨씬 흔함. 격식 있는 식당·호텔에서 madam.

senses.meaningEn: a word used at the start of a formal letter to a woman

examples.en: Dear Madam, thank you for your email.
Dear Sir or Madam, I need some help.

senses.note: Dear Sir or Madam 은 받는 사람을 전혀 모를 때만.

senses.meaningEn: to create or prepare something

examples.en: My mom makes the best kimchi stew.
examples.ko: 우리 엄마가 김치찌개를 제일 잘 하셔.

examples.en: Can you make me a cup of coffee?
examples.ko: 커피 한 잔 타 줄 수 있어?

senses.note: make breakfast / make dinner / make a sandwich.

senses.meaningEn: to cause someone to feel or do something

examples.en: This song always makes me happy.
examples.ko: 이 노래는 항상 나를 행복하게 해.

examples.en: Don't make me laugh, I'm trying to study!

senses.note: make + 사람 + 형용사/동사원형. make me to laugh (X).

senses.meaningEn: to earn money

examples.en: How much do you make a month?
She makes good money as a nurse.
examples.ko: 그녀는 간호사로 돈을 꽤 잘 벌어.

senses.meaningEn: to do something wrong by accident

examples.en: Don't worry, everyone makes mistakes.
I always make mistakes when I rush.

senses.note: 동사는 do 가 아니라 make: do a mistake (X). 실수를 '하다'라고 해서 do 로 쓰는 흔한 오류.

senses.meaningEn: a large building with many stores, restaurants, and sometimes a cinema inside

examples.en: Let's meet at the mall after school.
There's a new mall opening downtown next month.
examples.ko: 다음 달에 시내에 새 쇼핑몰이 열려.

senses.note: shopping mall 의 줄임말. 미국에서는 그냥 the mall 이라고 많이 함. 온라인 쇼핑몰은 online store/shop 이라고 해야 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: an adult male person

examples.en: A tall man is waiting at the door.
examples.ko: 키 큰 남자가 문 앞에서 기다리고 있어.

examples.en: There were two men and one woman in the car.
examples.ko: 차 안에 남자 둘, 여자 하나가 있었어.

senses.note: 복수형은 mans 가 아니라 men. 발음 구분: man /mæn/ vs men /men/.

senses.meaningEn: used to show strong feeling or to speak to a friend

examples.en: Man, I'm so tired today.
Hey man, how's it going?

senses.note: 친구(주로 남성) 사이의 매우 캐주얼한 표현. 격식 상황에서는 피할 것.

senses.meaningEn: a sweet tropical fruit with orange flesh and a large flat seed

examples.en: Mango is my favorite fruit.
I'd like a mango smoothie, please.

senses.note: 복수형은 mangoes 와 mangos 둘 다 가능.

senses.meaningEn: a drawing of an area that shows roads, rivers, towns, and so on

examples.en: Can you show me on the map?
I used a map app to find the hotel.

senses.note: look at a map, read a map(지도를 보다). a map of Seoul(서울 지도). subway map = 지하철 노선도. 동사 map 은 '지도를 만들다, 계획을 짜다(map out)'.

senses.meaningEn: the third month of the year

examples.en: School starts in March in Korea.
The flowers come out in late March.

senses.note: 소문자 march 는 '행진하다'라는 전혀 다른 단어. 월 이름은 대문자 March 로 구분. 줄임말은 Mar.

senses.meaningEn: a thick pen with a soft tip, used for writing or drawing

examples.en: Use a black marker so everyone can see.
examples.ko: 다들 볼 수 있게 검은 마커로 써.

examples.en: This marker is dry. Do you have another one?
examples.ko: 이 마커 안 나와. 다른 거 있어?

senses.note: 한국어 '매직'은 영어로 통하지 않음 → marker. 형광펜은 highlighter.

senses.meaningEn: a place, often outside, where people sell food and other things from tables or stalls

examples.en: We buy fresh fish at the market every Sunday.
examples.ko: 우리는 매주 일요일 시장에서 신선한 생선을 사.

examples.en: The fruit at the market is cheaper than at the store.

senses.note: 한국의 '마트'는 market 이 아니라 supermarket 또는 grocery store. market 은 재래시장·벼룩시장(flea market)·농산물 시장(farmers' market) 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: the study of numbers, shapes, and amounts

examples.en: I have math class right after lunch.
examples.ko: 점심 먹고 바로 수학 수업이 있어.

examples.en: Math is hard, but I like it.

senses.note: mathematics 의 줄임말. 미국식 math, 영국식 maths. 셀 수 없는 명사로 단수 취급(Math is...). 과목 이름은 보통 관사 없이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: the fifth month of the year

examples.en: We got married in May.
Children's Day is on May 5th in Korea.

senses.note: 줄임말 없이 항상 May 로 쓴다. 소문자 may(~해도 된다, ~일지도 모른다)는 조동사로 전혀 다른 단어. 문장 중간에 May 가 대문자면 월 이름.

senses.meaningEn: an occasion when you eat food, or the food eaten at that time

examples.en: I eat three meals a day.
That was a great meal, thank you.

senses.note: breakfast/lunch/dinner 를 모두 묶어 부르는 말. 약 복용 안내에서 after meals = 식후. 한국어 '식사하다'는 have a meal.

senses.meaningEn: to have a particular meaning

examples.en: What does this word mean?
A red light means you have to stop.

senses.note: What do you mean? = 무슨 말이야? 가장 많이 쓰는 되묻기 표현.

senses.meaningEn: to be serious about what you say, or to intend something

examples.en: I mean it. You did a great job.
Sorry, I didn't mean to hurt you.

senses.note: I didn't mean to... = 일부러 그런 게 아니야. 사과할 때 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: unkind or cruel

examples.en: Don't be mean to your little brother.
That was a really mean thing to say.

senses.meaningEn: the flesh of animals, eaten as food

examples.en: I don't eat meat, I'm a vegetarian.
How long should I cook the meat?

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: meats (×), a meat (×). 영어 meat 는 보통 소·돼지·닭고기를 뜻하고 생선은 fish 로 따로 말함. 발음이 같은 meet(만나다)와 혼동 주의.

senses.meaningEn: something you drink or swallow to treat an illness

examples.en: Take this medicine three times a day after meals.
examples.ko: 이 약을 식후에 하루 세 번 먹어요.

examples.en: Did you take your medicine this morning?

senses.note: 약을 '먹다'는 eat 가 아니라 take medicine. 셀 수 없는 명사(a medicine 보다 some medicine). 약국 = pharmacy / drugstore.

senses.meaningEn: the study and practice of treating illness

examples.en: She studies medicine at university.
My brother wants to study medicine and become a doctor.
examples.ko: 내 형은 의학을 공부해서 의사가 되고 싶어 해.

senses.note: study medicine = 의대에서 공부하다. medical school(의대).

senses.meaningEn: between small and large in size or amount

examples.en: Do you have this jacket in a medium?
A medium latte, please.

senses.note: 형용사이지만 사이즈를 말할 때는 명사처럼 a medium 으로도 씀. 머리 길이는 medium-length hair.

senses.meaningEn: cooked so that the inside of the meat is pink but not red

examples.en: How would you like your steak? Medium, please.
I ordered my steak medium rare.

senses.note: 익힘 정도: rare → medium rare → medium → medium well → well done.

senses.meaningEn: a large round fruit with sweet juicy flesh and a thick skin

examples.en: This melon is really sweet and juicy.
examples.ko: 이 멜론 정말 달고 물이 많네.

examples.en: Can you cut the melon into small pieces?

senses.note: watermelon(수박)은 한 단어로 붙여 씀. 한국어 '메론'과 달리 발음은 /ˈmelən/.

senses.meaningEn: a list of the food and drinks you can order in a restaurant

examples.en: Can we see the menu, please?
Everything on the menu looks good.
examples.ko: 메뉴에 있는 게 다 맛있어 보여.

senses.note: 한국어 '메뉴'는 음식 하나를 가리키기도 하지만, 영어 menu 는 '목록(메뉴판)'. 음식 하나는 dish. '추천 메뉴 뭐예요?'는 What do you recommend?

senses.meaningEn: a list of choices shown on a computer or phone screen

examples.en: Click the menu in the top corner.
Open the settings menu and turn off the sound.

senses.note: drop-down menu = 드롭다운 메뉴. menu bar = 메뉴 바.

senses.meaningEn: untidy, with things lying around everywhere

examples.en: My room is so messy right now.
Eating ribs is always messy.

senses.note: 사람에게도 씀: a messy person(정리 안 하는 사람). 명사는 mess (What a mess! = 엉망이네!).

senses.meaningEn: a small oven that heats food very quickly using waves of energy

examples.en: Put the soup in the microwave for two minutes.
Our microwave stopped working yesterday.

senses.note: 한국어 '전자레인지'를 electric range 라고 하면 안 됨. microwave 가 맞음.

senses.meaningEn: to heat food in a microwave

examples.en: Just microwave the leftovers for lunch.
examples.ko: 점심은 남은 음식 그냥 전자레인지에 돌려 먹어.

examples.en: Can you microwave this for thirty seconds?

senses.note: 구어에서는 nuke, zap 도 쓰지만 microwave 가 가장 무난함.

senses.meaningEn: twelve o'clock at night

examples.en: I went to bed after midnight last night.
The party ended at midnight.

senses.note: at midnight(자정에). 12 a.m. 과 같은 뜻이지만 noon 처럼 midnight 이라고 말하는 게 명확하다. midnight snack = 야식. 한국어 '새벽 2시'는 two in the morning 또는 2 a.m.

senses.meaningEn: the white drink that comes from cows and that people often drink or pour on cereal

examples.en: Do you want milk in your coffee?
We're out of milk again.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: a milk (×) → a glass of milk / a carton of milk. soy milk(두유), almond milk 등 식물성 음료에도 milk 를 씀.

senses.meaningEn: the number 1,000,000

examples.en: About ten million people live in Seoul.
The house sold for two million dollars.

senses.note: 한국어 '백만' = one million, '천만' = ten million, '1억' = one hundred million. 단위 바꾸는 연습이 필요함.

senses.meaningEn: a very large number or amount

examples.en: Thanks a million for your help!
I've seen that video a million times.

senses.note: Thanks a million = 정말 고마워(구어). one in a million = 아주 특별한 사람.

senses.meaningEn: a period of sixty seconds

examples.en: The train leaves in ten minutes.
It's a five-minute walk from here.

senses.note: 형용사처럼 쓸 때는 단수: a five-minute walk, a ten-minute break. 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: a five minutes walk (X).

senses.meaningEn: a very short time

examples.en: Wait a minute, I'm almost ready.
Do you have a minute to talk?

senses.note: Just a minute. / Hold on a minute. = 잠시만요. 실제로 1분을 뜻하는 게 아니라 '잠깐'. 형용사 minute(/maɪˈnuːt/, 아주 작은)는 발음이 다르다.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of glass that you can see yourself in

examples.en: She looked at herself in the mirror.
There's a big mirror in the bathroom.

senses.note: 거울'을' 보다는 look in the mirror(at ✗). 자동차 뒷거울은 rearview mirror, 사이드미러는 side mirror.

senses.meaningEn: to fail to catch a bus, train, or chance

examples.en: Hurry, or we'll miss the bus!
I missed the last train and took a taxi.

senses.meaningEn: to feel sad because someone or something is not with you

examples.en: I miss you so much. Come visit soon.
examples.ko: 너무 보고 싶어. 빨리 놀러 와.

examples.en: Do you miss Korean food when you travel?
examples.ko: 여행 가면 한국 음식 그립지 않아?

senses.note: '보고 싶다'를 want to see 로 직역하지 말고 miss 를 쓰면 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to not go to a class, meeting, or event

examples.en: I missed class yesterday because I was sick.
Don't miss the meeting at three.

senses.meaningEn: something you do wrong by accident

examples.en: I made a few mistakes on the test.
Don't worry. Everyone makes mistakes.

senses.note: make a mistake(do a mistake 는 틀림!). by mistake = 실수로(I took your bag by mistake). spelling mistake = 철자 실수.

senses.meaningEn: to think wrongly that one person or thing is another

examples.en: Sorry, I mistook you for my friend.
People often mistake me for my sister.

senses.note: mistake A for B = A 를 B 로 착각하다. 과거형 mistook, 과거분사 mistaken. You're mistaken. = 네가 잘못 알고 있어.

senses.meaningEn: to combine two or more things so they become one

examples.en: Mix the eggs and sugar in a bowl.
Mix the rice well with the sauce.

senses.note: mix A with B / mix A and B. 비빔밥은 mixed rice 로 설명 가능. 재료를 저어 섞으면 stir.

senses.meaningEn: a powder you add water or milk to in order to make food

examples.en: I bought a pancake mix at the store.
Just add water to the cake mix.

senses.meaningEn: an informal word for mother

examples.en: Mom, can I go out and play?
My mom makes the best pancakes.
examples.ko: 우리 엄마는 팬케이크를 제일 잘 만들어.

senses.note: 미국식 mom, 영국식 mum. 직접 부를 때는 대문자 Mom. 어린아이는 mommy.

senses.meaningEn: the day of the week after Sunday and before Tuesday

examples.en: I have an English class on Monday.
Monday is the busiest day at work.

senses.note: 요일은 항상 대문자로 쓰고 전치사는 on 을 쓴다(on Monday). on Mondays = 월요일마다. this/next/last Monday 앞에는 전치사 없음. Monday blues = 월요병.

senses.meaningEn: coins and bills that you use to buy things

examples.en: I don't have enough money for a new phone.
examples.ko: 새 휴대폰 살 돈이 충분하지 않아.

examples.en: How much money did you spend today?

senses.note: 불가산 명사: a money, moneys 는 틀림. much money / a lot of money. 돈을 '벌다'는 make/earn money, '쓰다'는 spend money, '모으다'는 save money.

senses.meaningEn: an animal with a long tail that climbs trees and is similar to humans

examples.en: The monkeys at the zoo were eating bananas.
A monkey took my hat on the mountain!

senses.note: 복수형은 monkeys(monkies 아님). 꼬리 없는 큰 유인원(고릴라·침팬지)은 ape. monkey around = 장난치다(비격식). 장난꾸러기 아이를 little monkey 라고 부름.

senses.meaningEn: one of the twelve parts of a year, about four weeks

examples.en: My birthday is next month.
We pay rent at the beginning of each month.

senses.note: 복수 months 의 발음(/mʌnθs/)이 어렵다면 th 를 가볍게 발음해도 통함. 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: '한 달에 두 번'은 twice a month, '다음 달에'는 next month(in 없이). 월 이름(January 등)은 대문자로 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: happening or done once every month

examples.en: How much is your monthly rent?
I pay my phone bill monthly.

senses.note: monthly rent(월세), monthly salary(월급), monthly pass(한 달 정기권). 형용사·부사 모두 같은 형태.

senses.meaningEn: the round object that shines in the sky at night

examples.en: Look, the moon is so bright tonight!
examples.ko: 봐, 오늘 밤 달이 정말 밝다!

examples.en: There's a full moon on Chuseok.

senses.note: full moon(보름달), new moon(초승달/삭), half moon(반달). once in a blue moon = 아주 드물게. over the moon = 너무 기뻐서(영국식 구어).

senses.meaningEn: the early part of the day, from when you wake up until noon

examples.en: I drink coffee every morning.
The meeting is at ten in the morning.

senses.note: in the morning(아침에) 이지만 this/tomorrow/yesterday morning 앞에는 전치사 없음. on Monday morning(요일과 함께는 on). Good morning! 은 정오 전까지 쓰는 인사. 발음은 mourning(애도)과 같다.

senses.meaningEn: a female parent

examples.en: My mother works at a hospital.
Her mother is a wonderful cook.

senses.note: 격식적·중립적 표현. 직접 부를 때는 보통 Mom 을 씀. Mother's Day = 어머니의 날.

senses.meaningEn: a very high hill

examples.en: We climbed the mountain last weekend.
There is snow on top of the mountain.

senses.note: '등산하다'는 climb a mountain 또는 go hiking. 산 이름 앞에는 Mount(Mt.)를 붙임: Mt. Halla. mountain 은 hill 보다 훨씬 높음.

senses.meaningEn: a small animal with a pointed nose, a long thin tail, and gray or brown fur

examples.en: There's a mouse in the kitchen!
Our cat caught two mice last night.
examples.ko: 우리 고양이가 어젯밤에 쥐 두 마리를 잡았어.

senses.note: 복수형은 mice(mouses 는 틀림). mouse 는 작은 생쥐, rat 은 더 큰 시궁쥐. 쥐 소리는 squeak.

senses.meaningEn: a small device you move with your hand to control a computer

examples.en: My mouse isn't working. Can I borrow yours?
examples.ko: 내 마우스가 안 돼. 네 거 좀 빌려줄래?

examples.en: Click the right button on the mouse.

senses.note: 컴퓨터 마우스의 복수형은 mice 와 mouses 둘 다 쓰지만 보통 mice. wireless mouse(무선 마우스), mouse pad(마우스 패드).

senses.meaningEn: the part of your face that you eat and speak with

examples.en: Open your mouth and say 'ah'.
Don't talk with your mouth full.

senses.note: 입을 다물다 = close your mouth, 입이 마르다 = my mouth is dry. 복수 mouths 는 발음이 /maʊðz/.

senses.meaningEn: to change position, or to put something in a different place

examples.en: Can you move your car, please?
Don't move, there's a bee on your arm.

senses.note: move over = 옆으로 좀 가다 (자리 비켜 줄 때). move the chair = 의자를 옮기다.

senses.meaningEn: to go to live in a different house or city

examples.en: We moved to Seoul last year.
She's moving to a new apartment next month.
examples.ko: 그녀는 다음 달에 새 아파트로 이사해.

senses.note: move to + 장소. move in(입주하다), move out(이사 나가다). "이사하다"를 move house 라고도 함(영국).

senses.meaningEn: to make someone feel strong emotions, especially sadness or sympathy

examples.en: The movie really moved me.
I was moved by her kind words.

senses.note: be moved by ~ = ~에 감동하다. 형용사 moving = 감동적인 (a moving story).

senses.meaningEn: a title used before a man's family name

examples.en: Good morning, Mr. Kim.
Mr. Brown is our new teacher.

senses.note: 반드시 성(family name) 앞에 붙임. Mr. Minsu(이름)는 틀림. 미국식은 마침표를 찍고(Mr.), 영국식은 생략(Mr). 한국의 '선생님'처럼 상대 직업과 상관없이 쓸 수 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a title used before a married woman's family name

examples.en: Mrs. Lee lives next door to us.
Thank you for the cookies, Mrs. Park.

senses.note: 결혼 여부를 모르면 Ms. 를 쓰는 것이 안전함. 발음은 '미시즈'.

senses.meaningKo: ~씨 (결혼 여부와 상관없이 여성 성 앞에 붙이는 호칭)
senses.meaningEn: a title used before a woman's family name, whether she is married or not

examples.en: Ms. Choi is my English teacher.
Can I speak to Ms. Johnson, please?

senses.note: 발음은 '미즈'. 직장·이메일에서 여성에게 가장 무난한 호칭. Miss(미혼)·Mrs.(기혼)와 구별.

senses.meaningEn: soft wet earth

examples.en: My shoes are covered in mud.
The kids love playing in the mud.

senses.note: 불가산. 진흙투성이의 = muddy(muddy shoes). 머드 축제 = mud festival.

senses.meaningEn: a soft plant with a round top and a stem, often used in cooking

examples.en: I'd like a mushroom pizza, please.
Don't eat wild mushrooms you don't know.

senses.note: 버섯은 셀 수 있는 명사(mushrooms). 송이·표고 등은 pine mushroom, shiitake.

senses.meaningEn: the school subject where you sing and learn about sounds and songs

examples.en: We sang a new song in music class.
Our music teacher plays the guitar.

senses.meaningEn: sounds made by instruments or voices that people enjoy listening to

examples.en: I listen to music on the bus.
What kind of music do you like?

senses.note: listen to music(to 필수). 셀 수 없는 명사: a music ✗, musics ✗. 노래 한 곡은 a song. musician = 음악가.

senses.meaningEn: the hard part at the end of your finger or toe

examples.en: I need to cut my nails.
Stop biting your nails!

senses.note: 손톱 fingernail, 발톱 toenail. 네일숍 = nail salon, 매니큐어 = nail polish(manicure 는 손톱 관리 서비스).

senses.meaningEn: a thin pointed piece of metal that you hit into wood

examples.en: Hang the picture on that nail.
Be careful, there's a nail on the floor.

senses.note: 못을 박다 = hammer a nail / nail something to the wall(동사로도 씀). 나사는 screw.

senses.meaningEn: the word that someone or something is called by

examples.en: What's your name?
My name is Minsu, nice to meet you.

senses.note: first name(이름) / last name, family name(성). full name = 성명. 영어는 이름을 먼저 말함.

senses.meaningEn: to give a name to a person, animal, or thing

examples.en: They named their baby Emma.
We named the dog Max.

senses.note: name A B = A 를 B 라고 이름 짓다. be named after = ~의 이름을 따서 짓다.

senses.meaningEn: to say the names of people or things

examples.en: Can you name three colors?
examples.ko: 색깔 세 가지 말해 볼 수 있어?

examples.en: Name a country that starts with K.
examples.ko: K 로 시작하는 나라 하나 말해 봐.

senses.note: 퀴즈·수업에서 자주 쓰는 표현. Name it! = 뭐든 말만 해!

senses.meaningEn: a piece of paper or cloth used at meals to clean your mouth and hands

examples.en: Could I have some more napkins?
He wiped his mouth with a napkin.

senses.note: 미국에서는 식탁용 휴지가 napkin. 휴지(화장지)는 tissue / toilet paper 로 구분. 영국에서는 serviette 도 씀.

senses.meaningEn: everything in the world not made by people, such as plants, animals, and weather

examples.en: I love walking in nature on weekends.
examples.ko: 주말에 자연 속을 걷는 게 좋아.

examples.en: We should protect nature for our children.

senses.note: 셀 수 없고 the 를 붙이지 않음: the nature ✗ → nature ✓. in nature = 자연 속에서. nature documentary(자연 다큐). 자연재해 = natural disaster(형용사 natural).

senses.meaningEn: the way a person or thing really is

examples.en: It's not in his nature to be rude.
examples.ko: 무례한 건 그 사람 천성이 아니야.

examples.en: She's kind by nature.

senses.note: by nature = 천성적으로. human nature = 인간 본성. good-natured = 성격이 온화한.

senses.meaningEn: the part of your body that joins your head to your shoulders

examples.en: I have a stiff neck from sleeping badly.
She wore a scarf around her neck.

senses.note: 한국어 '목'은 두 가지: 바깥쪽 목은 neck, 목구멍(안쪽)은 throat. '목이 아파'가 감기면 I have a sore throat, 뻐근하면 My neck hurts.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of jewelry that you wear around your neck

examples.en: She wore a gold necklace with her dress.
He gave her a necklace for her birthday.

senses.note: neck(목)+lace. 목걸이를 '하다/차다'도 wear/put on. 발음은 /ˈnekləs/ 로 'lace'를 길게 읽지 않음.

senses.meaningEn: a person who lives near you

examples.en: Our neighbors are very friendly.
My next-door neighbor has a cute dog.

senses.note: 영국식 철자는 neighbour. next-door neighbor = 바로 옆집 사람. gh 는 묵음.

senses.meaningEn: a person or thing that is next to another

examples.en: Please share the book with your neighbor.
Turn to your neighbor and say hello.

senses.note: 교실·행사에서 '옆자리 사람'을 가리킬 때 자주 씀. 나라끼리도 neighboring countries(이웃 나라).

senses.meaningEn: the area of a town where you live and the people who live there

examples.en: We live in a quiet neighborhood.
There's a new café in my neighborhood.

senses.note: 영국식 철자는 neighbourhood. '이웃 사람'은 neighbor. in the neighborhood = 근처에.

senses.meaningEn: not at any time; not ever

examples.en: I never drink coffee at night.
examples.ko: 나는 밤에 커피를 절대 안 마셔.

examples.en: Never give up on your dream.

senses.note: never 자체가 부정이라 not을 같이 쓰지 않음(I don't never go ✗ → I never go). Never mind. = 신경 쓰지 마, 괜찮아.

senses.meaningEn: not even once in your life up to now

examples.en: I have never been to Japan.
examples.ko: 나는 일본에 한 번도 가 본 적이 없어.

examples.en: He has never eaten sushi before.
examples.ko: 그는 전에 초밥을 한 번도 먹어 본 적이 없어.

senses.note: 경험을 말할 때는 have/has + never + 과거분사 형태로 씀. 질문은 Have you ever...? 로 묻고 부정 답은 never 로 함.

senses.meaningEn: recently made or bought, not used before

examples.en: I got a new phone last week.
Are these shoes new? They look great.

senses.note: brand new = 완전히 새것. '중고'는 used 또는 second-hand. 영국식 발음은 /njuː/.

senses.meaningEn: recently arrived at a place or recently started doing something

examples.en: I'm new here. Could you help me?
examples.ko: 제가 여기 처음이라서요. 도와주실 수 있어요?

examples.en: We have a new teacher this year.

senses.note: be new to + 장소/일 = ~에 익숙하지 않다(I'm new to this job). What's new? = 별일 없어? (안부 인사).

senses.meaningEn: coming right after this one in time or order

examples.en: See you next week!
Who's next, please?

senses.note: next week / next Monday 앞에는 전치사를 쓰지 않음(on next Monday ✗). the next day = 그 다음 날(과거 이야기).

senses.meaningEn: after this or that, in order

examples.en: What should we do next?
Next, add the eggs and mix well.

senses.meaningEn: beside; very close to something

examples.en: The bank is next to the post office.
Can I sit next to you?

senses.note: '옆에'는 꼭 next to 로 to 를 붙임. next the door ✗ → next to the door ✓.

senses.meaningEn: pleasant, enjoyable, or good

examples.en: What a nice day! Let's go outside.
We had a nice dinner at a small restaurant.

senses.note: 거의 모든 좋은 것에 쓸 수 있는 만능 형용사. 다만 너무 자주 쓰면 밋밋하게 들리니 great, lovely, delicious 등으로 바꿔 보자.

senses.meaningEn: kind and friendly to other people

examples.en: Thank you, that's very nice of you.
Be nice to your little brother.

senses.note: It's nice of you to + 동사 = ~해 줘서 고마워요. Nice to meet you. 는 첫 만남 인사. 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: 사람에 대해 쓰면 '외모가 멋지다'가 아니라 '성격이 좋다'는 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: the time when it is dark and most people sleep

examples.en: I couldn't sleep last night.
The stars are bright at night in the countryside.

senses.note: at night(밤에)는 at 을 쓰고 in the night 은 '한밤중에 (무슨 일이 일어남)'의 느낌. last night = 어젯밤(yesterday night X). Good night! 은 잘 자라는 인사. 발음은 knight(기사)와 같다.

senses.meaningEn: one stay of a night at a hotel or someone's home

examples.en: We stayed in Busan for three nights.
The hotel costs 100 dollars a night.

senses.note: 호텔 요금은 per night / a night(1박당). 2박 3일 = three days and two nights, 혹은 간단히 two nights. 친구 집에 하루 자고 가는 것은 stay the night / stay over.

senses.meaningEn: the number 9

examples.en: The store opens at nine in the morning.
examples.ko: 그 가게는 아침 아홉 시에 열어.

examples.en: Nine people came to the party.

senses.note: 서수는 ninth(9th, e 가 빠짐). nineteen(19), ninety(90)는 e 를 그대로 둠. 미국 긴급 전화 911은 nine one one 으로 읽음.

senses.meaningEn: the number 19

examples.en: My sister is nineteen and goes to college.
examples.ko: 우리 누나는 열아홉 살이고 대학에 다녀.

examples.en: I was born in nineteen ninety-nine.

senses.note: 연도는 두 자리씩 끊어 읽음: 1999 = nineteen ninety-nine, 1980 = nineteen eighty. 2000년대 이후는 two thousand (and) five 또는 twenty twenty-five.

senses.meaningEn: the number 90

examples.en: My grandfather is ninety years old.
The bus takes about ninety minutes.

senses.note: ninety(90)와 nineteen(19)은 강세로 구별: NINE-ty / nine-TEEN. 90년대 = the nineties.

senses.meaningEn: no person; not anyone

examples.en: No one came to the meeting.
No one told me about the test.
examples.ko: 시험에 대해 아무도 말해 주지 않았어.

senses.note: nobody 와 같은 뜻, 글에서 조금 더 흔함. 두 단어로 띄어 씀(noone ×). 동사는 긍정형·단수: No one knows.

senses.meaningEn: no person; not anyone

examples.en: Nobody answered the phone.
There was nobody in the room.

senses.note: nobody 자체가 부정이라 동사는 긍정형: Nobody knows(○) Nobody doesn't know(×). 단수 동사 사용.

senses.meaningEn: a long, thin piece of food made from flour, cooked in water or soup

examples.en: I love spicy noodles on a cold day.
examples.ko: 추운 날엔 매운 국수가 정말 좋아.

examples.en: Do you want noodles or rice with that?

senses.note: 거의 항상 복수형 noodles 로 씀. instant noodles(라면), rice noodles(쌀국수). 한국의 '라면'은 영어로 ramen 또는 instant noodles.

senses.meaningEn: twelve o'clock in the middle of the day

examples.en: Let's meet at noon for lunch.
The store opens at noon on Sundays.

senses.note: at noon(정오에). 12 p.m. 와 같은 뜻이지만 a.m./p.m. 이 헷갈리기 쉬워서 noon 이라고 말하는 게 더 명확하다. 영국식은 midday 도 자주 씀. afternoon(오후)은 noon 뒤의 시간.

senses.meaningEn: the part of your face that you breathe and smell with

examples.en: I have a runny nose and a cough.
Blow your nose with this tissue.

senses.note: 콧물이 나다 = have a runny nose, 코가 막히다 = have a stuffy nose, 코를 풀다 = blow your nose. 코피 = nosebleed.

senses.meaningEn: a book of empty pages for writing notes in

examples.en: Write the new words in your notebook.
I left my notebook at school.

senses.note: 한국어 '노트'는 영어로 notebook. note 는 '메모·쪽지'. take notes = 필기하다.

senses.meaningEn: a small, thin computer you can carry

examples.en: I bought a new notebook for school.
My notebook battery dies too fast.
examples.ko: 내 노트북 배터리가 너무 빨리 죽어.

senses.note: 컴퓨터는 영어에서 보통 laptop 이라고 함. notebook 만 쓰면 공책으로 들릴 수 있으니 notebook computer 또는 laptop 으로.

senses.meaningEn: the eleventh month of the year

examples.en: Thanksgiving is in late November.
It started snowing in November last year.

senses.note: 줄임말 Nov. 미국 추수감사절(Thanksgiving)은 11월 네 번째 목요일. 발음은 '노벰버'에 가깝게.

senses.meaningEn: at this moment

examples.en: I'm busy right now.
Where are you now?

senses.note: right now = 바로 지금. from now on = 지금부터. for now = 당분간은. 현재진행형(am doing)과 자주 함께 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: used to start a new topic or get attention

examples.en: Now, let's look at page ten.
Now, where did I put my keys?

senses.note: 이 뜻일 때는 '지금'이 아니라 주의를 끄는 말로, 뒤에 쉼표를 찍고 쉬어 읽는다. now then / now, now 등 다양한 변형이 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a word or sign like 1, 2, or 3 that shows how many

examples.en: Pick a number from one to ten.
Seven is my lucky number.

senses.note: number = 수 전체, digit = 한 자리 숫자(0~9). even number = 짝수, odd number = 홀수. 축약형 No. (No. 3 = 3번).

senses.meaningEn: a group of numbers that identifies a phone, room, or house

examples.en: Can I have your phone number?
What's your room number?

senses.note: 번호를 말할 때 0 은 oh 또는 zero. wrong number = 잘못 걸린 전화(You have the wrong number.).

senses.meaningEn: an amount of people or things

examples.en: A large number of students were late.
The number of cars is growing every year.

senses.note: a number of + 복수명사(여러 개의) → 복수 동사. the number of + 복수명사(~의 수) → 단수 동사. 시험에 자주 나오는 차이.

senses.meaningEn: a person whose job is to care for sick or injured people, usually in a hospital

examples.en: The nurse checked my temperature and blood pressure.
My aunt works as a nurse at a children's hospital.

senses.note: 남녀 모두 nurse(male nurse 라고 굳이 안 함). 동사로 '간호하다'도 가능. nursing home(요양원).

senses.meaningEn: a dry fruit with a hard shell and a seed inside that you can eat

examples.en: I eat a handful of nuts every day.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 견과류 한 줌을 먹어.

examples.en: Does this cake have nuts in it?

senses.note: 주로 복수형 nuts. 알레르기를 말할 때 I'm allergic to nuts. 땅콩은 peanut, 호두는 walnut.

senses.meaningEn: (nuts) crazy, or very excited about something

examples.en: Are you nuts? That's so dangerous!
My brother is nuts about soccer.

senses.note: be nuts about ~ = ~에 열광하다. go nuts = 미치다·흥분하다. 친한 사이에서만 씀.

senses.meaningEn: used after a number to say the exact hour

examples.en: Let's meet at six o'clock.
It's already ten o'clock!

senses.note: 정각에만 쓴다. 6:30 은 six thirty 또는 half past six 이고 six thirty o'clock 은 틀림. 원래 of the clock 의 줄임말이라 아포스트로피가 있음. 숫자 뒤에서만 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: one of the very large areas of salt water on the earth

examples.en: The Pacific Ocean is the biggest ocean.
We watched the sunset over the ocean.
examples.ko: 우리는 바다 위로 지는 해를 바라봤어.

senses.note: 미국 영어에서는 바다를 흔히 the ocean 이라고 함(영국은 the sea). 대양 이름은 the Pacific Ocean, the Atlantic Ocean.

senses.meaningEn: the tenth month of the year

examples.en: The leaves turn red in October.
Halloween is on October 31st.

senses.note: 줄임말 Oct. 날짜를 말할 때는 October thirty-first 처럼 서수로 읽는다. 10월 하면 Halloween 과 단풍(fall colors)이 대표적.

senses.meaningEn: a sea animal with a soft body and eight long arms

examples.en: An octopus has eight arms.
Have you ever tried grilled octopus?

senses.note: 복수형은 octopuses(octopi 도 쓰임). 문어 다리는 arms 또는 tentacles. 낙지·주꾸미도 보통 small octopus 로 설명. 오징어는 squid, 요리명은 calamari.

senses.meaningEn: many times; on many occasions

examples.en: How often do you go to the gym?
We often eat out on Fridays.

senses.note: 빈도부사라 보통 일반동사 앞, be동사 뒤에 옴(I often go / I am often late). t는 보통 묵음이지만 /ˈɔːftən/도 흔함. 빈도: always > usually > often > sometimes > never.

senses.meaningEn: a thick liquid from plants or animals that is used in cooking

examples.en: Heat some oil in the pan first.
examples.ko: 먼저 팬에 기름을 좀 두르고 데워.

examples.en: I use olive oil on my salad.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. cooking oil(식용유), olive oil(올리브유), sesame oil(참기름), vegetable oil(콩기름 등 식물성 기름). 형용사는 oily(기름진).

senses.meaningEn: a thick, dark liquid taken from under the ground, used as fuel or to make machines run smoothly

examples.en: The car needs an oil change soon.
Oil prices went up again this month.
examples.ko: 이번 달에 석유 가격이 또 올랐어.

senses.note: 자동차 '기름(연료)'은 oil 이 아니라 gas(미) / petrol(영). oil 은 엔진오일이나 원유를 뜻함. '기름 넣어야 해' = I need to get gas.

senses.meaningEn: having lived for a long time, or used to say someone's age

examples.en: How old is your brother?
My son is five years old.

senses.note: 나이를 말할 때는 ~ years old. 노인을 old people 이라고 하면 무례하게 들릴 수 있어 elderly, older people 을 권함. 반대말은 young.

senses.meaningEn: having existed or been used for a long time

examples.en: These are my old jeans from high school.
examples.ko: 이거 고등학교 때부터 입던 낡은 청바지야.

examples.en: We live in an old house downtown.
examples.ko: 우리는 시내에 있는 오래된 집에 살아.

senses.note: '헌 옷'은 old clothes, 중고는 used. 역사적으로 오래된 건물은 historic 이 더 긍정적.

senses.meaningEn: from an earlier time in your life

examples.en: I met an old friend at the station.
This is my old school.

senses.note: old friend = 늙은 친구가 아니라 '오래된 친구'. my old job(예전 직장), the good old days(좋았던 옛날).

senses.meaningEn: one time only

examples.en: I go swimming once a week.
examples.ko: 나는 일주일에 한 번 수영을 가.

examples.en: I only met him once.
examples.ko: 그 사람은 딱 한 번 만났어.

senses.note: 횟수: once(1회) → twice(2회) → three times(3회). once a day/week/month = 하루/일주일/한 달에 한 번. one time 도 가능하지만 once 가 더 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: at some time in the past, but not now

examples.en: My dad once lived in Busan.
This was once a small village.

senses.note: Once upon a time... = 옛날 옛적에(동화 시작 문구).

senses.meaningEn: as soon as; after something has happened

examples.en: Once you try it, you will love it.
examples.ko: 한번 먹어 보면 분명 좋아할 거야.

examples.en: Call me once you get home.

senses.note: 접속사로 쓰일 때 미래 일이어도 뒤에는 현재형(Once you get home, 미래형 ✗).

senses.meaningEn: the number 1

examples.en: I have one brother and two sisters.
examples.ko: 나는 남동생 하나, 여동생 둘이 있어.

examples.en: Let's meet at one o'clock.

senses.note: 서수는 first(1st). one hundred, one thousand 처럼 큰 수 앞에도 붙임. won(이기다의 과거형)과 발음이 같음.

senses.meaningEn: used instead of repeating a noun already mentioned

examples.en: Which one do you want, the red or the blue?
examples.ko: 빨간 거랑 파란 거 중에 어느 걸 원해?

examples.en: This cup is dirty. Can I get a new one?
examples.ko: 이 컵이 더러워요. 새 걸로 받을 수 있을까요?

senses.note: 같은 명사를 반복하지 않으려고 씀. 복수는 ones: I like the blue ones. this one / that one / the other one 이 가장 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: used to talk about a particular time without saying exactly when

examples.en: One day I want to visit Paris.
I saw her at the park one morning.
examples.ko: 어느 날 아침 공원에서 그녀를 봤어.

senses.note: one day 는 과거(어느 날)와 미래(언젠가) 둘 다 가능. someday 는 미래에만 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a round vegetable with many layers and a strong smell and taste

examples.en: Cutting onions always makes me cry.
No onions on my burger, please.

senses.note: 발음은 '어니언' /ˈʌnjən/. green onion = 파, spring onion(영국식).

senses.meaningEn: to move something so it is no longer closed

examples.en: Can you open the window? It's hot.
Open your mouth and say ah.

senses.meaningEn: not closed, or ready for business

examples.en: Is the bank open on Saturdays?
The store is open until ten.

senses.note: '영업 중'은 open, '닫음'은 closed(close 가 아님).

senses.meaningEn: a round, sweet fruit with a thick orange skin

examples.en: Can you peel this orange for me?
I had an orange and some yogurt for breakfast.

senses.note: 모음으로 시작하므로 an orange. 한국어 '귤'은 영어로 mandarin 또는 tangerine. 오렌지 껍질은 orange peel.

senses.meaningEn: having the color between red and yellow

examples.en: She was wearing a bright orange jacket.
examples.ko: 그녀는 밝은 주황색 재킷을 입고 있었어.

examples.en: The sky turned orange at sunset.

senses.note: 명사(주황색)로도 씀: My favorite color is orange. 과일과 색깔이 같은 단어라서 문맥으로 구분.

senses.meaningEn: to ask for food, drink, or goods

examples.en: Are you ready to order?
I ordered a pizza online last night.

senses.note: 식당에서 종업원이 Are you ready to order? 라고 물으면 I'll have... 로 답함.

senses.meaningEn: a request for food or goods

examples.en: Can I take your order?
My order hasn't arrived yet.

senses.note: place an order = 주문하다, take an order = 주문을 받다.

senses.meaningEn: the way things are arranged one after another

examples.en: Put the words in the right order.
The names are in alphabetical order.

senses.note: out of order = 고장 난 (기계에 붙은 안내문).

senses.meaningEn: not inside a building; in the open air

examples.en: The kids are playing outside in the yard.
It's sunny outside. Let's go for a walk.

senses.meaningEn: not in a particular place, but near it

examples.en: I'll wait for you outside the station.
There's a bus stop right outside the school.
examples.ko: 학교 바로 밖에 버스 정류장이 있어.

senses.note: meet outside the café = 카페 앞에서 만나자. outside of 는 미국 구어.

senses.meaningEn: a closed box in a kitchen that you heat to bake or roast food

examples.en: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
The cookies are in the oven right now.

senses.note: 발음은 /ˈʌvən/ ('어븐'). put it in the oven, take it out of the oven. 전자레인지는 microwave (oven).

senses.meaningEn: a bird with large round eyes that hunts at night

examples.en: An owl was sitting on the tree outside.
examples.ko: 밖에 있는 나무에 부엉이가 앉아 있었어.

examples.en: Owls can see very well in the dark.
examples.ko: 부엉이는 어두운 데서도 아주 잘 봐.

senses.note: night owl = 밤에 활동하는 사람, 야행성 인간(↔ early bird). 부엉이 소리는 hoot. 영어에서 owl 은 '지혜'의 상징(as wise as an owl). 발음은 한 음절 /aʊl/.

senses.meaningEn: one side of a sheet of paper in a book

examples.en: Turn to page 15, everyone.
This book has over 300 pages.

senses.note: 쪽수를 말할 때 page 15 처럼 뒤에 숫자. '페이지를 넘기다'는 turn the page.

senses.meaningEn: a single screen of information on a website

examples.en: The page is not loading.
Go to the home page and click on 'Login'.

senses.note: home page = 사이트 첫 화면. 웹페이지는 web page(띄어 쓰기도 함).

senses.meaningEn: the feeling you have when a part of your body hurts

examples.en: I have a sharp pain in my back.
Is the pain getting better or worse?

senses.note: have / feel a pain in + 신체 부위. be in pain(아파하고 있다). 진통제 = painkiller. 형용사 painful(아픈).

senses.meaningEn: someone or something that is annoying

examples.en: Waiting in line is such a pain.
examples.ko: 줄 서서 기다리는 거 정말 귀찮아.

examples.en: My little brother can be a real pain sometimes.

senses.note: a pain (in the neck) = 귀찮은 사람/일. 친한 사이에서만 쓰는 표현.

senses.meaningEn: to make a picture using paints

examples.en: The kids painted pictures of the sea.
I want to learn to paint flowers.
examples.ko: 꽃 그림 그리는 걸 배우고 싶어.

senses.note: 물감 그림은 paint, 연필·펜 그림은 draw. 그린 그림은 painting, 화가는 painter.

senses.meaningEn: to cover a wall or object with paint

examples.en: We painted the kitchen yellow.
Dad is painting the fence this weekend.

senses.note: paint something + 색깔(paint the wall white). 'Wet paint' 는 '페인트 주의' 안내문.

senses.meaningEn: a colored liquid used for making pictures or covering walls

examples.en: Don't get paint on your clothes.
We need a can of white paint.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. 물감 세트는 a set of paints 로 복수 가능.

senses.meaningEn: two things of the same kind that are used together

examples.en: I bought a new pair of shoes.
Do you have a pair of scissors?

senses.note: a pair of + 복수명사. shoes, socks, gloves(두 개로 된 것)와 jeans, pants, glasses, scissors(하나지만 두 부분으로 된 것) 모두 pair 로 센다. 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: a pants (X) → a pair of pants (O).

senses.meaningEn: two people who are together or do something together

examples.en: Work in pairs and talk about your weekend.
examples.ko: 둘씩 짝을 지어 주말에 대해 이야기해 보세요.

examples.en: The two of them make a nice pair.

senses.note: in pairs = 둘씩. 교실에서 pair work(짝 활동)라는 표현을 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a large black and white animal like a bear that lives in China and eats bamboo

examples.en: The pandas at the zoo were eating bamboo.
My daughter has a panda on her backpack.
examples.ko: 우리 딸 가방에 판다 그림이 있어.

senses.note: giant panda(자이언트 판다)가 정식 이름. 대나무는 bamboo. 한국의 '푸바오'처럼 판다는 아이들 대화에 자주 등장.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of clothing that covers the legs, with a separate part for each leg

examples.en: These pants are a little long for me.
He put on his pants and a sweater.

senses.note: 항상 복수형. 한 벌은 a pair of pants. 영국에서 pants 는 '속옷'이고 바지는 trousers 이니 주의.

senses.meaningEn: thin material that you write or draw on

examples.en: Can I have a piece of paper?
examples.ko: 종이 한 장 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: Write your name at the top of the paper.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. '종이 한 장'은 a paper ✗ → a piece of paper / a sheet of paper.

senses.meaningEn: a test, or a piece of writing done for school

examples.en: I have to write a paper for history class.
The teacher handed back our papers today.

senses.note: 이 뜻일 때는 셀 수 있는 명사(a paper, papers).

senses.meaningEn: a newspaper

examples.en: My dad reads the paper every morning.
examples.ko: 우리 아빠는 매일 아침 신문을 읽으셔.

examples.en: Did you see the story in today's paper?

senses.note: 구어에서 newspaper 를 줄여 the paper 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: a person's mother or father

examples.en: My parents live in a small town.
Every parent wants the best for their child.
examples.ko: 모든 부모는 자식에게 가장 좋은 걸 바라지.

senses.note: 한 명이면 parent, 두 분이면 parents. 한국어 '부모님'을 말할 때 대부분 복수 parents 를 써야 함.

senses.meaningEn: the mother or father of a student, in relation to the school

examples.en: Parents are invited to the school meeting on Friday.
The teacher called my parents last night.

senses.note: parent-teacher meeting = 학부모 상담.

senses.meaningEn: the person you do an activity or game with

examples.en: Find a partner and practice the dialogue.
My partner and I won the game.

senses.meaningEn: the person you are married to or in a long relationship with

examples.en: She came to the party with her partner.
You can bring your partner to the dinner.
examples.ko: 저녁 식사에 배우자나 연인을 데려와도 돼.

senses.note: 결혼 여부·성별을 밝히지 않고 연인/배우자를 말할 때 두루 쓰는 중립적인 단어. husband/wife/boyfriend/girlfriend 를 모를 때 안전함.

senses.meaningEn: a person who owns a business together with someone else

examples.en: He and his business partner opened a café.
The two partners share the work.

senses.meaningEn: after a particular hour on the clock

examples.en: It's ten past eight.
The kids went to bed at half past nine.

senses.note: 분이 30 이하일 때 '분 past 시' 로 말한다(twenty past six = 6:20). 30 이 넘으면 to 를 쓴다(twenty to seven = 6:40). 미국식은 after 도 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: moving by or beyond a place

examples.en: Walk past the bank and turn left.
A bus just drove past us.
examples.ko: 버스 한 대가 방금 우리 옆을 지나갔어.

senses.note: go past / walk past / drive past 처럼 이동 동사와 짝을 이룬다. 동사 pass 의 과거형 passed 와 발음이 같아 글에서 헷갈리기 쉬움.

senses.meaningEn: the time before now

examples.en: In the past, people wrote letters by hand.
Let's forget the past and start again.

senses.note: the past(과거), the present(현재), the future(미래). 형용사로도 쓴다: the past week(지난 한 주), past tense(과거 시제).

senses.meaningEn: an Italian food made from flour and water, such as spaghetti

examples.en: I'm making pasta for dinner tonight.
This pasta needs more sauce.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: pastas (×), a pasta (×) → a plate of pasta, some pasta. spaghetti, penne, macaroni 가 모두 pasta 의 종류.

senses.meaningEn: a person who is getting medical care from a doctor

examples.en: The doctor sees about thirty patients a day.
examples.ko: 그 의사는 하루에 환자 30명 정도를 봐.

examples.en: Patients must wait here until their name is called.
examples.ko: 환자는 이름이 불릴 때까지 여기서 기다려야 해요.

senses.meaningEn: able to wait calmly without getting angry

examples.en: Please be patient. The bus will come soon.
examples.ko: 조금만 참아. 버스 곧 올 거야.

examples.en: My teacher is very patient with us.
examples.ko: 우리 선생님은 우리에게 아주 참을성이 많으셔.

senses.note: 명사 '환자'와 형용사 '참을성 있는'이 같은 철자. be patient with + 사람. 명사형 patience(인내).

senses.meaningEn: to give money for something you buy or use

examples.en: I'll pay for the coffee.
Did you pay the rent yet?

senses.note: pay for + 물건·서비스(pay for dinner), pay + 돈·요금(pay 10 dollars, pay the bill). 'pay the coffee' 는 틀림. 결제 수단: pay by card / in cash.

senses.meaningEn: the money you get for doing your job

examples.en: The pay is good, but the hours are long.
She got a pay raise last month.

senses.note: 불가산 명사. payday(월급날), pay raise(임금 인상), paycheck(급여, 급여 수표).

senses.meaningEn: physical education; the school subject where you do sports and exercise

examples.en: We played basketball in PE today.
Don't forget your PE uniform tomorrow.

senses.note: physical education 의 약자, 대문자 PE 로 쓰고 글자 하나씩 /피이/로 읽음. PE class = 체육 수업, PE teacher = 체육 선생님. 미국에서는 gym (class) 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: a soft round fruit with a fuzzy skin and a large seed inside

examples.en: I bought some peaches at the market.
Peaches are in season in the summer.

senses.note: 복수형은 peaches. 색을 말할 때도 peach(살구색·복숭아색)라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: a small nut with a soft brown shell that grows under the ground

examples.en: I'm allergic to peanuts.
Do you want peanut butter on your toast?

senses.note: peanut butter(땅콩버터)는 미국 가정의 기본 식품. 알레르기 표시에서 자주 보는 단어.

senses.meaningEn: a sweet fruit that is narrow at the top and wide at the bottom

examples.en: Would you like an apple or a pear?
Korean pears are big and very juicy.
examples.ko: 한국 배는 크고 아주 물이 많아.

senses.note: pair(한 쌍)와 발음이 같음. 한국 배는 Asian pear 또는 Korean pear 라고 구분해 부름.

senses.meaningEn: a tool with ink inside that you use to write

examples.en: Do you have a pen I can use?
examples.ko: 내가 쓸 수 있는 펜 있어?

examples.en: Please sign here with a black pen.

senses.note: 볼펜은 ballpoint pen 또는 그냥 pen. '볼펜' 그대로 ball pen 은 잘 안 씀. in pen = 펜으로. 사인펜은 marker.

senses.meaningEn: a thin wooden stick with a dark center used for writing or drawing

examples.en: Can I borrow a pencil, please?
Write your answers in pencil, not pen.

senses.note: in pencil = 연필로(관사 없음). pencil case = 필통, pencil sharpener = 연필깎이. 샤프펜슬은 mechanical pencil.

senses.meaningEn: a black and white sea bird that cannot fly but swims very well and lives in cold places

examples.en: Penguins can't fly, but they swim really well.
examples.ko: 펭귄은 날지 못하지만 수영은 정말 잘해.

examples.en: The penguins at the aquarium were so cute.

senses.note: 펭귄은 날지 못하는 새(bird). 발음은 '펭귄'보다 '펭그윈'(/ˈpeŋɡwɪn/)에 가까움. 펭귄은 뒤뚱뒤뚱 걷다 = waddle.

senses.meaningEn: persons in general; more than one person

examples.en: There were so many people at the mall.
Most people like to sleep in on Sundays.
examples.ko: 대부분의 사람들은 일요일에 늦잠 자는 걸 좋아해.

senses.note: people 은 이미 복수이므로 peoples, many peoples 라고 쓰지 않음. People are... (is 아님).

senses.meaningEn: all the persons who live in a country or belong to one group

examples.en: The Korean people love their food.
The president spoke to the people on TV.

senses.note: 이 뜻에서는 the people 로 쓰며, 여러 민족을 말할 때만 peoples 복수가 가능.

senses.meaningEn: a hot-tasting black or white powder used to add flavor to food

examples.en: Would you like some pepper on your salad?
Add salt and pepper to taste.

senses.note: 후추는 셀 수 없음: black pepper(검은 후추). 후추통은 pepper shaker, 후추 그라인더는 pepper mill.

senses.meaningEn: a hollow green, red, or yellow vegetable, or a small hot one used in spicy food

examples.en: I bought red and green peppers for the salad.
examples.ko: 샐러드용으로 빨간 피망과 초록 피망을 샀어.

examples.en: These little peppers are really spicy!

senses.note: 채소일 때는 셀 수 있음. 피망·파프리카는 bell pepper, 매운 고추는 chili pepper 또는 hot pepper. 한국어 '파프리카'는 영어로 bell pepper 라고 해야 통함.

senses.meaningEn: one human being

examples.en: She is a very kind person.
Only one person can sit here.
examples.ko: 여기엔 한 사람만 앉을 수 있어.

senses.note: 복수는 보통 people. persons 는 법률·공식 안내문에서만 (예: Maximum 4 persons).

senses.meaningEn: used in 'in person': by being there yourself, not by phone or online

examples.en: Let's meet in person next week.
You have to sign the paper in person.
examples.ko: 서류는 본인이 직접 와서 서명해야 해.

senses.note: in person = 직접, 대면으로. 온라인 회의와 대비할 때 자주 씀.

senses.meaningEn: an animal that you keep at home for company

examples.en: Do you have any pets at home?
My pet is a small white dog.

senses.note: pet shop(펫숍), pet food. 반려동물 주인은 pet owner.

senses.meaningEn: to touch an animal gently with your hand

examples.en: Can I pet your dog?
She petted the cat softly.

senses.note: 과거형은 t 를 겹쳐 petted. 사람을 쓰다듬을 때는 stroke 나 pat 을 더 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a device you use to call people, send messages, and go online

examples.en: I left my phone at home today.
Can I borrow your phone for a second?
examples.ko: 잠깐 네 폰 좀 빌려도 돼?

senses.note: cell phone(미) / mobile phone(영). 요즘은 phone 만 해도 스마트폰을 뜻함. on the phone = 통화 중. 한국어 "핸드폰(hand phone)"은 안 통함.

senses.meaningEn: to call someone on the phone

examples.en: Phone me when you get home.
I'll phone the restaurant and book a table.

senses.note: 미국에서는 call 이 더 흔함. phone to me (X) → phone me.

senses.meaningEn: to lift something from a surface

examples.en: Please pick up your toys from the floor.
He picked up the phone and said hello.
examples.ko: 그는 전화기를 들고 여보세요 라고 했어.

senses.meaningEn: to go and get someone in a car

examples.en: Can you pick me up at the station?
examples.ko: 역에서 나 좀 태워 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: I pick up my kids from school at three.

senses.note: pick + 사람 + up 순서로도 씀: pick me up. 반대는 drop off(내려 주다).

senses.meaningEn: to buy or collect something, often casually

examples.en: Could you pick up some bread on your way?
examples.ko: 오는 길에 빵 좀 사 올 수 있어?

examples.en: I need to pick up my package at the post office.

senses.meaningEn: to learn something easily without much effort

examples.en: Kids pick up new words very quickly.
examples.ko: 아이들은 새 단어를 아주 빨리 익혀.

examples.en: I picked up some Spanish while traveling.

senses.meaningEn: a meal that you eat outside, such as in a park

examples.en: Let's have a picnic in the park this Saturday.
We packed sandwiches for the picnic.

senses.note: have a picnic / go on a picnic. 한국어 '소풍'이 학교 행사면 school trip / field trip 이 더 맞음. picnic 은 야외에서 먹는 식사가 핵심.

senses.meaningEn: a drawing or painting

examples.en: My daughter drew a picture of our dog.
There's a big picture on the living room wall.
examples.ko: 거실 벽에 큰 그림이 걸려 있어.

senses.note: draw a picture = 그림을 그리다(색칠하는 그림은 paint). 그림 '속의' = in the picture.

senses.meaningEn: a photograph

examples.en: Can you take a picture of us, please?
examples.ko: 저희 사진 한 장 찍어 주실래요?

examples.en: I took a lot of pictures on my trip.

senses.note: take a picture = 사진을 찍다(make ✗). photo 와 거의 같은 뜻으로 일상에서 많이 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a baked dish with a pastry crust and a sweet or savory filling

examples.en: My mom makes the best apple pie.
Would you like a slice of pie?

senses.note: a slice of pie = 파이 한 조각. 단 것(apple pie)뿐 아니라 고기 파이(meat pie)도 있음. as easy as pie = 아주 쉬운.

senses.meaningEn: a part that is cut or broken from something bigger

examples.en: Would you like another piece of cake?
Cut the apple into small pieces.

senses.note: slice 는 얇게 '썬' 조각(피자·빵), piece 는 모양과 상관없는 조각 전체를 가리킨다. in pieces = 산산조각 난.

senses.meaningKo: (셀 수 없는 명사를 세는) 하나, 한 장
senses.meaningEn: one item of something you cannot count directly

examples.en: Can I have a piece of paper?
examples.ko: 종이 한 장 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: Let me give you a piece of advice.

senses.note: a piece of paper/furniture/advice/news/information 처럼 셀 수 없는 명사를 셀 때 쓴다. 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: an advice (X) → a piece of advice (O). 발음은 peace(평화)와 같다.

senses.meaningKo: 아주 쉬운 일, 식은 죽 먹기
senses.meaningEn: something that is very easy to do

examples.en: The test was a piece of cake.
Don't worry, fixing this is a piece of cake.
examples.ko: 걱정 마, 이거 고치는 건 아주 쉬워.

senses.note: 항상 a piece of cake 로 씀. 실제 케이크 한 조각이라는 뜻과 구별은 문맥으로.

senses.meaningEn: a farm animal with a fat body, short legs, and a curly tail

examples.en: The pigs are rolling in the mud.
My uncle keeps pigs and chickens on his farm.

senses.note: 돼지고기는 pork, 새끼 돼지는 piglet. 돼지 소리는 oink.

senses.meaningEn: a person who eats too much or is dirty and messy

examples.en: Don't be a pig and share the pizza.
I ate like a pig at the party last night.

senses.note: eat like a pig = 게걸스럽게 먹다. 친구 사이에 장난으로는 쓰지만 남에게 쓰면 무례함.

senses.meaningEn: a small round piece of medicine that you swallow

examples.en: Take one pill with a glass of water.
examples.ko: 알약 하나를 물 한 잔과 함께 먹어요.

examples.en: These pills are too big for me to swallow.
examples.ko: 이 알약은 너무 커서 삼키기 힘들어.

senses.note: take a pill(알약을 먹다). sleeping pill(수면제), vitamin pill. 비슷한 말 tablet(정제), capsule(캡슐).

senses.meaningEn: a soft object that you rest your head on in bed

examples.en: This pillow is too soft for me.
Can I get an extra pillow, please?
examples.ko: 베개 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

senses.note: 베갯잇은 pillowcase. 소파의 장식 쿠션은 cushion 또는 throw pillow.

senses.meaningEn: a large tropical fruit with a rough skin and sweet yellow flesh

examples.en: Do you like pineapple on pizza?
Fresh pineapple is hard to cut.

senses.note: 음식 재료로 말할 때는 셀 수 없는 명사처럼 pineapple 로 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a flat, round bread baked with tomato sauce, cheese, and other food on top

examples.en: Let's order a pizza tonight.
Can I have one more slice of pizza?
examples.ko: 피자 한 조각 더 먹어도 돼?

senses.note: 피자 한 판은 a pizza, 한 조각은 a slice of pizza. '피자 한 조각' 을 a piece 라고 해도 되지만 slice 가 더 자연스러움. 발음은 [핏자]에 가까움.

senses.meaningEn: a living thing that grows in the ground and has leaves and roots

examples.en: I water my plants every morning.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 아침 화초에 물을 줘.

examples.en: This plant needs a lot of sun.

senses.note: 집 안의 화분 식물은 houseplant. 식물에 '물을 주다'는 water a plant.

senses.meaningEn: to put a seed or young plant in the ground so it grows

examples.en: We planted a tree in the garden.
When do you plant tomatoes?

senses.meaningEn: a factory or a building where power is made

examples.en: My uncle works at a car plant.
There is a power plant near the river.

senses.note: power plant = 발전소. '식물'과 전혀 다른 뜻이니 문맥으로 구별.

senses.meaningEn: a flat round dish that you eat food from

examples.en: Can you put the plates on the table?
Be careful, that plate is hot.

senses.meaningEn: the food on a plate

examples.en: I'd like a plate of pasta, please.
He finished his whole plate in five minutes.
examples.ko: 그는 한 접시를 5분 만에 다 먹었어.

senses.note: a plate of pasta / fries. 평평한 접시에 담는 음식. 깊은 그릇은 bowl.

senses.meaningEn: to take part in a game or sport, or to have fun

examples.en: The kids are playing in the yard.
Do you want to play soccer after school?

senses.note: play soccer / play games. 구기 종목은 play, 수영·달리기는 go swimming / go running.

senses.meaningEn: to make music with an instrument

examples.en: She plays the piano really well.
I'm learning to play the guitar.

senses.note: 악기 앞에는 the: play the piano. 운동 앞에는 the 없음: play tennis.

senses.meaningEn: to make a song or video start

examples.en: Can you play that song again?
Press here to play the video.

senses.meaningEn: a story performed by actors in a theater

examples.en: We saw a play at the theater last night.
My daughter is in the school play.

senses.meaningEn: an outdoor area where children can play

examples.en: The kids are on the playground.
We played tag in the school playground.

senses.note: on the playground(미) / in the playground(영). 미끄럼틀·그네가 있는 놀이터와 학교 운동장 둘 다 가리킴.

senses.meaningEn: a small bag sewn into clothes for keeping small things

examples.en: I put my keys in my pocket.
This jacket has four pockets.

senses.note: pocket money = 용돈(영국식). 가방 주머니도 pocket. 한국어 '포켓'처럼 발음하지 말고 /ˈpɑːkɪt/ 로.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of writing in short lines that uses rhythm, sounds, and feelings

examples.en: We read a poem about spring in class.
examples.ko: 수업 시간에 봄에 관한 시를 읽었어.

examples.en: She wrote a poem for her mother.

senses.note: poem = 시 한 편(셀 수 있음), poetry = 시 장르 전체(셀 수 없음), poet = 시인. write/read/recite a poem.

senses.meaningEn: a small area of still water, smaller than a lake

examples.en: There are ducks in the pond.
My grandfather has a small fish pond.
examples.ko: 우리 할아버지는 작은 물고기 연못이 있어.

senses.note: lake 보다 훨씬 작은 물. 정원 연못 = garden pond, 물고기 연못 = fish pond.

senses.meaningEn: the meat from a pig

examples.en: Does this soup have pork in it?
We're grilling pork belly tonight.

senses.note: 동물은 pig, 고기는 pork. 셀 수 없는 명사. pork belly(삼겹살), pork cutlet(돈가스), pork chop(뼈 있는 등심).

senses.meaningEn: a round vegetable with brown or yellow skin that grows underground

examples.en: We're having potatoes with dinner tonight.
examples.ko: 오늘 저녁엔 감자를 같이 먹을 거야.

examples.en: Can you peel the potatoes for me?

senses.note: 복수형은 potatoes. sweet potato = 고구마. couch potato = 소파에서 TV만 보는 사람.

senses.meaningEn: to make a liquid flow out of a container

examples.en: Can you pour me some water?
Pour the milk into the cup slowly.

senses.note: pour A into B(A를 B에 붓다). pour someone a drink = 술/음료를 따라 주다. 발음은 /pɔːr/, poor(가난한)와 같은 소리.

senses.meaningEn: to rain very heavily

examples.en: It's pouring outside. Take an umbrella.
It poured all day yesterday.

senses.note: It's pouring. = 비가 퍼붓는다. 구어로 It's pouring down. 도 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: to do something again and again so you get better at it

examples.en: I practice the piano for an hour a day.
examples.ko: 나는 하루에 한 시간씩 피아노를 연습해.

examples.en: Let's practice speaking English together.

senses.note: practice + 명사/동사-ing (practice to speak ✗ → practice speaking). 미국은 동사·명사 모두 practice, 영국은 동사 practise.

senses.meaningEn: time spent doing an activity in order to get better

examples.en: I have soccer practice after school.
Practice makes perfect!

senses.note: soccer practice / piano practice = 축구 연습 / 피아노 연습. out of practice = 오래 안 해서 녹슨.

senses.meaningEn: something you give to someone on a special day

examples.en: I got a lot of presents for my birthday.
What should I buy her for a present?
examples.ko: 그녀에게 선물로 뭘 사 주면 좋을까?

senses.note: present 와 gift 는 거의 같음. gift 가 조금 더 격식적이고 gift card/gift shop 처럼 복합어에 많이 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: in a particular place

examples.en: Everyone is present today. Great!
All the family members were present at dinner.

senses.note: 출석 부를 때 Present! 또는 Here! 로 대답. be present at + 행사.

senses.meaningEn: the time that is happening now

examples.en: Let's forget the past and live in the present.
At present, I'm living with my parents.

senses.note: at present = 현재는(약간 격식). 문법의 '현재 시제' = present tense. 동사 present(발표하다)는 강세가 뒤로 감 /prɪˈzent/.

senses.meaningEn: pleasant to look at

examples.en: What a pretty dress you're wearing!
The flowers in the garden are so pretty.

senses.meaningEn: quite, fairly

examples.en: The test was pretty easy.
I'm pretty sure he's coming.

senses.note: pretty good = 꽤 좋다. 미국 구어에서 매우 자주 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: the amount of money you have to pay for something

examples.en: What's the price of this watch?
Prices are going up every year.

senses.note: 가격을 물을 때는 How much is it? 이 더 자연스러움. 가격이 '높다/낮다'는 high/low price (expensive/cheap price 는 어색). 가격표 = price tag.

senses.meaningEn: the person in charge of a school

examples.en: The principal gave a speech this morning.
examples.ko: 오늘 아침 교장 선생님이 연설을 하셨어.

examples.en: You have to go to the principal's office.

senses.note: 영국식은 headteacher / headmaster. 철자 혼동: principle(원칙)과 다름 — 교장은 '사람(pal)'이 들어간 principal.

senses.meaningEn: a large round orange vegetable with a thick skin

examples.en: We made pumpkin soup for dinner.
Kids carve pumpkins on Halloween.

senses.note: 한국의 애호박은 zucchini(미국식) 또는 Korean zucchini 라고 함. pumpkin pie 는 미국 추수감사절 대표 음식.

senses.meaningEn: a child who is being taught at school

examples.en: The pupils lined up outside the classroom.
She was the best pupil in her piano class.

senses.note: 영국식에서 어린 학생을 가리킴. 미국식에서는 거의 student 를 씀. '눈동자(pupil)'와 같은 철자.

senses.meaningEn: a young dog

examples.en: We got a new puppy last weekend.
The puppies are only six weeks old.

senses.note: 줄여서 pup 이라고도 함. 복수형은 puppies(y→ies). 한국어 '강아지'는 다 큰 개에게도 쓰지만 영어 puppy 는 어린 개에게만 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a bag that a woman carries for her money, keys, and small things

examples.en: She put her phone in her purse.
Don't leave your purse on the chair.

senses.note: 미국: purse = 핸드백(handbag 과 같음). 영국: purse = 여성용 지갑, 핸드백은 handbag. 한국어 '지갑'을 미국인에게 말할 땐 wallet 이 안전함.

senses.meaningEn: to place clothes or glasses on your body

examples.en: Put on your coat, it's cold outside.
Let me put my shoes on first.

senses.note: 입는 동작은 put on, 입고 있는 상태는 wear. I'm putting on a hat (동작) vs I'm wearing a hat (상태).

senses.meaningEn: to spread cream or makeup on your skin

examples.en: Don't forget to put on sunscreen.
She puts on makeup every morning.

senses.meaningEn: to gain weight

examples.en: I put on three kilos over the holidays.
He's putting on weight since he stopped running.
examples.ko: 그는 달리기를 그만둔 뒤로 살이 찌고 있어.

senses.note: put on weight = gain weight. 반대는 lose weight.

senses.meaningEn: one of four equal parts; fifteen minutes

examples.en: It's a quarter past nine.
I ate a quarter of the pizza.

senses.note: 시간 표현: a quarter past seven(7:15), a quarter to seven(6:45). 미국에서는 past 대신 after 도 많이 쓴다(a quarter after seven).

senses.meaningEn: a US coin worth twenty-five cents

examples.en: Do you have a quarter for the machine?
The gum costs two quarters.

senses.note: 미국 동전: penny(1¢), nickel(5¢), dime(10¢), quarter(25¢). 세탁소·자판기·주차 미터기에 자주 필요.

senses.meaningEn: a sentence that asks for information

examples.en: Can I ask you a question?
Raise your hand if you have a question.

senses.note: ask a question(질문하다) — question 자체를 동사로 쓰면 '의심하다·심문하다'. make a question ✗.

senses.meaningEn: a problem in a test that you must answer

examples.en: Question five was really hard.
Answer all the questions on this page.

senses.note: 시험 '문제'는 problem 보다 question 이 자연스러움(수학 계산 문제는 problem 도 씀).

senses.meaningEn: a short, simple test

examples.en: We have a short quiz every Monday.
I got nine out of ten on the quiz.

senses.note: 복수는 quizzes(z 두 개). pop quiz = 예고 없는 쪽지시험.

senses.meaningEn: a game where people answer questions for fun

examples.en: Let's do a quiz about animals!
My family loves TV quiz shows.
examples.ko: 우리 가족은 TV 퀴즈 쇼를 좋아해.

senses.note: quiz show = 퀴즈 프로그램. 한국어 '퀴즈'와 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: a small animal with long ears and a short tail that jumps and lives in holes

examples.en: A rabbit is eating the carrots in our garden.
examples.ko: 토끼가 우리 텃밭에서 당근을 먹고 있어.

examples.en: My little sister wants a pet rabbit.
examples.ko: 내 여동생은 애완 토끼를 갖고 싶어 해.

senses.note: bunny 는 아이들 말투의 '토끼'. 새끼 토끼는 kit 또는 bunny. 토끼는 hop(깡충 뛰다).

senses.meaningEn: a machine or broadcast that you listen to for music, news, and talk

examples.en: I listen to the radio in the car.
Turn on the radio, I love this song.
examples.ko: 라디오 켜 봐, 이 노래 정말 좋아.

senses.note: listen to the radio 처럼 the 를 붙임 (TV 와 다름). on the radio = 라디오에서.

senses.meaningEn: water that falls from the clouds in drops

examples.en: We got a lot of rain last night.
Don't go out in the rain without a coat.
examples.ko: 비 오는데 코트 없이 나가지 마.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: a rain ✗ → heavy rain(폭우), light rain(가벼운 비). in the rain = 비를 맞으며. rain check = 다음 기회에 하자는 약속.

senses.meaningEn: to fall from the sky as rain

examples.en: It's raining, so take an umbrella.
Is it going to rain tomorrow?

senses.note: 주어는 항상 it: It rains / It's raining / It rained. 한국식으로 Rain is coming 보다 It's going to rain 이 자연스러움. It's raining cats and dogs. = 비가 억수같이 온다.

senses.meaningEn: a curve of different colors in the sky after rain

examples.en: Look, there's a rainbow over the river!
We saw a beautiful rainbow after the rain.
examples.ko: 비 온 뒤에 예쁜 무지개를 봤어.

senses.note: 무지개가 뜨다 = a rainbow appears/comes out. 무지개 색 = the colors of the rainbow. 미국에서는 무지개가 7색이 아니라 ROYGBIV 로 외움.

senses.meaningEn: having a lot of rain

examples.en: It's a rainy day, so bring your umbrella.
July is the rainy season in Korea.

senses.note: rainy day(비 오는 날)는 형용사, It's raining(지금 비가 온다)은 동사. the rainy season = 장마철. save for a rainy day = 어려울 때를 위해 저축하다.

senses.meaningEn: to lift something to a higher position

examples.en: Raise your hand if you know the answer.
He raised the cup and took a sip.
examples.ko: 그는 컵을 들어 한 모금 마셨어.

senses.note: raise 는 '무엇을' 올리는 타동사(raise your hand). rise 는 '스스로' 오르는 자동사(The sun rises). 한국인이 가장 많이 혼동하는 짝.

senses.meaningEn: to take care of children or animals until they are grown

examples.en: My grandparents raised me.
They raise chickens on their farm.

senses.note: 미국식에서 아이를 '키우다'는 raise, 영국식은 bring up 을 더 씀. born and raised in Seoul = 서울에서 나고 자란.

senses.meaningEn: an increase in the money you are paid for your job

examples.en: I got a raise last month!
She asked her boss for a raise.
examples.ko: 그녀는 사장님에게 월급을 올려 달라고 했어.

senses.note: get a raise = 월급이 오르다(미국식). 영국식은 pay rise. 가격 인상은 price increase.

senses.meaningEn: an animal like a large mouse with a long tail, often found in dirty places

examples.en: I saw a huge rat near the trash cans.
examples.ko: 쓰레기통 근처에서 엄청 큰 쥐를 봤어.

examples.en: Rats can carry diseases, so be careful.
examples.ko: 쥐는 병을 옮길 수 있으니 조심해.

senses.note: mouse(생쥐)보다 크고 더 지저분한 인상. 비격식으로 '배신자, 밀고자'를 rat 이라고도 함. 발음 주의: rat /ræt/ 과 rot /rɑːt/ 구별.

senses.meaningEn: to look at words and understand what they mean

examples.en: I read a book before bed every night.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 밤 자기 전에 책을 읽어.

examples.en: Can you read this word for me?

senses.note: 과거형도 read 로 쓰지만 발음은 /red/(빨간색 red 와 같음). I read it yesterday /red/.

senses.meaningEn: to say written words aloud for someone else

examples.en: Dad reads to me every night.
examples.ko: 아빠는 매일 밤 나한테 책을 읽어 주셔.

examples.en: Read the sign out loud, please.

senses.note: read to someone = ~에게 읽어 주다. read aloud / read out loud = 소리 내어 읽다.

senses.meaningEn: to understand signs, numbers, or a map

examples.en: I can't read a map at all.
The thermometer reads 38 degrees.

senses.note: read a map = 지도를 보다, read music = 악보를 읽다. 기계가 주어이면 '~라고 표시하다'.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of paper that shows you have paid for something

examples.en: Would you like a receipt?
Keep the receipt in case you want to return it.
examples.ko: 반품할 수도 있으니 영수증 챙겨 둬.

senses.note: p 는 발음하지 않음 /rɪˈsiːt/. 환불·교환 시 꼭 필요. 영수증 '필요 없어요'는 No receipt, thanks.

senses.meaningEn: a large machine that keeps food and drinks cold

examples.en: Put the milk back in the refrigerator.
We need a bigger refrigerator for our new kitchen.
examples.ko: 새 주방에는 더 큰 냉장고가 필요해.

senses.note: 일상 대화에서는 거의 fridge 를 씀. refrigerator 는 매장·설명서 등 약간 격식 있는 말. 냉동실은 freezer.

senses.meaningEn: to keep something in your mind or bring it back to your mind

examples.en: Do you remember my name?
I can't remember where I put my keys.
examples.ko: 열쇠를 어디 뒀는지 기억이 안 나.

senses.note: remember + 동사-ing = ~했던 것을 기억하다(I remember meeting him.). 한국어 '기억이 나다'는 I remember 로 충분(It remembers ✗).

senses.meaningEn: to not forget to do something

examples.en: Remember to lock the door.
Did you remember to bring your homework?
examples.ko: 숙제 챙겨 오는 거 잊지 않았지?

senses.note: remember to + 동사 = 앞으로 할 일을 잊지 않다. remember + 동사-ing 와 뜻이 다르니 주의.

senses.meaningEn: to say or do something again

examples.en: Repeat after me: 'Nice to meet you.'
Could you repeat that, please?

senses.note: Could you repeat that? 는 못 들었을 때 가장 예의 바른 표현. repeat again 은 중복이므로 그냥 repeat. 영어 수업의 Repeat after me = 따라 하세요.

senses.meaningEn: to tell someone what another person said

examples.en: Don't repeat this to anyone.
I'm only repeating what she told me.
examples.ko: 나는 그냥 그녀가 한 말을 전하는 것뿐이야.

senses.note: repeat something to someone. 재방송은 a repeat(영) / a rerun(미).

senses.meaningEn: to stop working and relax or sleep for a while

examples.en: You should rest at home for a few days.
Let's rest here for a minute.

senses.meaningEn: a period of relaxing or sleeping

examples.en: Get some rest, you look tired.
The doctor said I need plenty of rest.

senses.note: get some rest / take a rest. 짧게 쉬는 '휴식 시간'은 break 가 더 자연스럽다.

senses.meaningEn: the other people or things that are left

examples.en: I'll eat the rest of the pizza later.
You go first, and the rest of us will follow.

senses.note: the rest of + 명사. 항상 the 를 붙인다.

senses.meaningEn: a place where you can buy and eat a meal

examples.en: There's a new Italian restaurant near my house.
examples.ko: 우리 집 근처에 새 이탈리안 식당이 생겼어.

examples.en: Let's eat at a restaurant tonight.

senses.note: 철자 주의: restaurant(u 와 a 의 순서). 한국어 '레스토랑'보다 뜻이 넓어서 분식집·백반집도 모두 restaurant.

senses.meaningEn: cooked rice grains eaten as a meal

examples.en: Would you like some more rice?
We eat rice with almost every meal.
examples.ko: 우리는 거의 매 끼니 밥을 먹어.

senses.note: 한국어는 '쌀'과 '밥'을 구분하지만 영어는 둘 다 rice. 익힌 밥을 강조하려면 cooked rice, steamed rice, a bowl of rice.

senses.meaningEn: the small white or brown grains that are cooked and eaten

examples.en: We need to buy a bag of rice.
Brown rice is healthier than white rice.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: rices (×). 단위로 셀 때는 a bag of rice, a cup of rice.

senses.meaningEn: correct or true

examples.en: That's the right answer. Good job!
You're right, we should leave early.

senses.meaningEn: on the side of your body that is toward the east when you face north

examples.en: The bank is on your right.
I hurt my right hand yesterday.

senses.meaningEn: exactly or immediately

examples.en: Wait here. I'll be right back.
The store is right next to the station.
examples.ko: 그 가게는 역 바로 옆에 있어.

senses.note: right now = 지금 당장, right here = 바로 여기, right away = 즉시.

senses.meaningEn: to make the sound of a bell, or to press a doorbell

examples.en: The phone is ringing. Can you get it?
Someone rang the doorbell a minute ago.

senses.note: ring the doorbell = 초인종을 누르다. 영국에서는 ring = 전화하다(call)로도 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a small circle of metal worn on a finger

examples.en: She wears a gold ring on her left hand.
I lost my ring somewhere in the house.

senses.note: wedding ring = 결혼반지. 반지는 wear(끼다), 손가락에 put on.

senses.meaningEn: a large natural stream of water that flows to the sea

examples.en: The Han River runs through Seoul.
Let's have a picnic by the river.

senses.note: 강 이름은 the Han River 처럼 the + 이름 + River. 강가는 by the river / riverside.

senses.meaningEn: a large piece of stone, or the hard material of the earth

examples.en: Be careful, the rocks are wet and slippery.
We sat on a big rock and had lunch.
examples.ko: 우리는 큰 바위에 앉아서 점심을 먹었어.

senses.note: 미국에서는 작은 돌도 흔히 rock 이라고 함(영국은 stone). 암석 재료는 불가산.

senses.meaningEn: a kind of loud popular music with guitars and drums

examples.en: My brother listens to rock all the time.
examples.ko: 우리 형은 항상 록 음악을 들어.

examples.en: They play in a rock band on weekends.

senses.note: rock music / rock band / rock star. 동사 rock 은 '흔들다'(rock the baby).

senses.meaningEn: the top part of a building or a car that covers it

examples.en: The roof is leaking when it rains.
There's a cat sitting on the roof.

senses.note: 안쪽에서 보는 '천장'은 ceiling, 바깥쪽 꼭대기는 roof. 복수형은 roofs(rooves 는 옛 형태). a roof over your head = 살 곳.

senses.meaningEn: a part of a building with its own walls, floor, and door

examples.en: Go to your room and clean it up.
This room is too small for a party.

senses.note: 호텔에서는 a single room / a double room. 방 번호는 room 302 처럼 말함.

senses.meaningEn: empty space that you can use

examples.en: Is there room for one more person?
examples.ko: 한 사람 더 탈 자리 있어?

examples.en: Make some room for the cake in the fridge.
examples.ko: 냉장고에 케이크 넣을 자리 좀 만들어.

senses.note: 이 뜻일 때는 불가산(a room ✗). room for ~ = ~할 공간/여지. There's room for improvement = 개선의 여지가 있다.

senses.meaningEn: a person you share a room, apartment, or house with

examples.en: My roommate is from Canada.
I'm looking for a new roommate.

senses.note: 미국에서는 같은 집에 살면 방이 달라도 roommate 라고 함. 영국은 flatmate.

senses.meaningEn: the part of a plant that grows under the ground

examples.en: The roots of this tree are very long.
Carrots are roots that we can eat.
examples.ko: 당근은 우리가 먹을 수 있는 뿌리야.

senses.meaningEn: where a person or their family comes from

examples.en: My roots are in a small town in Busan.
She went back to Korea to find her roots.
examples.ko: 그녀는 뿌리를 찾기 위해 한국에 돌아갔어.

senses.note: 이 뜻은 보통 복수 roots 로 씀. the root of the problem = 문제의 근본 원인.

senses.meaningEn: a flower with a sweet smell and sharp points on its stem

examples.en: He gave me a red rose on my birthday.
examples.ko: 그가 내 생일에 빨간 장미 한 송이를 줬어.

examples.en: The roses in the garden smell wonderful.

senses.note: 장미 꽃다발 = a bunch of roses. 장미 가시 = thorn. 참고: rose 는 동사 rise(오르다)의 과거형이기도 함(The sun rose at six).

senses.meaningEn: a statement about what you must or must not do

examples.en: The first rule is: no phones in class.
examples.ko: 첫 번째 규칙은 수업 중에 휴대폰 금지야.

examples.en: You have to follow the rules of the game.

senses.note: follow/break a rule = 규칙을 지키다/어기다. against the rules = 규칙 위반. as a rule = 보통, 대개.

senses.meaningEn: to have power over a country or people and control them

examples.en: The king ruled the country for forty years.
Who rules this island?

senses.note: ruler 는 '통치자'와 '(길이 재는) 자' 두 뜻이 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a long flat tool with marks on it, used for measuring or drawing straight lines

examples.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
My ruler is thirty centimeters long.

senses.note: '지배자(통치자)'라는 뜻도 있지만 학교에서는 자. 미국은 inch 자가 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: a cold dish of raw vegetables, often with a sauce on top

examples.en: I'll just have a salad for lunch.
Would you like soup or salad with your meal?
examples.ko: 식사에 수프와 샐러드 중 어느 걸 드릴까요?

senses.note: 샐러드에 뿌리는 소스는 dressing 이라고 함. 식당에서는 흔히 soup or salad? 라고 물음. 발음은 [샐러드]보다 [쌜러드]에 가까움.

senses.meaningEn: a time when a store sells things at lower prices than usual

examples.en: The shoes were on sale, so I got two pairs.
examples.ko: 신발이 세일 중이어서 두 켤레 샀어.

examples.en: There's a big sale at the mall this weekend.
examples.ko: 이번 주말에 쇼핑몰에서 큰 세일을 해.

senses.note: on sale = 세일 중(미국식). for sale = 판매 중(팔려고 내놓은). 두 표현 혼동 주의. clearance sale = 재고 정리 세일.

senses.meaningEn: the act of selling something, or the amount sold

examples.en: The sale of the house took three months.
examples.ko: 집을 파는 데 석 달이 걸렸어.

examples.en: Sales were good this month.

senses.note: 복수 sales 는 '매출' 또는 '영업(부서)'. sales clerk = 판매 직원.

senses.meaningEn: a white substance that you add to food to make it taste better

examples.en: Could you pass the salt, please?
This soup needs a little more salt.
examples.ko: 이 국은 소금이 조금 더 필요해.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: a pinch of salt(소금 한 꼬집). salt and pepper 는 항상 이 순서로 말함. 형용사는 salty(짠).

senses.meaningEn: to add salt to food
