examples.en: Salt the water before you add the pasta.
examples.ko: 파스타 넣기 전에 물에 소금을 넣어.

examples.en: Don't forget to salt the meat.
examples.ko: 고기에 소금 치는 거 잊지 마.

senses.note: season(양념하다)보다 소금만 넣는 동작을 구체적으로 말할 때 씀.

senses.meaningEn: tasting of salt or containing a lot of salt

examples.en: The soup is a bit too salty.
I love salty snacks like chips.
examples.ko: 나는 감자칩 같은 짠 간식을 좋아해.

senses.note: salt(소금) + y. 음식이 '싱겁다'는 bland 또는 It needs more salt.

senses.meaningEn: very small pieces of rock found on beaches and in deserts

examples.en: The sand is too hot to walk on.
examples.ko: 모래가 너무 뜨거워서 걸을 수 없어.

examples.en: We built a castle out of sand.

senses.note: 불가산명사(a sand ✗). 모래성 = sandcastle, 모래사장 = sandy beach, 모래밭 놀이터 = sandbox.

senses.meaningEn: light open shoes held on the foot by straps, worn in warm weather

examples.en: I wear sandals in the summer.
She lost a sandal at the beach.
examples.ko: 그녀는 해변에서 샌들 한 짝을 잃어버렸어.

senses.note: a pair of sandals. 발가락 사이에 끼우는 슬리퍼형은 flip-flops. 한국어 '슬리퍼'는 집에서 신는 slippers 와 구별.

senses.meaningEn: two pieces of bread with food such as meat or cheese between them

examples.en: I made a ham and cheese sandwich for lunch.
Do you want half of my sandwich?

senses.note: 발음은 [샌드위치]보다 [쌘위치]에 가깝게, d 는 거의 들리지 않음. 복수형은 sandwiches.

senses.meaningEn: the day of the week after Friday and before Sunday

examples.en: Are you free this Saturday?
I sleep late on Saturdays.

senses.note: this/next/last Saturday 앞에는 on 을 쓰지 않는다. on Saturdays = 토요일마다(습관). 철자에 주의: Sat-ur-day.

senses.meaningEn: a thick liquid that you put on food to give it more flavor

examples.en: Can I get some extra sauce on the side?
examples.ko: 소스 좀 따로 더 주실 수 있어요?

examples.en: This tomato sauce is a little too sweet.
examples.ko: 이 토마토 소스는 조금 너무 달아.

senses.note: 보통 셀 수 없음. soy sauce(간장), hot sauce(매운 소스), on the side(따로 담아서). 한국어 '소스'와 달리 영어에서는 ketchup, mayo 는 보통 sauce 라고 부르지 않고 condiment 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: to keep money instead of spending it, or to spend less of it

examples.en: I'm saving money for a trip to Japan.
examples.ko: 일본 여행 가려고 돈을 모으고 있어.

examples.en: You can save ten dollars with this coupon.

senses.note: save (up) for + 목표. save money/time/energy = 돈·시간·에너지를 아끼다. 은행 저축 계좌는 savings account.

senses.meaningEn: to stop someone or something from being hurt or lost

examples.en: The doctor saved her life.
Wear a seatbelt. It could save your life.
examples.ko: 안전벨트 매. 목숨을 구할 수도 있어.

senses.note: save a life(생명을 구하다), save the planet(지구를 지키다).

senses.meaningEn: to keep something so you can use it later

examples.en: Save me a seat, please.
Don't forget to save the file before you leave.
examples.ko: 가기 전에 파일 저장하는 거 잊지 마.

senses.note: save some for later(나중을 위해 남겨 두다), save a seat(자리를 맡다). 컴퓨터의 '저장'도 save.

senses.meaningEn: to speak words

examples.en: What did you say? I didn't hear you.
She said she was tired.

senses.note: say + 말한 내용(say hello, say sorry). 듣는 사람을 붙일 때는 say to me(say me ✗). tell 은 사람이 목적어: tell me.

senses.meaningEn: to give information in writing

examples.en: The sign says 'No Parking'.
What does the text message say?

senses.note: 책·시계·표지판이 주어일 때 '~라고 되어 있다'. My watch says 3:00. = 내 시계는 3시를 가리켜.

senses.meaningEn: used to suggest an example or possibility

examples.en: Let's meet at, say, six o'clock.
Say you win the lottery. What would you buy?
examples.ko: 네가 복권에 당첨됐다고 쳐. 뭘 살 거야?

senses.note: 구어에서 '예컨대, ~라고 하자'. Let's say... 로도 자주 씀. 발음: says /sez/, said /sed/ (세이즈 ✗).

senses.meaningEn: a piece of cloth worn around the neck or head to keep warm or look nice

examples.en: She wrapped a scarf around her neck.
I bought two scarves for my sisters.
examples.ko: 언니들한테 줄 스카프를 두 개 샀어.

senses.note: 복수형은 scarves(scarfs 도 쓰이지만 덜 흔함). 한국어 '머플러'는 영어에서 자동차 배기관(muffler)이라 통하지 않음 — 목도리는 scarf.

senses.meaningEn: a plan that shows when things will happen

examples.en: What's your schedule like this week?
The bus schedule changed yesterday.

senses.note: 미국식 발음은 '스케줄', 영국식은 '셰줄'(/ˈʃedjuːl/). on schedule = 예정대로, behind schedule = 예정보다 늦게. 학교 시간표는 미국에서 class schedule.

senses.meaningEn: to plan for something to happen at a certain time

examples.en: I scheduled a dentist appointment for Monday.
The meeting is scheduled for 3 p.m.

senses.note: be scheduled for + 시간/날짜. reschedule = 일정을 다시 잡다.

senses.meaningEn: a place where children go to learn

examples.en: I walk to school every morning.
My school has a big playground.

senses.note: go to school(학생으로 다니다)은 관사 없이. 건물 자체를 말할 때는 the school.

senses.meaningEn: the time during the day when lessons take place

examples.en: What time does school finish today?
Let's play soccer after school.

senses.note: after school = 방과 후. school is out = 방학이다/수업이 끝났다.

senses.meaningEn: the outdoor area around a school where students play

examples.en: The students lined up in the schoolyard.
We used to play soccer in the schoolyard.
examples.ko: 우리는 학교 운동장에서 축구를 하곤 했어.

senses.note: 주로 미국식. 학교 건물 주변의 야외 공간 전체를 가리키며, playground 는 놀이 기구가 있는 곳에 더 가까움.

senses.meaningEn: the study of nature and the world, done by testing and watching

examples.en: We did a fun experiment in science class.
My sister wants to be a science teacher.
examples.ko: 우리 누나는 과학 선생님이 되고 싶어 해.

senses.note: science class(과학 수업), science fair(과학 전시회). 과학자는 scientist, 형용사는 scientific.

senses.meaningEn: a tool with two blades, used for cutting paper or cloth

examples.en: Where are the scissors?
Cut along the line with your scissors.

senses.note: 항상 복수형(scissors are...). 한 개는 a scissor ✗ → a pair of scissors.

senses.meaningEn: the number of points someone gets in a test or game

examples.en: My test score was 85 out of 100.
What was the final score of the game?

senses.note: a high/low score. 시험 점수는 score, 등급은 grade. 경기 스코어는 2 to 1 처럼 말함.

senses.meaningEn: to get a point or goal in a game

examples.en: He scored two goals in the second half.
Who scored first in the game?

senses.note: score a goal(골을 넣다), score a point(점수를 내다). 시험에서 '90점 받다'도 score 90.

senses.meaningEn: the salt water that covers most of the earth

examples.en: I love swimming in the sea.
examples.ko: 나는 바다에서 수영하는 게 정말 좋아.

examples.en: Our hotel room has a view of the sea.

senses.note: 보통 the sea. 바닷가로 놀러 간다는 go to the beach 가 더 자연스러움(go to the sea 는 어색). 해산물 = seafood, 바다 쪽 = by the sea.

senses.meaningEn: one of the four parts of the year: spring, summer, fall, and winter

examples.en: Which season do you like best?
Korea has four clear seasons.

senses.note: the four seasons = 사계절. the rainy season = 장마(철).

senses.meaningEn: the time of year when a sport or activity happens, or one set of TV episodes

examples.en: The baseball season starts in April.
I watched all three seasons in one week.
examples.ko: 나는 세 시즌을 일주일 만에 다 봤어.

senses.note: 한국어 '시즌'과 거의 같게 쓰인다. in season = 제철인(과일·채소), out of season = 제철이 아닌/비수기의.

senses.meaningEn: one of the sixty parts of a minute

examples.en: He ran 100 meters in eleven seconds.
Hold the button for three seconds.

senses.note: 구어에서 '잠깐'이라는 뜻으로도 많이 씀: Just a second. / Give me a sec.

senses.meaningEn: coming after the first one

examples.en: Our office is on the second floor.
This is my second cup of coffee today.

senses.note: 서수: first, second, third. 미국에서 second floor 는 한국의 2층과 같지만, 영국에서는 3층(ground floor 가 1층). second hand = 중고의(secondhand).

senses.meaningEn: in the position after the first

examples.en: She came second in the race.
First, mix the eggs. Second, add the flour.
examples.ko: 먼저 달걀을 섞고, 두 번째로 밀가루를 넣어.

senses.note: 순서를 설명할 때 First, … Second, … Finally, … 로 이어 말한다. come/finish second = 2위를 하다.

senses.meaningEn: the small hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows

examples.en: Put the seeds in the soil and water them.
These apple seeds are very small.

senses.note: 수박·사과처럼 작은 씨는 seed, 복숭아처럼 큰 씨는 pit/stone. sunflower seeds = 해바라기씨(간식).

senses.meaningEn: to give something to someone in exchange for money

examples.en: I sold my old bike for fifty dollars.
Does this store sell phone chargers?

senses.note: sell A to B = B에게 A를 팔다. sell for + 가격. 과거형 sold 는 '매진'에도 씀: sold out. '잘 팔린다'는 It sells well.

senses.meaningEn: one of the two halves of a school or college year

examples.en: The new semester starts in March.
I'm taking five classes this semester.

senses.note: semester = 1년 2학기제의 '학기'. 미국은 보통 fall semester(가을 학기)와 spring semester(봄 학기). 영국식 term 은 3학기제. 방학은 break/vacation.

senses.meaningEn: a group of words that expresses a complete idea, ending with a period

examples.en: Make a sentence with the word 'happy'.
Read the first sentence out loud.
examples.ko: 첫 문장을 소리 내서 읽어 봐.

senses.note: a sentence 는 대문자로 시작하고 마침표로 끝남. '문장'은 sentence, '글/본문'은 text, '글 한 단락'은 paragraph.

senses.meaningEn: a punishment given by a judge in court

examples.en: He got a two-year prison sentence.
The judge gave her a light sentence.

senses.note: 뉴스에서 자주 들리는 뜻. life sentence = 종신형, death sentence = 사형. 동사로도 쓰임(be sentenced to 3 years).

senses.meaningEn: the ninth month of the year

examples.en: The weather gets cooler in September.
Chuseok is in September this year.

senses.note: 미국·영국은 보통 9월에 새 학년이 시작된다. 줄임말 Sept. 또는 Sep. 가운데 음절에 강세.

senses.meaningEn: the number 7

examples.en: There are seven days in a week.
Dinner is at seven, so don't be late.

senses.note: 서수는 seventh(7th). seventeen(17), seventy(70). 서양에서 7은 행운의 숫자(lucky seven). 편의점 이름 7-Eleven 도 seven.

senses.meaningEn: the number 17

examples.en: My cousin is seventeen and in high school.
Our flight leaves from gate seventeen.

senses.note: sevenTEEN(17) vs SEVenty(70). 서수는 seventeenth(17th).

senses.meaningEn: the number 70

examples.en: My grandmother is seventy, but she still works.
The speed limit here is seventy.

senses.note: SEVenty(70) vs sevenTEEN(17). 미국 고속도로 제한 속도는 보통 마일 단위로 65~70. the seventies = 1970년대.

senses.meaningEn: the dark shape made when something blocks the light

examples.en: My shadow is very long in the evening.
The cat was scared of its own shadow.

senses.note: shadow 는 물체 모양의 '그림자', shade 는 그늘(시원한 곳). sit in the shade = 그늘에 앉다.

senses.meaningEn: a large sea fish with sharp teeth that can be dangerous

examples.en: Are there sharks in this water?
The shark swam right under our boat.
examples.ko: 상어가 우리 배 바로 밑으로 지나갔어.

senses.note: shark fin(상어 지느러미), shark attack(상어 공격). 비격식으로 '남을 속여 돈을 뜯는 사람'(loan shark = 고리대금업자)을 뜻하기도 함. 발음 주의: shark /ʃɑːrk/ 와 shock /ʃɑːk/.

senses.meaningEn: a farm animal with a thick woolly coat, kept for its wool and meat

examples.en: There are hundreds of sheep on that hill.
examples.ko: 저 언덕에 양이 수백 마리 있어.

examples.en: I can't sleep, so I'm counting sheep.
examples.ko: 잠이 안 와서 양을 세고 있어.

senses.note: 단수·복수 모두 sheep(sheeps 는 틀림). 새끼 양은 lamb, 양고기도 lamb, 양털은 wool. count sheep = 잠들려고 양을 세다.

senses.meaningEn: a flat board on a wall or in a cupboard where you put things

examples.en: Put the books back on the shelf, please.
examples.ko: 책들을 다시 선반에 올려 놔 줘.

examples.en: The cups are on the top shelf.

senses.note: 복수형 shelves. 책장 전체는 bookshelf / bookcase. 가게 진열대도 shelf: on the shelves = 진열 중.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of clothing with sleeves and buttons worn on the top half of the body

examples.en: He wore a white shirt and a blue tie.
examples.ko: 그는 흰 셔츠에 파란 넥타이를 했어.

examples.en: This shirt is too big for me.

senses.note: 한국어 '와이셔츠'는 dress shirt. 단추 없는 상의는 top 이라고 두루 부름.

senses.meaningEn: things you wear on your feet, usually made of leather or cloth

examples.en: Please take off your shoes at the door.
I need new shoes for school.
examples.ko: 학교 갈 때 신을 새 신발이 필요해.

senses.note: 보통 복수형, a pair of shoes. 신다/벗다 = put on / take off. 신발 가게는 shoe store(단수형으로 수식).

senses.meaningEn: a small building or room where you can buy things

examples.en: There's a little coffee shop on the corner.
The shop closes at nine tonight.

senses.note: 영국에서는 shop, 미국에서는 store 를 더 많이 씀. 미국에서 shop 은 coffee shop, gift shop 처럼 작은 전문점에 주로 붙음.

senses.meaningEn: to go to shops and buy things

examples.en: I usually shop for food on Saturdays.
We went shopping at the mall yesterday.

senses.note: '쇼핑하러 가다'는 go shopping. shop for + 물건(식료품 등을 사다). 온라인은 shop online.

senses.meaningEn: a list of the things you need to buy at a store

examples.en: Did you bring the shopping list?
Add milk and eggs to the shopping list.

senses.note: 식료품만 살 때는 grocery list 라고도 함. '쇼핑 목록에 올리다'는 put/add ~ on the list.

senses.meaningEn: having less than average height

examples.en: I'm a little short, so I can't reach the top shelf.
examples.ko: 내가 키가 좀 작아서 맨 위 칸에 손이 안 닿아.

examples.en: My sister is shorter than me.

senses.note: 키가 작다는 short, small 이 아니다. small 은 몸집이 작다는 뜻에 가깝다.

senses.meaningEn: small in length or lasting only a little time

examples.en: She has short hair now.
It's just a short walk to the station.

senses.note: short break(짧은 휴식), short answer(짧은 대답), for short(줄여서) 등으로 자주 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: short pants that end above the knee

examples.en: It's hot, so I'm wearing shorts today.
He plays basketball in shorts and a t-shirt.
examples.ko: 그는 반바지에 티셔츠 입고 농구를 해.

senses.note: 항상 복수형, a pair of shorts. 미국에서는 남성용 사각 속옷도 (boxer) shorts 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: one of the two parts of your body between your neck and your arms

examples.en: My shoulders are sore from carrying the bag.
He tapped me on the shoulder.

senses.note: 보통 복수 shoulders. 어깨를 으쓱하다 = shrug your shoulders. 발음은 '쇼울더'(l 소리 약함).

senses.meaningEn: washing your body under running water

examples.en: I take a shower every morning.
Can I have a quick shower first?

senses.note: 샤워하다 take a shower(미국) / have a shower(영국). do a shower 는 틀림. 샤워기 자체도 shower.

senses.meaningEn: a short period of rain

examples.en: There will be showers this afternoon.
Take an umbrella, we might get a shower.
examples.ko: 우산 가져가, 소나기 올 수도 있어.

senses.note: 날씨 예보에서 showers(복수)로 자주 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: not well; having an illness

examples.en: I can't come to work today. I'm sick.
She was sick for a whole week.

senses.note: 미국에서 '아프다'의 가장 일반적인 말. get sick(병나다), call in sick(아파서 못 간다고 연락하다), sick day(병가).

senses.meaningKo: 속이 안 좋은, 토할 것 같은
senses.meaningEn: feeling like you are going to vomit

examples.en: I feel sick on long bus rides.
examples.ko: 버스 오래 타면 속이 안 좋아.

examples.en: He got sick after eating the old fish.

senses.note: feel sick = 토할 것 같다, be sick(영국) = 토하다. carsick(차멀미), seasick(배멀미).

senses.meaningEn: bored with or annoyed by something because it has happened too much

examples.en: I'm sick of this rainy weather.
examples.ko: 이 비 오는 날씨 정말 지겨워.

examples.en: We're sick of eating the same lunch.

senses.note: be sick of + 명사/-ing. 강조하면 sick and tired of.

senses.meaningEn: easy to understand or do, without many parts

examples.en: The rules of the game are simple.
Let me explain it in simple words.

senses.note: easy 는 '힘이 안 든다', simple 은 '복잡하지 않다'에 초점. It's simple. = 간단해. keep it simple = 단순하게 해.

senses.meaningEn: plain, without extra decoration or anything special

examples.en: She wore a simple black dress.
We had a simple dinner of rice and soup.
examples.ko: 우리는 밥과 국으로 소박한 저녁을 먹었어.

senses.note: simple life = 소박한 삶. 사람에게 simple 을 쓰면 '단순한, 머리가 좋지 않은'으로 들릴 수 있어 주의.

senses.meaningEn: from a time in the past until now

examples.en: I've lived here since 2020.
She has been sick since Monday.

senses.note: since + 시작 시점(since Monday), for + 기간(for three days). 보통 현재완료(have + p.p.)와 함께 쓴다. '언제부터' 를 from 으로 쓰면 '지금까지' 의 뜻이 약해지니 since 가 자연스러움. ever since = 그때부터 줄곧.

senses.meaningEn: because; as

examples.en: Since it's raining, let's stay home.
I'll drive, since you're tired.

senses.note: because 보다 가볍고 '상대도 이미 아는 이유' 를 댈 때 쓴다. 문장 앞에 자주 온다. 시간의 since 와 헷갈리지 않도록 문맥을 본다.

senses.meaningEn: a large bowl fixed to a wall or counter with taps for washing

examples.en: Put the dirty dishes in the sink.
The bathroom sink is leaking again.

senses.note: kitchen sink(싱크대), bathroom sink(세면대). 둘 다 sink 로 부름.

senses.meaningEn: to go down below the surface of water

examples.en: The boat started to sink in the storm.
Heavy things sink to the bottom.

senses.note: sink - sank - sunk. 반대말 float(떠 있다).

senses.meaningEn: a polite way to speak to a man whose name you do not know

examples.en: Can I help you, sir?
Excuse me, sir, you dropped your wallet.

senses.note: 가게·식당·공항 직원이 남성 고객에게 쓰는 말. 친구나 아는 사람에게는 쓰지 않음. 여성에게는 ma'am.

senses.meaningEn: a word used at the start of a formal letter to a man

examples.en: Dear Sir, I am writing about my order.
examples.ko: 귀하, 제 주문 건으로 글을 드립니다.

examples.en: Dear Sir or Madam, I have a question.

senses.note: 받는 사람 이름을 모를 때 Dear Sir or Madam. 이름을 알면 Dear Mr. Kim 이 더 좋음.

senses.meaningEn: a girl or woman who has the same parents as you

examples.en: My sister is two years older than me.
examples.ko: 우리 언니는 나보다 두 살 많아.

examples.en: I share a room with my little sister.

senses.note: 영어는 언니/누나/여동생을 구분하지 않음. 필요하면 older sister / younger (little) sister.

senses.meaningEn: to rest with your weight on your bottom, as on a chair

examples.en: Please sit down and relax.
We sat by the window and talked.

senses.note: sit down = (동작) 앉다, be sitting = (상태) 앉아 있다. Have a seat. / Take a seat. 가 Sit down. 보다 부드러운 표현.

senses.meaningEn: to take an exam

examples.en: I'm sitting a math test tomorrow.
She sat the exam last week.

senses.note: sit an exam 은 주로 영국식. 미국에서는 take a test / take an exam 이 일반적.

senses.meaningEn: the number 6

examples.en: I usually wake up at six.
A pack of six eggs, please.
examples.ko: 달걀 여섯 개짜리 한 팩 주세요.

senses.note: 서수는 sixth(6th). sixteen(16), sixty(60). sex 와 발음이 비슷해지지 않도록 /ɪ/를 짧고 또렷하게.

senses.meaningEn: the number 16

examples.en: You can drive at sixteen in some states.
examples.ko: 미국 일부 주에서는 열여섯 살에 운전할 수 있어.

examples.en: There are sixteen students in my class.
examples.ko: 우리 반에는 학생이 열여섯 명 있어.

senses.note: sixTEEN(16) vs SIXty(60). 미국에서 16세 생일(sweet sixteen)은 특별히 크게 축하하는 문화가 있음.

senses.meaningEn: the number 60

examples.en: An hour has sixty minutes.
My grandfather is sixty years old.

senses.note: SIXty(60) vs sixTEEN(16). 1분 = sixty seconds, 1시간 = sixty minutes. 서수는 sixtieth(60th).

senses.meaningEn: one of the standard measurements that clothes or shoes are made in

examples.en: What size do you wear?
Do you have this shirt in a bigger size?
examples.ko: 이 셔츠 더 큰 사이즈 있어요?

senses.note: 사이즈를 물을 때 What size are you? 도 자연스러움. 신발은 shoe size, 옷은 그냥 size. try on(입어 보다)과 같이 자주 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: how big or small something is

examples.en: The two rooms are about the same size.
Look at the size of that dog!

senses.note: the size of ~ = ~의 크기. '크기가 어느 정도예요?'는 How big is it? 이 더 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: the outer layer that covers your body

examples.en: My skin gets very dry in winter.
This cream is good for sensitive skin.

senses.note: dry skin(건성), oily skin(지성), sensitive skin(민감성). skin care(피부 관리).

senses.meaningEn: the outer layer of a fruit, vegetable, or animal

examples.en: You can eat the skin of an apple.
I don't like chicken skin.

senses.note: 바나나·오렌지처럼 두꺼운 껍질은 peel, 견과류·달걀 껍질은 shell.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of clothing for women and girls that hangs from the waist

examples.en: She wore a long skirt to the party.
examples.ko: 그녀는 파티에 긴 치마를 입고 갔어.

examples.en: This skirt goes well with your boots.
examples.ko: 이 치마는 네 부츠랑 잘 어울려.

senses.note: shirt(셔츠)와 발음이 비슷하니 /skɜːrt/ 의 k 를 분명히. mini skirt, long skirt.

senses.meaningEn: the space above the earth where you see clouds, the sun, and stars

examples.en: The sky is really blue today.
There's not a cloud in the sky.

senses.note: 보통 the sky. 복수 skies 는 날씨 표현에서: clear skies(맑은 하늘), sunny skies. sky blue = 하늘색. The sky's the limit. = 한계가 없다.

senses.meaningEn: to rest with your eyes closed and your mind not awake

examples.en: I slept for nine hours last night.
Did you sleep well?

senses.note: go to bed(자러 가다)와 fall asleep(잠들다), sleep(자는 상태)을 구분. 과거형 slept.

senses.meaningEn: the state of resting with your eyes closed

examples.en: I didn't get enough sleep this week.
examples.ko: 이번 주에 잠을 충분히 못 잤어.

examples.en: A good night's sleep will help.
examples.ko: 밤에 푹 자면 도움이 될 거야.

senses.note: get enough sleep = 충분히 자다. go to sleep = 잠들다.

senses.meaningEn: feeling that you want to sleep

examples.en: I always get sleepy after lunch.
The baby is sleepy, so let's put her to bed.

senses.note: tired(피곤한)와 구분: sleepy 는 잠이 오는 상태. feel / get sleepy. 졸음운전 = drowsy driving.

senses.meaningEn: one thin, triangle-shaped piece cut from a pizza

examples.en: Can I have one more slice of pizza?
examples.ko: 피자 한 조각 더 먹어도 돼?

examples.en: A slice of pizza costs three dollars here.

senses.note: slice 는 얇게 '썬' 조각: a slice of pizza/bread/cheese/cake. 미국에서는 피자를 조각 단위(by the slice)로도 판다. 피자 한 판은 a whole pizza 또는 a pie(뉴욕식).

senses.meaningEn: thin in an attractive way

examples.en: You look so slim in that dress.
examples.ko: 그 드레스 입으니까 정말 날씬해 보여.

examples.en: She stays slim by walking every day.

senses.note: thin 보다 긍정적인 칭찬 표현. 한국어 '슬림하다'와 뜻이 거의 같다.

senses.meaningEn: not large in size, amount, or number

examples.en: We live in a small apartment near the station.
examples.ko: 우리는 역 근처 작은 아파트에 살아.

examples.en: Can I have a small coffee, please?

senses.note: small 은 크기·양을 객관적으로 말할 때, little 은 '작고 귀여운' 느낌이 들어감(a little boy). 식당·카페 사이즈는 small / medium / large.

senses.meaningEn: the smallest standard size of clothes or drinks

examples.en: These shoes are too small for me.
I'll take the small, please.

senses.note: 옷 라벨의 S 는 small, M 은 medium, L 은 large. '작다'를 tight(꽉 낀다)로 말하기도 함.

senses.meaningEn: able to learn and understand things quickly

examples.en: My little sister is really smart.
That was a smart answer.

senses.note: 미국 구어에서 '똑똑하다'는 smart 가 가장 흔함. 영국에서는 clever 를 더 씀. smart phone/smart TV 의 smart 도 '똑똑한'.

senses.meaningEn: clean, neat, and stylish in appearance

examples.en: You look smart in that suit.
Wear something smart for the interview.

senses.note: 주로 영국식 용법. smart casual = 단정한 캐주얼(드레스 코드). 미국에서는 sharp 나 nice 를 더 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to make a happy expression with your mouth, without sound

examples.en: She smiled at me and said hello.
Smile for the camera!

senses.note: smile 은 소리 없이 웃는 것, laugh 는 소리 내어 웃는 것. smile at someone.

senses.meaningEn: a happy expression on your face

examples.en: He has a warm smile.
She said goodbye with a big smile.
examples.ko: 그녀는 환하게 웃으며 작별 인사를 했어.

senses.note: with a smile = 웃으며. a big smile, a warm smile.

senses.meaningEn: the gray or black gas that comes from something burning

examples.en: I can smell smoke. Is something burning?
examples.ko: 연기 냄새가 나. 뭐 타는 거 아니야?

examples.en: Black smoke came out of the chimney.

senses.note: 불가산. 연기 감지기 = smoke detector/alarm.

senses.meaningEn: to breathe in and out the smoke from a cigarette

examples.en: You can't smoke in here.
My dad stopped smoking last year.

senses.note: 금연 구역 = no smoking area. 담배를 끊다 = quit/stop smoking. 흡연자 = smoker.

senses.meaningEn: a small amount of food eaten between meals

examples.en: I need a snack before the meeting.
Fruit is a healthy snack for kids.

senses.note: have/grab a snack = 간식을 먹다. 한국어 '스낵(과자)'보다 뜻이 넓어 과일·샌드위치도 snack.

senses.meaningEn: to eat a small amount of food between meals

examples.en: I snack on nuts while I work.
Stop snacking, dinner is almost ready.
examples.ko: 그만 주워 먹어, 저녁 거의 다 됐어.

senses.note: snack on + 음식. 동사로 쓰면 '주워 먹다'는 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: a long thin animal with no legs that moves by sliding along the ground

examples.en: Watch out! There's a snake on the path.
Are the snakes in this area dangerous?

senses.note: 독사는 poisonous/venomous snake. 뱀은 slide/slither(미끄러지듯 기어가다), 소리는 hiss. 사람을 snake 라고 하면 '믿을 수 없는 사람'.

senses.meaningEn: soft comfortable shoes with rubber bottoms, worn for sports or everyday

examples.en: I wear sneakers when I walk to work.
Her new sneakers are white and pink.

senses.note: 미국식. 영국식은 trainers. 달리기 전용은 running shoes. a pair of sneakers.

senses.meaningEn: to suddenly push air out through your nose and mouth, for example when you have a cold

examples.en: I always sneeze when I'm near cats.
examples.ko: 고양이 근처에 가면 항상 재채기가 나.

examples.en: He sneezed three times in a row.

senses.note: 누가 재채기하면 Bless you! 라고 말해 줌. 명사로도 씀(a loud sneeze).

senses.meaningEn: soft white pieces of frozen water that fall from the sky

examples.en: The kids are playing in the snow.
We had the first snow of the year today.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: a snow ✗, snows ✗ → heavy snow(폭설). 첫눈 = the first snow. 눈사람 = snowman, 눈싸움 = snowball fight.

senses.meaningEn: to fall from the sky as snow

examples.en: It snowed all night.
It's snowing! Let's go outside.

senses.note: rain 처럼 주어는 it: It snows / It's snowing / It snowed. Snow is falling 도 가능하지만 더 문학적.

senses.meaningEn: with snow falling or covering the ground

examples.en: It was a cold, snowy night.
The roads are snowy, so drive slowly.

senses.note: It's snowing(지금 눈이 온다) 과 구별. 눈이 많은 겨울 = a snowy winter. snowy white = 눈처럼 하얀.

senses.meaningEn: a substance you use with water to wash your body or things

examples.en: Wash your hands with soap and water.
We're out of soap. Can you buy some?
examples.ko: 비누가 다 떨어졌어. 좀 사다 줄래?

senses.note: soap 은 보통 셀 수 없는 명사. '비누 한 개'는 a bar of soap. 세제는 detergent, 주방 세제는 dish soap.

senses.meaningEn: soft pieces of clothing that cover your feet inside your shoes

examples.en: Put on clean socks every day.
These socks have a hole in them.

senses.note: 보통 복수형, a pair of socks. 한 짝은 a sock. 양말을 '신다'도 wear/put on. 스타킹은 tights/pantyhose.

senses.meaningEn: a sweet drink with bubbles in it, such as cola

examples.en: Can I have a soda with my burger?
I'm trying to drink less soda.

senses.note: 미국에서는 지역에 따라 soda / pop / soft drink / coke 라고 부름. 한국어 '사이다'는 영어로 lemon-lime soda 나 Sprite 이고, 영어 cider 는 사과술·사과주스를 뜻함.

senses.meaningEn: a white powder used in baking or cleaning (baking soda)

examples.en: Add a little baking soda to the dough.
Baking soda cleans the sink really well.
examples.ko: 베이킹 소다는 싱크대를 정말 잘 닦아 줘.

senses.meaningEn: a long, soft seat for two or more people

examples.en: Sit on the sofa and make yourself comfortable.
I fell asleep on the sofa last night.

senses.note: 미국에서는 couch 를 더 자주 씀. 소파'에' 앉다는 on the sofa.

senses.meaningEn: a person, when you do not know or say who

examples.en: Somebody is knocking on the door.
Ask somebody for directions.

senses.note: someone 과 같은 뜻, 더 구어적. 단수 동사와 함께: Somebody is(○).

senses.meaningEn: a person, when you do not know or say who

examples.en: Someone left a bag on the bus.
I need someone to help me move.

senses.note: 긍정문에 someone, 의문·부정문에는 보통 anyone. 단, 부탁·제안할 때는 질문에도 someone: Can someone open the door?

senses.meaningEn: on some occasions but not always

examples.en: Sometimes I walk to work instead of driving.
She sometimes forgets to lock the door.
examples.ko: 그녀는 가끔 문 잠그는 걸 잊어.

senses.note: 문장 맨 앞·중간·끝 어디에나 올 수 있어 자유로운 편. sometime(어느 때, 언젠가)과 some time(얼마간의 시간)과 혼동 주의: Let's meet sometime. / I need some time.

senses.meaningEn: a person's male child

examples.en: They have a son and a daughter.
examples.ko: 그들은 아들 하나 딸 하나가 있어.

examples.en: My son just started elementary school.

senses.note: sun(태양)과 발음이 같음 /sʌn/. only son = 외아들.

senses.meaningEn: a short piece of music with words that you sing

examples.en: This is my favorite song!
Let's sing a song together.

senses.note: sing a song(노래를 부르다), a love song(사랑 노래). 노래방은 karaoke. 가수는 singer, 가사는 lyrics.

senses.meaningEn: in a short time from now

examples.en: Dinner will be ready soon.
I hope you feel better soon.

senses.note: See you soon!(곧 보자), as soon as possible(가능한 한 빨리, ASAP), sooner or later(언젠가는). 비교급 sooner, 최상급 soonest. 한국어 '빨리'를 fast 로 옮기지 말고 아플 때는 get well soon 처럼 soon 을 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: painful, especially when touched or used

examples.en: I have a sore throat and a cough.
My legs are sore from running yesterday.

senses.note: sore throat(목 아픔), sore muscles(근육통). 운동 후 '알이 배다'도 sore. 날카롭게 '아프다'는 hurt, 통증은 pain.

senses.meaningEn: a hot liquid food made by cooking vegetables, meat, or fish in water

examples.en: I'd like the chicken soup to start.
Mom makes soup when I have a cold.
examples.ko: 내가 감기 걸리면 엄마가 국을 끓여 주셔.

senses.note: 보통 셀 수 없음: a bowl of soup(한 그릇). 영어에서는 수프를 '마신다(drink)'가 아니라 eat soup / have soup 라고 함. 한국 음식의 국·찌개를 설명할 때도 soup 또는 stew 를 씀.

senses.meaningEn: having a sharp taste like a lemon

examples.en: This lemon is really sour!
I don't like sour candy.

senses.note: 신 김치처럼 발효로 신맛은 sour, 레몬의 상큼한 신맛은 tart / tangy 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: having a bad taste because it is no longer fresh

examples.en: The milk smells sour. Don't drink it.
examples.ko: 우유가 쉰 냄새 나. 마시지 마.

examples.en: This milk went sour in the heat.

senses.note: go sour / turn sour = 쉬다, 상하다. 주로 우유·크림에 씀.

senses.meaningEn: to be able to talk in a particular language

examples.en: Do you speak English?
She speaks three languages.

senses.note: 언어 이름 앞에는 전치사 없음: speak Korean (speak in Korean 은 '한국어로 말하다' 뉘앙스). Can you speak English? 보다 Do you speak English? 가 더 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to talk to someone about something

examples.en: Can I speak to the manager, please?
I spoke with my teacher after class.

senses.note: speak to/with someone. talk 보다 조금 더 격식적. 전화에서 'This is Minho speaking.' = 저 민호인데요.

senses.meaningEn: to use your voice to say words

examples.en: Please speak more slowly.
Speak up! I can't hear you.

senses.note: speak up = 더 크게 말하다 / 의견을 당당히 말하다. speak loudly = 큰 소리로 말하다.

senses.meaningEn: to say or write the letters of a word in the right order

examples.en: How do you spell your last name?
I always spell 'Wednesday' wrong.

senses.note: How do you spell it? = 철자가 어떻게 돼요? 철자(명사)는 spelling. 과거형 spelled(미)/spelt(영).

senses.meaningEn: magic words that make something happen

examples.en: The witch put a spell on the prince.
Say the magic spell and the door will open.

senses.note: put a spell on / cast a spell = 마법을 걸다. 동화·영화에서 자주 나옴.

senses.meaningEn: to use money to buy or pay for things

examples.en: I spent too much money on clothes this month.
examples.ko: 이번 달에 옷에 돈을 너무 많이 썼어.

examples.en: How much do you spend on food each week?

senses.note: spend money on + 대상. 'spend money for' 는 틀림. 과거형 spent /spent/.

senses.meaningEn: to use time doing something or being somewhere

examples.en: We spent the weekend at my parents' house.
I spend an hour a day studying English.
examples.ko: 나는 하루에 한 시간 영어 공부에 써.

senses.note: spend time (in) -ing = ~하면서 시간을 보내다. spend time with + 사람. 한국어 '시간을 때우다'는 kill time.

senses.meaningEn: having a strong hot flavor from spices like chili or pepper

examples.en: Korean food is often very spicy.
Can you make it less spicy, please?
examples.ko: 덜 맵게 해 주실 수 있어요?

senses.note: '맵다'는 spicy 또는 hot. spicy 는 향신료의 맛, hot 은 혀가 타는 느낌이 강조됨. 안 매운 것은 mild.

senses.meaningEn: a tool with a small bowl and a handle, used for eating or stirring

examples.en: I need a spoon for my soup.
Koreans eat rice with a spoon.

senses.note: 작은 숟가락은 teaspoon, 큰 숟가락은 tablespoon(레시피 계량 단위로도 씀).

senses.meaningEn: the amount a spoon holds

examples.en: Add a spoon of sugar to the tea.
Just try one spoon of this.

senses.note: 정확히는 a spoonful of sugar 가 표준이지만 구어에서는 a spoon of 도 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: the season between winter and summer when plants start to grow

examples.en: Spring is my favorite season.
Cherry blossoms bloom in early spring.

senses.note: 계절 앞에는 in 을 쓰고(in spring / in the spring), 관사는 있어도 없어도 된다. 계절 이름은 보통 소문자.

senses.meaningEn: a curled piece of metal that goes back to its shape after you press it

examples.en: The old bed has a broken spring.
examples.ko: 그 낡은 침대는 스프링이 하나 부러졌어.

examples.en: This toy jumps because of a spring inside.
examples.ko: 이 장난감은 안에 스프링이 있어서 뛰어올라.

senses.meaningEn: a place where water comes up naturally from the ground

examples.en: The water comes from a mountain spring.
examples.ko: 이 물은 산속 샘에서 나온 거야.

examples.en: We relaxed in a hot spring in Japan.

senses.note: hot spring = 온천. spring water = 샘물(생수 상표에도 자주 보임).

senses.meaningEn: a set of steps that you walk up or down to go to another floor

examples.en: Let's take the stairs instead of the elevator.
Be careful, the stairs are wet.

senses.note: 보통 복수형으로 씀. 계단 한 칸은 a step/stair. 위층으로 = upstairs, 아래층으로 = downstairs(둘 다 to 없이 씀).

senses.meaningEn: to be on your feet in an upright position

examples.en: Please stand up when the teacher comes in.
We stood in line for twenty minutes.

senses.note: stand up = (동작) 일어서다, be standing = (상태) 서 있다. stand in line = 줄을 서다(미국식).

senses.meaningEn: to accept or bear something unpleasant

examples.en: I can't stand this hot weather.
examples.ko: 이 더운 날씨 정말 못 참겠어.

examples.en: She can't stand waiting in long lines.
examples.ko: 그녀는 긴 줄 서서 기다리는 걸 못 견뎌.

senses.note: 거의 항상 can't stand 형태로 쓰임. I can't stand him. = 그 사람 정말 싫어. hate 보다 구어적이고 감정이 강함.

senses.meaningEn: a small bright point of light in the night sky

examples.en: You can see so many stars from here.
Can you find the brightest star in the sky?
examples.ko: 하늘에서 가장 밝은 별 찾을 수 있어?

senses.note: a shooting star = 별똥별. 밤하늘에 별이 많다 = The sky is full of stars.

senses.meaningEn: a famous and popular actor, singer, or player

examples.en: She wants to be a movie star.
He's the star of the team.

senses.note: K-pop star, movie star, soccer star 처럼 뒤에 붙여 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a symbol used to show how good something is

examples.en: I gave the restaurant five stars.
This hotel only has three stars.

senses.note: a five-star hotel = 5성급 호텔. 리뷰 별점 = star rating.

senses.meaningEn: to begin doing something, or to begin happening

examples.en: Let's start the meeting now.
School starts at eight thirty.

senses.note: start to do / start doing 둘 다 가능. begin 보다 구어적이고 훨씬 자주 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: to make a car or machine begin to work

examples.en: The car won't start this morning.
examples.ko: 오늘 아침에 차 시동이 안 걸려.

examples.en: Press this button to start the washing machine.

senses.note: 기계에는 begin 을 쓰지 않음. start the engine = 시동을 걸다.

senses.meaningEn: the beginning of something

examples.en: We were late from the start.
It's a good start. Keep going!

senses.note: at the start of = ~의 초반에. 명사로는 start 가 begin 보다 훨씬 흔함(beginning 과 비교).

senses.meaningEn: to live or sleep somewhere for a short time

examples.en: We stayed at a small hotel near the beach.
examples.ko: 우리는 해변 근처 작은 호텔에 묵었어.

examples.en: Can I stay at your place tonight?
examples.ko: 오늘 밤 너희 집에서 자도 돼?

senses.note: stay at + 숙소, stay with + 사람, stay in + 도시. stay home = 집에 있다(at 없이도 됨). 짧은 체류는 stay, 거주는 live.

senses.meaningEn: to continue to be in a particular state

examples.en: Stay calm and don't worry.
It's cold outside, so stay warm!

senses.note: stay + 형용사: stay healthy, stay safe, stay awake(안 자고 있다). stay up late = 늦게까지 안 자다.

senses.meaningEn: a period of time that you spend in a place

examples.en: Enjoy your stay in Korea!
How long was your stay in Tokyo?

senses.note: Enjoy your stay. 는 호텔에서 자주 듣는 말. overnight stay = 1박.

senses.meaningEn: continuing up to now, longer than expected

examples.en: Are you still at the office?
I still love this old song.
examples.ko: 나는 이 옛날 노래가 여전히 좋아.

senses.note: 계속되고 있는 상태를 말함. 끝나지 않은 일을 부정문에서 말할 때는 yet(not yet)을 더 자주 씀. 위치는 be동사 뒤, 일반동사 앞.

senses.meaningEn: despite that; even so

examples.en: It was cold, but we still had fun.
He is busy, but he still calls his mom.

senses.note: but 과 함께 "그래도"의 뜻을 강조할 때 자주 씀. 문장 맨 앞에 Still, ... 로 쓰면 "그렇기는 해도".

senses.meaningEn: not moving

examples.en: Stand still while I take the picture.
examples.ko: 사진 찍을 테니까 가만히 서 있어.

examples.en: The baby would not sit still.

senses.note: sit still, stand still, keep still, hold still 처럼 동사와 묶어서 씀. still water = (탄산 없는) 생수, sparkling water 의 반대.

senses.meaningEn: the organ inside your body where food goes after you eat, or the front part of your body below your chest

examples.en: My stomach hurts after eating too much.
Don't take this medicine on an empty stomach.

senses.note: 발음 주의: 끝의 ch 는 /k/ 소리. 아이들 말로는 tummy, 구어로 belly. 배가 꾸르륵 = My stomach is growling.

senses.meaningEn: a pain in your stomach

examples.en: I have a stomachache. I think I ate too much.
examples.ko: 배가 아파. 너무 많이 먹었나 봐.

examples.en: He stayed home from school with a stomachache.
examples.ko: 그는 배가 아파서 학교에 안 가고 집에 있었어.

senses.note: have a stomachache. stomach ache 로 띄어 쓰기도 함. 더 일반적인 구어: My stomach hurts.

senses.meaningEn: a small piece of rock, or the hard material it is made of

examples.en: He threw a stone into the water.
The old bridge is made of stone.

senses.note: 재료일 때는 불가산(made of stone). 미국 일상어에서는 작은 돌을 rock 이라고 더 많이 함. 보석은 precious stone / gemstone.

senses.meaningEn: to not continue doing something

examples.en: Stop talking and listen, please.
It stopped raining an hour ago.

senses.note: stop doing = ~하는 것을 멈추다. stop to do = ~하기 위해 멈추다(뜻이 다름!). Stop it! = 그만해!

senses.meaningEn: to not move any more, or to make something not move

examples.en: The bus stops right in front of my house.
examples.ko: 버스가 우리 집 바로 앞에 서.

examples.en: Please stop here. I'll get out.

senses.note: 택시에서 '여기 세워 주세요'는 Please stop here. / Right here is fine.

senses.meaningEn: a place where a bus or train stops for people to get on and off

examples.en: Get off at the next stop.
Where's the nearest bus stop?

senses.note: bus stop = 버스 정류장, 지하철역은 station. 'my stop' = 내가 내릴 역.

senses.meaningEn: a place where you can buy things

examples.en: I need to go to the store for some milk.
Is there a convenience store around here?

senses.note: 미국식에서 가장 일반적인 '가게'. grocery store(식료품점), department store(백화점), convenience store(편의점). the store 라고만 하면 흔히 마트를 뜻함.

senses.meaningEn: to keep things in a place until you need them

examples.en: Store the rice in a cool, dry place.
Where do you store your winter clothes?

senses.note: 컴퓨터·휴대폰의 저장도 store(저장 공간 = storage). '안전하게 보관하다'는 keep safe 로도 자주 말함.

senses.meaningEn: very bad weather with strong wind and heavy rain or snow

examples.en: A big storm is coming this weekend.
The storm knocked down a lot of trees.

senses.note: snowstorm(눈보라), thunderstorm(뇌우), typhoon(태풍: 한국·동아시아), hurricane(허리케인: 미국). a storm in a teacup = 사소한 일로 큰 소란.

senses.meaningEn: with strong wind, heavy rain, and sometimes thunder

examples.en: Don't go swimming in stormy weather.
It was a dark and stormy night.

senses.meaningEn: full of strong feelings and arguments

examples.en: They had a stormy relationship.
It was a stormy meeting with lots of shouting.

senses.note: a stormy relationship/meeting = 감정이 격하게 오가는 관계·회의.

senses.meaningEn: a description of real or imagined events, told for fun or to teach

examples.en: Grandma told us a story before bed.
examples.ko: 할머니가 자기 전에 이야기를 해 주셨어.

examples.en: I like stories with a happy ending.

senses.note: tell a story(이야기를 해 주다), read a story. short story = 단편 소설. '사정/변명'의 뜻도: That's a long story.(얘기하면 길어).

senses.meaningEn: a report about something in the news

examples.en: Did you see the story about the storm?
It was the top story on the news tonight.
examples.ko: 오늘 밤 뉴스의 첫 번째 소식이었어.

senses.note: 뉴스의 꼭지 하나를 story 라고 함. cover story = 잡지 표지 기사. 거짓말을 가볍게 '꾸며낸 이야기'로 말할 때도 story.

senses.meaningEn: a level of a building

examples.en: We live in a two-story house.
The building is twenty stories tall.

senses.note: '몇 층짜리 건물'을 말할 때 story(미국식) / storey(영국식). '3층에 있다'는 on the third floor 로 floor 를 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a kitchen appliance with burners on top that you cook on

examples.en: Turn off the stove when the water boils.
Don't touch the stove, it's still hot.

senses.note: 한국어 '가스레인지'는 영어로 stove(또는 range). on the stove = 레인지 불 위에서. '전자레인지'는 microwave.

senses.meaningEn: a closed heater that burns wood or gas to warm a room

examples.en: We sat by the wood stove to stay warm.
examples.ko: 우리는 몸을 녹이려고 장작 난로 옆에 앉았어.

examples.en: The old cabin has a small stove for heat.
examples.ko: 그 오래된 오두막에는 난방용 작은 난로가 있어.

senses.note: wood stove(장작 난로). 전기 난방기는 보통 heater 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: a person you do not know

examples.en: Don't talk to strangers, okay?
A stranger asked me for directions.

senses.note: strange(이상한)에서 왔지만 stranger 는 '이상한 사람'이 아니라 '모르는 사람'.

senses.meaningKo: 처음 온 사람, 그곳을 잘 모르는 사람
senses.meaningEn: a person who is new to a place and does not know it well

examples.en: Sorry, I'm a stranger here too.
He's a stranger in this town.
examples.ko: 그는 이 동네에 처음 온 사람이야.

senses.note: 길을 물어볼 때 I'm a stranger here. = 저도 여기 잘 몰라요.

senses.meaningEn: a small, soft red fruit with tiny seeds on the outside

examples.en: Strawberries are my favorite fruit in spring.
examples.ko: 딸기는 봄에 내가 제일 좋아하는 과일이야.

examples.en: I'd like a strawberry milkshake, please.

senses.note: 복수형은 strawberries(y → ies). strawberry jam, strawberry ice cream 처럼 맛을 나타낼 때는 단수형으로 앞에 붙임. 비슷한 과일: blueberry, raspberry.

senses.meaningEn: a road in a town or city with buildings on both sides

examples.en: I live on Main Street, near the park.
examples.ko: 나는 공원 근처 메인 스트리트에 살아.

examples.en: Be careful when you cross the street.

senses.note: on the street(거리에서), across the street(길 건너편에). 도시 안의 길은 street, 도시 밖 큰길은 road.

senses.meaningEn: having a lot of physical power or good health

examples.en: My brother is strong enough to carry two boxes.
examples.ko: 우리 형은 상자 두 개를 들 만큼 힘이 세.

examples.en: Eat well and you'll grow strong.

senses.meaningEn: having a lot of flavor, smell, or alcohol

examples.en: I need a strong coffee this morning.
This cheese has a very strong smell.

senses.note: strong coffee / strong tea / strong smell. '진하다'를 thick 이나 deep 으로 옮기지 않도록 주의.

senses.meaningEn: having a lot of force or power

examples.en: There was a strong wind last night.
Hold on tight, the current is strong here.

senses.note: strong wind, strong rain 은 heavy rain 이 더 자연스럽다.

senses.meaningEn: a person who is studying at a school or university

examples.en: How many students are in your class?
I'm a student at Seoul National University.

senses.note: 미국에서는 초등학생도 student. 영국에서는 어린 학생을 pupil 이라고도 함. '대학생'은 college/university student.

senses.meaningEn: to spend time learning about a subject

examples.en: I have to study for my English test.
She studied all night for the exam.

senses.note: study for a test = 시험 공부를 하다. study English (전치사 없음). learn 은 결과(익히다), study 는 과정(공부하다)에 초점.

senses.meaningEn: to learn a subject at a university or college

examples.en: My sister studies medicine in Seoul.
What did you study in college?

senses.note: What's your major? 도 흔히 쓰지만 What do you study? 가 더 구어적.

senses.meaningEn: a room in a house used for reading and working

examples.en: Dad is working in his study.
We turned the small room into a study.

senses.note: study room 이라고 하면 도서관의 '열람실'처럼 들릴 수 있음. 집의 서재는 그냥 study.

senses.meaningEn: not smart; showing a lack of good thinking

examples.en: That was a stupid thing to say. Sorry.
examples.ko: 그렇게 말한 건 바보 같았어. 미안해.

examples.en: Don't call your brother stupid.

senses.note: 사람에게 직접 쓰면 매우 무례함. 자기 실수에는 I feel so stupid.(내가 너무 바보 같아) 로 자주 씀. 좀 더 부드러운 말은 silly.

senses.meaningEn: used to show you are annoyed about something

examples.en: This stupid phone won't turn on!
examples.ko: 이 바보 같은 전화기가 안 켜지네!

examples.en: I'm so tired of this stupid traffic.
examples.ko: 이 지겨운 교통 체증 정말 지쳤어.

senses.note: 물건·상황에 붙여 짜증을 표현하는 구어. 친한 사이에서만.

senses.meaningEn: a particular design or shape of clothes, hair, or things

examples.en: I like this style of jacket.
She changed her hair style last week.

senses.note: hairstyle 은 한 단어로도 씀. 한국어 '스타일 좋다'(몸매·옷차림)는 영어로 She has great style. 또는 She dresses well.

senses.meaningEn: the way someone does something

examples.en: Everyone has their own style of learning.
I don't like his style of talking.
examples.ko: 그의 말하는 방식이 마음에 안 들어.

senses.note: That's not my style. = 내 취향/방식이 아니야. in style = 유행하는(in fashion).

senses.meaningEn: an area of knowledge that you study at school, like math or history

examples.en: What's your favorite subject at school?
Math is my worst subject.

senses.note: favorite subject = 좋아하는 과목. 과목 이름(math, English)은 subject 뒤에 바로 붙이지 않고 단독으로 씀.

senses.meaningEn: the thing that people are talking or writing about

examples.en: Let's change the subject, okay?
The subject of her talk was healthy eating.

senses.note: change the subject = 화제를 바꾸다. 이메일 제목 줄도 subject (line).

senses.meaningEn: a sweet white or brown substance used to make food and drinks sweet

examples.en: How many sugars do you take in your coffee?
examples.ko: 커피에 설탕 몇 개 넣어 드세요?

examples.en: This cake has too much sugar in it.
examples.ko: 이 케이크는 설탕이 너무 많이 들어갔어.

senses.note: 보통 셀 수 없음(a spoonful of sugar). 커피·차에 넣는 '설탕 한 개(한 스푼)' 를 말할 때만 one sugar, two sugars 처럼 셈. 발음은 [슈거].

senses.meaningEn: a large bag with a handle that you carry clothes in when you travel

examples.en: I packed my suitcase the night before the trip.
examples.ko: 여행 전날 밤에 짐을 다 쌌어.

examples.en: Her suitcase was too heavy to lift.
examples.ko: 그녀의 여행 가방은 너무 무거워서 들 수 없었어.

senses.note: 한국어 '캐리어'는 영어로 suitcase(또는 carry-on = 기내용). carrier 는 통신사·항공사·운반 기구를 뜻함. pack/unpack a suitcase = 짐을 싸다/풀다. 짐 전체는 luggage/baggage.

senses.meaningEn: the warmest season of the year, between spring and fall

examples.en: What are you doing this summer?
Korean summers are hot and humid.

senses.note: summer vacation(여름 방학), summer camp, in the summer. 형용사처럼 명사 앞에 바로 쓴다(summer clothes). this summer 앞에는 in 을 쓰지 않는다.

senses.meaningEn: the big bright star in the sky that gives us light and heat

examples.en: The sun comes up at six in summer.
Don't look straight at the sun.

senses.note: 하나뿐이라 보통 the sun. 해가 뜨다 = the sun rises/comes up, 지다 = the sun sets/goes down. sun(해)과 son(아들)은 발음이 같음.

senses.meaningEn: the light and heat that come from the sun

examples.en: Let's sit in the sun for a while.
I got too much sun at the beach.

senses.note: in the sun = 햇볕 아래, in the shade = 그늘에. get some sun = 햇볕을 좀 쬐다.

senses.meaningEn: the day of the week after Saturday and before Monday

examples.en: We visit my grandparents every Sunday.
examples.ko: 우리는 일요일마다 할아버지 할머니 댁에 가.

examples.en: The store is closed on Sunday.

senses.note: 미국 달력은 일요일이 한 주의 첫 날. Sunday brunch, Sunday dinner 처럼 가족 식사와 자주 짝을 이룸. sundae(아이스크림)와 발음이 같아 혼동 주의.

senses.meaningEn: a tall plant with a very large yellow flower

examples.en: Sunflowers grow very tall in summer.
I like eating sunflower seeds.

senses.note: sun + flower 를 붙여 한 단어로. 해바라기씨 = sunflower seeds, 해바라기유 = sunflower oil.

senses.meaningEn: with bright light from the sun and few clouds

examples.en: It's sunny today, so let's go to the park.
Tomorrow will be sunny and warm.

senses.note: 날씨 표현은 It's + 형용사: It's sunny. 'sunny side up' = 한쪽만 익힌 달걀 프라이.

senses.meaningEn: cheerful and happy

examples.en: She has a sunny personality.
He gave me a big, sunny smile.

senses.meaningEn: the time in the morning when the sun first appears

examples.en: We got up early to watch the sunrise.
The sunrise over the sea was beautiful.

senses.note: at sunrise = 해 뜰 때. 새해 첫 일출 = the first sunrise of the year. 해가 뜨다(동사) = the sun rises.

senses.meaningEn: the time in the evening when the sun goes down

examples.en: Let's watch the sunset from the beach.
The sky turns orange at sunset.
examples.ko: 해 질 때 하늘이 주황색으로 변해.

senses.note: at sunset = 해 질 때. 해가 지다(동사) = the sun sets / goes down. '노을'을 말할 때도 sunset 을 쓰면 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: a large store that sells food, drinks, and things for the house

examples.en: I'm going to the supermarket. Do you need anything?
The supermarket is open twenty-four hours.

senses.note: 미국 일상 회화에서는 grocery store 를 더 자주 씀. 한국어 '마트'를 mart 라고 하면 통하지 않을 수 있음.

senses.meaningEn: a light meal eaten in the evening, or the last meal of the day

examples.en: What's for supper tonight?
We had a late supper after the movie.
examples.ko: 영화 보고 나서 늦은 저녁을 먹었어.

senses.note: dinner 보다 가볍고 가정적인 느낌. 지역·가정에 따라 dinner 와 같은 뜻으로도 쓰임. 일상에서는 dinner 가 훨씬 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: to make food or drink go down your throat into your stomach

examples.en: Swallow the pill with a glass of water.
examples.ko: 약을 물 한 잔과 함께 삼켜.

examples.en: My throat hurts when I swallow.

senses.note: 병원에서 It hurts to swallow. 는 꼭 알아 둘 표현. 씹지 않고 통째로 삼키는 것은 swallow whole.

senses.meaningEn: a small bird with long pointed wings and a forked tail

examples.en: We saw swallows flying over the river.
A swallow built a nest under our roof.
examples.ko: 제비가 우리 집 지붕 밑에 둥지를 지었어.

senses.note: 동사 '삼키다'와 철자·발음이 같은 전혀 다른 뜻. 문맥으로 구분.

senses.meaningEn: a warm knitted piece of clothing for the top half of the body

examples.en: I wore a warm sweater under my coat.
My grandma made me this sweater.
examples.ko: 이 스웨터는 할머니가 짜 주신 거야.

senses.note: 영국식은 jumper. 한국어 '니트'는 영어로 sweater 또는 knit top. 발음은 sweat(땀)+er.

senses.meaningEn: to clean a floor with a broom

examples.en: I sweep the kitchen floor every morning.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 아침 주방 바닥을 쓸어.

examples.en: She swept the leaves off the steps.

senses.note: sweep - swept - swept. sweep the floor(바닥을 쓸다), sweep up(쓸어 모으다). 진공청소기로 청소하는 건 vacuum.

senses.meaningEn: tasting like sugar

examples.en: This cake is too sweet for me.
I like my coffee a little sweet.

senses.note: sweet and sour = 달고 신(탕수육 소스). 단 것을 좋아하면 have a sweet tooth.

senses.meaningEn: kind and gentle in a way that makes people like you

examples.en: That's so sweet of you, thank you.
My grandmother is a very sweet person.

senses.note: 칭찬할 때 You're so sweet. 자주 씀. 미국 구어로 'Sweet!'(좋다!) 감탄사로도 사용.

senses.meaningEn: a soft shirt with short sleeves and no collar or buttons

examples.en: I usually wear a t-shirt and jeans on weekends.
Can I get this t-shirt in a medium?

senses.note: 글로는 T-shirt(대문자 T)가 표준 표기. 모양이 T 자여서 붙은 이름.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs

examples.en: Could we get a table for two, please?
Put the plates on the table, please.

senses.note: 식탁을 차리다 = set the table, 치우다 = clear the table. 식당 예약: book a table.

senses.meaningEn: a list of facts or numbers arranged in rows and columns

examples.en: Look at the table on page twelve.
The table shows the prices for each month.
examples.ko: 이 표는 월별 가격을 보여 줘.

senses.note: 구구단은 times tables / multiplication table. 목차는 table of contents.

senses.meaningEn: to carry or move something or someone to another place

examples.en: Don't forget to take your umbrella today.
I'll take the kids to school this morning.
examples.ko: 오늘 아침은 내가 애들 학교에 데려다줄게.

senses.note: take 는 '여기서 저기로' 가져가다, bring 은 '이쪽으로' 가져오다.

senses.meaningEn: to travel using a bus, train, taxi, etc.

examples.en: Let's take a taxi. It's raining.
I take the subway to work every day.

senses.note: take a bus / take the train / take a taxi. ride 보다 take 가 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to need a certain amount of time

examples.en: It takes about ten minutes to walk there.
How long does it take by bus?

senses.note: It takes + 시간 + to 동사. '걸리다'를 spend 로 쓰지 않도록 주의.

senses.meaningEn: to swallow medicine

examples.en: Take this medicine twice a day after meals.
examples.ko: 이 약은 하루 두 번 식후에 드세요.

examples.en: Did you take your pills this morning?

senses.note: 약은 eat 이 아니라 take.

senses.meaningEn: to stop working or studying for a short time to rest

examples.en: Let's take a break and get some coffee.
You've been studying for hours. Take a break.
examples.ko: 몇 시간 동안 공부했잖아. 좀 쉬어.

senses.note: take a rest 보다 take a break 가 훨씬 자연스러움. take a short break / take a coffee break.

senses.meaningEn: to relax, calm down, or not work too hard

examples.en: Take it easy. Everything will be okay.
The doctor told me to take it easy this week.
examples.ko: 의사가 이번 주는 무리하지 말라고 했어.

senses.meaningEn: used as a casual way to say goodbye

examples.en: See you tomorrow. Take it easy!
Okay, take it easy, man.

senses.note: 미국 구어에서 친한 사이의 작별 인사. 격식 있는 자리에서는 피함.

senses.meaningEn: to remove clothes or shoes

examples.en: Please take off your shoes at the door.
It's hot. Take your jacket off.

senses.meaningEn: to leave the ground and start flying

examples.en: The plane takes off at nine thirty.
We're taking off soon, so turn off your phone.

senses.meaningEn: to not go to work for a period of time

examples.en: I'm taking Friday off to see the doctor.
Why don't you take a few days off?

senses.note: take + 날 + off: take Monday off, take a week off.

senses.meaningEn: to say things to someone in a conversation

examples.en: We talked for hours on the phone.
examples.ko: 우리는 전화로 몇 시간 동안 이야기했어.

examples.en: Can we talk about this later?
examples.ko: 이 얘기는 나중에 하면 안 될까?

senses.note: talk to/with someone about something. speak 보다 가볍고 일상적. '우리 얘기 좀 하자' = We need to talk.

senses.meaningEn: a short speech or conversation about a subject

examples.en: She gave a talk about recycling.
I had a long talk with my dad last night.

senses.note: give a talk = 강연(발표)하다. have a talk with = ~와 이야기하다. 잡담은 small talk.

senses.meaningEn: having a greater height than average

examples.en: My dad is very tall, almost two meters.
examples.ko: 우리 아빠는 키가 아주 커, 거의 2미터야.

examples.en: How tall are you?

senses.note: 사람·나무·건물의 키는 tall, 산·천장처럼 바닥에서 높이 있는 것은 high. 키를 물을 때는 How tall are you? 이고 How high 는 쓰지 않는다.

senses.meaningEn: a long thin strip of sticky material

examples.en: Can I borrow some tape?
Hold the poster while I put tape on it.
examples.ko: 내가 테이프 붙이는 동안 포스터 잡아 줘.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. 한국어 '스카치테이프'는 상표명이고, 영어는 tape 또는 Scotch tape(미).

senses.meaningEn: to fasten something with tape

examples.en: Tape the box shut before you mail it.
She taped the note to the door.

senses.note: tape A to B = A 를 B 에 붙이다.

senses.meaningEn: to have a particular flavor

examples.en: This soup tastes a little salty.
It tastes like chicken.

senses.note: taste + 형용사(tastes good / sweet), taste like + 명사(tastes like chicken). '맛있다'는 It tastes good. 이 가장 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to put a small amount of food in your mouth to find out its flavor

examples.en: Taste the soup and tell me what you think.
examples.ko: 수프 맛 좀 보고 어떤지 말해 줘.

examples.en: Have you ever tasted Korean rice cake?
examples.ko: 한국 떡 먹어 본 적 있어?

senses.note: '한번 먹어 봐'는 Try it. 이 더 흔함. taste 는 조금 맛보는 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: the flavor of food or drink

examples.en: I love the taste of fresh strawberries.
examples.ko: 나는 신선한 딸기 맛을 정말 좋아해.

examples.en: This tea has a strong taste.

senses.note: '내 취향이다'는 It's my taste. 가 아니라 It's to my taste. / It's my style. 가 자연스러움. 명사 taste 에는 '취향·감각(good taste)' 뜻도 있음.

senses.meaningEn: having a good, strong flavor

examples.en: These noodles are really tasty.
Do you know any tasty and cheap restaurants?
examples.ko: 맛있고 싼 식당 아는 데 있어?

senses.note: delicious 보다 조금 가벼운 느낌. 짜고 매운 음식처럼 '맛이 진한' 음식에 잘 어울림. '맛있다'를 It tastes good. 로도 자주 표현.

senses.meaningEn: a hot drink made by pouring water over dried leaves

examples.en: Would you like some tea?
I drink green tea every morning.

senses.note: 영어에서 tea 만 말하면 보통 홍차(black tea). 녹차는 green tea, 허브차는 herbal tea. 한 잔은 a cup of tea, 가게에서는 two teas 도 가능. 영국에서는 tea 가 '저녁 식사'를 뜻하기도 함.

senses.meaningEn: to give lessons to students in a school or class

examples.en: My mom teaches math at a high school.
Who taught you English?

senses.note: teach someone something(간접목적어 먼저). 과거·과거분사 모두 taught. 가르치는 사람은 teacher.

senses.meaningEn: to show someone how to do something

examples.en: Can you teach me how to ride a bike?
examples.ko: 자전거 타는 법 가르쳐 줄 수 있어?

examples.en: Grandpa taught us to fish last weekend.
examples.ko: 할아버지가 지난 주말에 우리한테 낚시를 가르쳐 주셨어.

senses.note: teach someone (how) to + 동사. 길을 '가르쳐 주다'는 teach ✗ → tell/show me the way.

senses.meaningEn: a person whose job is to teach in a school

examples.en: My English teacher is from Canada.
The teacher asked us to sit down.

senses.note: 호칭으로 Teacher! 라고 부르지 않음. Mr. Kim / Ms. Lee 처럼 성을 붙여 부름.

senses.meaningEn: a group of players who play a sport or game together against another group

examples.en: Our team won the game two to one.
Which team do you play for?

senses.meaningEn: a group of people who work together on a job

examples.en: I work on a small team of five people.
examples.ko: 나는 다섯 명짜리 작은 팀에서 일해.

examples.en: The whole team is meeting at three.

senses.note: 미국식은 on a team, 영국식은 in a team. team up (with) = 함께 팀을 이루다. 한국식 '팀장'은 team leader/manager.

senses.meaningEn: a drop of water that comes from your eye when you cry

examples.en: Tears ran down her face.
He wiped away a tear and smiled.

senses.note: '눈물'은 /tɪr/ [티어]. 보통 복수 tears 로 쓴다. in tears = 울면서.

senses.meaningEn: to pull something such as paper or cloth into pieces

examples.en: Be careful not to tear the map.
I tore my jeans on the fence.

senses.note: '찢다'는 /ter/ [테어]로 발음이 다르다. 과거형 tore, 과거분사 torn. tear up = 갈기갈기 찢다.

senses.meaningEn: a young person between 13 and 19 years old

examples.en: My son is a teenager now, so he sleeps a lot.
examples.ko: 우리 아들이 이제 십 대라서 잠을 많이 자.

examples.en: Many teenagers spend hours on their phones.
examples.ko: 많은 십 대들이 폰을 몇 시간씩 봐.

senses.note: thirteen~nineteen 처럼 -teen 으로 끝나는 나이라서 teenager. 구어로 짧게 teen. 형용사는 teenage (teenage boy).

senses.meaningEn: the plural of tooth

examples.en: Brush your teeth before bed.
He has very white teeth.

senses.note: tooth 의 불규칙 복수. 이를 닦다 = brush my teeth(wash ×). 이 사이에 뭐가 끼다 = something is stuck in my teeth.

senses.meaningEn: a device you use to talk to someone far away

examples.en: The telephone is ringing, can you get it?
May I use your telephone, please?

senses.note: 일상에서는 phone 이 훨씬 흔하고 telephone 은 약간 격식적. telephone number = phone number.

senses.meaningEn: to call someone on the phone

examples.en: Please telephone us if you have any questions.
She telephoned the office this morning.

senses.note: 동사로는 call 이 훨씬 자연스러움. telephone to us (X) → telephone us.

senses.meaningEn: a machine with a screen that shows programs

examples.en: We bought a new television for the living room.
Turn the television down, please.

senses.note: 일상 회화에서는 TV 가 훨씬 많이 쓰임. 격식 있는 글에서 television.

senses.meaningEn: the programs that are shown on a television

examples.en: I don't watch much television these days.
She works in television.

senses.note: watch television 에는 the 를 붙이지 않음 (watch the television X). on television = 텔레비전에(서).

senses.meaningEn: to give information to someone by speaking

examples.en: Tell me about your weekend.
He told me the store was closed.

senses.note: tell + 사람 + 내용(tell me the truth). say 와 달리 듣는 사람이 바로 뒤에 옴: tell me (tell to me ✗). tell a story / tell a lie / tell the truth.

senses.meaningEn: to order or advise someone to do something

examples.en: Mom told me to clean my room.
I told you not to touch that!

senses.note: tell someone to + 동사 / tell someone not to + 동사. ask 보다 강한 지시.

senses.meaningEn: to know or recognize the difference between things

examples.en: Can you tell the twins apart?
I can't tell if he's joking or not.

senses.note: can/can't tell = 알아보다/못 알아보다. tell A from B = A 와 B 를 구별하다. You can never tell. = 알 수 없는 일이야.

senses.meaningEn: how hot or cold something is

examples.en: What's the temperature outside?
The temperature will drop tonight.

senses.note: 기온이 오르다/내리다 = the temperature rises/goes up / drops/falls. 미국은 화씨(Fahrenheit) 사용: 섭씨 20도 ≈ 화씨 68도. room temperature = 상온.

senses.meaningEn: the heat of a person's body; a fever

examples.en: Let me take your temperature.
She has a temperature, so she's staying home.

senses.note: 체온을 재다 = take someone's temperature. have/run a temperature = 열이 있다(= have a fever). 정상 체온 = normal temperature.

senses.meaningEn: the number 10

examples.en: Can you count to ten in English?
I'll be back in ten minutes.

senses.note: 서수는 tenth(10th). ten out of ten = 10점 만점에 10점(아주 좋다). 달러를 말할 때 ten bucks = 10달러.

senses.meaningEn: coming after the ninth one

examples.en: Today is our tenth wedding anniversary.
My daughter's tenth birthday is next week.
examples.ko: 딸의 열 번째 생일이 다음 주야.

senses.note: 10th. 서수는 날짜·층·생일·기념일에 자주 쓰임: on the tenth(10일에).

senses.meaningEn: one of ten equal parts of something

examples.en: A tenth of the students got full marks.
He finished in less than a tenth of a second.

senses.note: 소수 0.1 = one tenth(또는 point one).

senses.meaningEn: a set of questions to check what someone knows

examples.en: We have a spelling test on Friday.
I got a good grade on the test.

senses.note: take a test(시험을 보다) — see a test ✗. pass/fail a test = 합격/불합격하다. exam 보다 작고 자주 보는 시험.

senses.meaningEn: a medical check to find out about your health

examples.en: The doctor did a blood test.
I need an eye test for new glasses.
examples.ko: 새 안경 때문에 시력 검사를 받아야 해.

senses.note: blood test(혈액 검사), eye test(시력 검사). 검사를 받다 = have/get a test.

senses.meaningEn: to try something to see if it works

examples.en: Let me test the microphone first.
They tested the new phone for a week.
examples.ko: 그들은 새 폰을 일주일 동안 테스트했어.

senses.meaningEn: a book used for studying a subject at school

examples.en: Please open your textbook to page 20.
I left my math textbook at home.

senses.note: 한 단어로 붙여 씀(text book ✗). 참고서는 study guide, 문제집은 workbook.

senses.meaningEn: at that time in the past or future

examples.en: I was only five years old then.
Call me at six. I'll be home by then.
examples.ko: 6시에 전화해. 그때까지는 집에 가 있을 거야.

senses.note: by then = 그때까지, since then = 그때 이후로, until then = 그때까지(계속). back then = 그 당시에는.

senses.meaningEn: after that; next

examples.en: Boil the water, then add the noodles.
We had dinner and then watched a movie.
examples.ko: 우리는 저녁을 먹고 나서 영화를 봤어.

senses.note: 순서를 말할 때 first, then, finally 로 이어진다. than(~보다)과 철자 혼동 주의: then 은 시간·순서, than 은 비교.

senses.meaningEn: in that case; as a result

examples.en: If you're tired, then go to bed early.
You don't like it? Then don't eat it.

senses.note: If ... then ... 구조에서 then 은 생략해도 된다. 대화 끝에 OK then / See you then 처럼 마무리 말로도 자주 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: having little fat on the body

examples.en: He got very thin when he was sick.
You look thinner. Are you eating well?
examples.ko: 살이 빠진 것 같네. 밥은 잘 먹고 있어?

senses.note: thin 은 중립적이거나 약간 부정적(너무 마른). 칭찬할 때는 slim 이 좋다.

senses.meaningEn: having a small distance between two sides

examples.en: This paper is too thin to write on.
examples.ko: 이 종이는 너무 얇아서 글씨를 쓸 수 없어.

examples.en: Wear a thin jacket, it's not that cold.
examples.ko: 얇은 재킷 입어, 그렇게 춥지 않아.

senses.note: 두께가 얇으면 thin, 두꺼우면 thick. 소리가 작으면 thin 이 아니라 quiet.

senses.meaningEn: to have an opinion or believe something is true

examples.en: I think it's going to rain today.
What do you think of my new hat?

senses.note: I think so. = 그런 것 같아 / I don't think so. = 아닐 것 같아. 부정은 I think it's not 보다 I don't think it is 가 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to use your mind to solve a problem or decide something

examples.en: Let me think for a minute.
Think before you answer.

senses.note: think about = ~에 대해 생각하다, think of = ~을 떠올리다/생각해 내다. 쉽게 혼동됨.

senses.meaningEn: coming after the second one

examples.en: Our room is on the third floor.
This is the third time I've called you.
examples.ko: 너한테 전화하는 게 벌써 세 번째야.

senses.note: 3rd 로 줄여 씀. 날짜: March third(3월 3일). th 발음은 혀를 윗니에 살짝 대고 냄.

senses.meaningEn: one of three equal parts of something

examples.en: Cut the cake into thirds.
I ate a third of the pizza.

senses.note: 분수: one third(1/3), two thirds(2/3). 분자가 2 이상이면 -s.

senses.meaningEn: wanting or needing to drink something

examples.en: I'm really thirsty. Can I have some water?
examples.ko: 목이 너무 말라. 물 좀 마셔도 될까?

examples.en: Running makes me thirsty.

senses.note: '목마르다'는 I'm thirsty. I'm thirst 는 틀림(thirst 는 명사). 발음은 [써스티]에 가깝다.

senses.meaningEn: the number 13

examples.en: My nephew just turned thirteen.
examples.ko: 우리 조카가 막 열세 살이 됐어.

examples.en: Room thirteen is at the end of the hall.

senses.note: -teen 은 끝음절에 강세, -ty 는 첫음절에 강세: thirTEEN(13) vs THIRty(30). 서양에서 13은 불길한 숫자로 여겨져 13층이 없는 건물도 있음. teenager 는 13~19세.

senses.meaningEn: the number 30

examples.en: It's half past six, so six thirty.
About thirty people came to the wedding.

senses.note: THIRty(30) vs thirTEEN(13), 강세 위치로 구별. 시간 표현 "~시 30분"은 six thirty 처럼 숫자 뒤에 바로 붙임. 서수는 thirtieth(30th).

senses.meaningEn: the number 1,000

examples.en: The laptop costs about a thousand dollars.
Five thousand people live in this town.

senses.note: 영어는 세 자리마다 쉼표: 10,000 = ten thousand. 한국어 '만(10,000)'에 해당하는 단어가 없어서 ten thousand 로 말함.

senses.meaningEn: a very large number of people or things

examples.en: Thousands of fans came to the concert.
I have a thousand things to do today.

senses.note: a thousand things to do = 할 일이 엄청 많다(과장 표현).

senses.meaningEn: the number 3

examples.en: My son is three years old.
I'll be there in three minutes.

senses.note: th 는 혀를 윗니 뒤에 대고 내는 /θ/ 소리. tree(/triː/)와 구별할 것. 서수는 third(3rd). three times = 세 번.

senses.meaningEn: the short thick finger on the side of your hand

examples.en: The baby is sucking her thumb.
He gave me a thumbs up.

senses.note: 끝의 b 는 소리 내지 않음(/θʌm/). thumbs up = 좋아요, 찬성. 엄지발가락은 big toe.

senses.meaningEn: the loud sound you hear in the sky during a storm

examples.en: Did you hear that thunder?
My dog is scared of thunder.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: a thunder ✗ → a clap of thunder(천둥 한 번). 천둥은 소리(thunder), 번개는 빛(lightning): thunder and lightning 순서로 묶어 말함. thunderstorm = 뇌우.

senses.meaningEn: the day of the week after Wednesday and before Friday

examples.en: I'll send you the report by Thursday.
We usually have pizza night on Thursday.
examples.ko: 우리는 보통 목요일에 피자 먹는 날을 해.

senses.note: 철자에 주의: Thursday(Tuesday 와 혼동). 첫소리 th 는 /θ/ 로 혀를 윗니에 대고 발음한다. by Thursday = 목요일까지(기한). 줄임말은 Thu. 또는 Thurs.

senses.meaningEn: with everything in its place and nothing lying around

examples.en: Her desk is always neat and tidy.
examples.ko: 그녀의 책상은 항상 깔끔하게 정돈돼 있어.

examples.en: Keep your room tidy, please.

senses.note: neat and tidy 로 자주 붙여 씀. clean(더럽지 않은)과 tidy(물건이 정리된)는 다름.

senses.meaningEn: to put things in their right place so a room looks neat

examples.en: Let's tidy the living room before Mom comes.
examples.ko: 엄마 오시기 전에 거실 좀 치우자.

examples.en: I need to tidy my desk.

senses.note: tidy up = 정리하다. 미국에서는 clean up 이 더 흔하고 tidy 는 영국식 느낌.

senses.meaningEn: a long narrow piece of cloth worn around the neck under a shirt collar

examples.en: He wore a blue tie to the interview.
examples.ko: 그는 면접에 파란 넥타이를 하고 갔어.

examples.en: Can you help me with my tie?

senses.note: necktie 라고도 함. 넥타이를 '매다' = put on/tie a tie, '풀다' = take off/loosen.

senses.meaningEn: to fasten something with a string, rope, or knot

examples.en: Tie your shoes before you run.
She tied her hair back with a ribbon.

senses.note: tie - tied - tied, 현재분사는 tying. 풀다 = untie.

senses.meaningEn: a result in a game where both sides have the same score

examples.en: The game ended in a tie, two to two.
It was a tie, so nobody won.

senses.note: 영국식은 draw. 동사로도 쓰임: The two teams tied.

senses.meaningEn: a large wild cat with orange fur and black stripes that lives in Asia

examples.en: The tiger is the biggest cat in the world.
examples.ko: 호랑이는 세계에서 가장 큰 고양잇과 동물이야.

examples.en: My son's favorite animal is the tiger.
examples.ko: 우리 아들이 가장 좋아하는 동물은 호랑이야.

senses.note: 호랑이 무늬는 stripes(줄무늬). 호랑이는 한국의 상징 동물. 새끼는 cub. 발음은 '타이거'(/ˈtaɪɡər/).

senses.meaningEn: what we measure in hours and minutes, or a point on the clock

examples.en: What time is it now?
Sorry, I don't have time today.

senses.note: '시간이 있다/없다'는 have time(셀 수 없는 명사, a 없이). on time = 정각에, in time = 시간 안에(늦지 않게). 시각을 묻는 가장 자연스러운 말은 What time is it? 또는 Do you have the time?

senses.meaningEn: a particular moment or period when something happens

examples.en: This is not a good time to call.
I had a great time at your party.

senses.note: have a good/great/hard time = 좋은/힘든 시간을 보내다. at the same time = 동시에. for the time being = 당분간.

senses.meaningEn: one occasion when something happens

examples.en: I've seen this movie three times.
Next time, let's try the other restaurant.

senses.note: once(한 번), twice(두 번), three times(세 번)… 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: one time 보다 once, two times 보다 twice 가 자연스럽다. every time = 매번, this time = 이번에.

senses.meaningEn: feeling that you need to rest or sleep

examples.en: I'm so tired. I didn't sleep well last night.
examples.ko: 너무 피곤해. 어젯밤에 잠을 잘 못 잤어.

examples.en: You look tired. Why don't you go to bed early?
examples.ko: 피곤해 보여. 일찍 자는 게 어때?

senses.note: be/feel/get/look tired. 매우 피곤하면 exhausted. 피곤하게 만드는 것은 tiring(a tiring day).

senses.meaningEn: bored with something because it has happened too often

examples.en: I'm tired of eating the same thing every day.
examples.ko: 매일 같은 것 먹는 게 지겨워.

examples.en: She is tired of waiting for his call.
examples.ko: 그녀는 그의 전화를 기다리는 데 지쳤어.

senses.note: be tired of + 명사/-ing. sick of 와 비슷하며 sick and tired of 로 강조.

senses.meaningEn: on this day

examples.en: I'm not going to school today.
What did you do today?

senses.note: today 앞에 전치사를 쓰지 않는다: on today (X). 명사로도 씀: Today is Friday. / today's news(오늘의 뉴스).

senses.meaningEn: in the present time, these days

examples.en: Today, most people have a smartphone.
examples.ko: 오늘날 대부분의 사람들이 스마트폰을 가지고 있어.

examples.en: Kids today spend a lot of time online.
examples.ko: 요즘 아이들은 온라인에서 시간을 많이 보내.

senses.note: 이 뜻으로는 문장 앞에 Today, 로 시작하거나 명사 뒤에 붙인다(young people today). 글에서는 nowadays 보다 today 가 더 자연스럽다.

senses.meaningEn: one of the five parts at the end of your foot

examples.en: Ouch, I hit my toe on the door.
Wiggle your toes to warm them up.

senses.note: 손가락은 finger, 발가락은 toe. big toe(엄지발가락), little toe(새끼발가락).

senses.meaningEn: the bowl with a seat that you sit on to use the bathroom

examples.en: The toilet is clogged again.
Please flush the toilet after you use it.
examples.ko: 사용한 뒤에는 변기 물을 내려 주세요.

senses.note: flush the toilet = 변기 물을 내리다. toilet paper = 휴지.

senses.meaningEn: a room with a toilet in it

examples.en: Excuse me, where's the toilet?
I need to go to the toilet.

senses.note: 미국에서는 toilet 이 변기 자체를 뜻해서 '화장실 어디예요?'는 Where's the bathroom/restroom? 이 자연스러움. 영국·호주에서는 toilet 으로 화장실을 말함.

senses.meaningEn: a soft red fruit eaten as a vegetable, often in salads and sauces

examples.en: Add two tomatoes to the salad.
I don't like raw tomato.

senses.note: 복수형은 tomatoes(-es). 미국식 발음은 /təˈmeɪtoʊ/, 영국식은 /təˈmɑːtəʊ/.

senses.meaningEn: on the day after today

examples.en: See you tomorrow!
I have a big test tomorrow morning.

senses.note: tomorrow morning/afternoon/night 처럼 바로 이어 쓴다(전치사 없음). the day after tomorrow = 내후일. 명사로도 씀: Tomorrow is a holiday. 철자에 주의: m 하나, r 두 개.

senses.meaningEn: the soft part inside your mouth that you taste and speak with

examples.en: I burned my tongue on the hot soup.
Stick out your tongue, please.

senses.note: 발음은 '텅'(/tʌŋ/), 끝의 ue 는 소리 나지 않음. 혀를 깨물다 = bite my tongue.

senses.meaningEn: a language, especially the one you learned as a child

examples.en: Korean is my mother tongue.
English is not her native tongue.

senses.note: mother tongue = native language(모국어). 보통 이 표현 안에서만 쓰고, 일반적인 '언어'는 language.

senses.meaningEn: on the evening or night of today

examples.en: Are you free tonight?
Let's order pizza for dinner tonight.

senses.note: 오늘 저녁 식사 시간대까지 포함해서 넓게 '오늘 밤'을 가리킨다. '어젯밤'은 last night, '내일 밤'은 tomorrow night. this night (X) 라고 하지 않는다.

senses.meaningEn: one of the hard white things in your mouth that you bite with

examples.en: I have a loose tooth.
The dentist pulled out my bad tooth.

senses.note: 한 개는 tooth, 두 개 이상은 teeth(tooths ×). 이가 아프다 = have a toothache. 치과 = the dentist's.

senses.meaningEn: a pain in one of your teeth

examples.en: I have a toothache, so I'm going to the dentist.
A bad toothache kept me awake all night.
examples.ko: 심한 치통 때문에 밤새 잠을 못 잤어.

senses.note: tooth(이 하나) + ache. 치과 = the dentist / dentist's office. 이가 아프다 = My tooth hurts.

senses.meaningEn: a small brush used for cleaning your teeth

examples.en: I need a new toothbrush. This one is old.
Don't forget to pack your toothbrush.

senses.note: tooth(단수)+brush. teethbrush 라고 하지 않는다. 전동 칫솔은 electric toothbrush.

senses.meaningEn: a soft substance you put on a toothbrush to clean your teeth

examples.en: Put a little toothpaste on the brush.
Which toothpaste do you use?

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. '치약 하나'는 a tube of toothpaste.

senses.meaningEn: a piece of soft cloth used for drying yourself or things

examples.en: Can you hand me a towel, please?
The hotel gives you fresh towels every day.
examples.ko: 그 호텔은 매일 새 수건을 줘.

senses.note: 목욕 수건 bath towel, 손 수건 hand towel, 종이 타월 paper towel. 발음은 [타월]에 가깝다.

senses.meaningEn: things you throw away because you do not want them

examples.en: Can you take out the trash tonight?
examples.ko: 오늘 밤 쓰레기 좀 내다 버려 줄래?

examples.en: Don't leave trash on the table.

senses.note: 미국식. 영국에서는 rubbish. take out the trash = 쓰레기를 내다 버리다. 셀 수 없는 명사라 a trash (X).

senses.meaningEn: a container that you put trash in

examples.en: Throw it in the trash can over there.
The trash can is full again.

senses.note: garbage can 도 같은 뜻. 영국에서는 bin. 컴퓨터 화면의 쓰레기통도 trash.

senses.meaningEn: a tall plant with a trunk, branches, and leaves

examples.en: There's a big tree in front of our house.
examples.ko: 우리 집 앞에 큰 나무가 있어.

examples.en: The kids love climbing trees.

senses.note: 살아 있는 나무 = tree, 재료인 목재 = wood(a wooden table). 나무를 심다 = plant a tree, 베다 = cut down a tree. Christmas tree, family tree(가계도), apple tree.

senses.meaningEn: to make an effort to do something

examples.en: I'll try to call you tonight.
She tried hard, but she didn't win.

senses.note: try to do = ~하려고 노력하다. 구어에서는 try and do 도 흔함. Nice try! = 아쉽지만 잘했어(격려 또는 가벼운 놀림).

senses.meaningEn: to test something to see if you like it

examples.en: Try this soup. It's really good.
examples.ko: 이 수프 한번 먹어 봐. 진짜 맛있어.

examples.en: Have you tried Korean food before?
examples.ko: 한국 음식 먹어 본 적 있어요?

senses.note: try + 명사 = 먹어 보다/써 보다. try on 은 옷·신발을 '입어 보다'. try doing = 시험 삼아 ~해 보다(try to do 와 뜻이 다름).

senses.meaningEn: an attempt to do something

examples.en: Let me have a try.
He got it right on his first try.

senses.note: give it a try = 한번 해 보다. 미국식으로 have a try 보다 give it a try/shot 이 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: the day of the week after Monday and before Wednesday

examples.en: The meeting was moved to Tuesday.
We play soccer every Tuesday evening.

senses.note: 철자에 주의: Tuesday(Thursday 와 헷갈리기 쉬움). 미국식 발음은 /ˈtuːzdeɪ/, 영국식은 /ˈtjuːzdeɪ/. 글에서는 Tue. 또는 Tues. 로 줄여 쓴다.

senses.meaningEn: a brightly colored spring flower shaped like a cup

examples.en: Tulips come out in April.
She planted yellow tulips by the door.
examples.ko: 그녀는 문 옆에 노란 튤립을 심었어.

senses.note: 발음 주의: /ˈtuːlɪp/ (튜울립 아님). 네덜란드(the Netherlands)가 튤립으로 유명함.

senses.meaningEn: to change direction

examples.en: Turn left at the next corner.
Turn around, you're going the wrong way.

senses.note: turn left / turn right / turn around. 길 안내의 기본 표현.

senses.meaningEn: to become a different color, state, or age

examples.en: The leaves turn red in October.
My son turns seven next month.
examples.ko: 우리 아들은 다음 달에 일곱 살이 돼.

senses.note: turn + 색/나이. turn thirty = 서른 살이 되다.

senses.meaningEn: the time when it is your chance to do something

examples.en: It's your turn to roll the dice.
Please wait your turn in line.

senses.note: take turns = 번갈아 하다.

senses.meaningEn: to make a machine, light, or water stop

examples.en: Turn off your phone during the movie.
examples.ko: 영화 보는 동안 폰 꺼 줘.

examples.en: Did you turn off the water in the bathroom?

senses.note: turn off 는 전원·물·가스 모두 가능. switch off 도 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: to leave the road you are driving on

examples.en: Turn off at the next exit.
We turned off the highway to get gas.

senses.meaningEn: to make a machine or light start working

examples.en: Can you turn on the TV?
Turn the light on, it's too dark.

senses.note: turn on the TV / turn the TV on 둘 다 가능. 대명사는 turn it on 만 가능.

senses.meaningEn: to make water or gas start flowing

examples.en: Turn on the hot water for the bath.
Don't turn on the gas yet.

senses.meaningEn: an animal with a hard shell on its back that moves slowly and lives in or near water

examples.en: The turtle slowly walked across the beach.
I have a small turtle as a pet.

senses.note: 미국에서는 민물·바다 거북 모두 turtle. 땅거북은 tortoise. 거북 등딱지는 shell. 느린 것의 대표: as slow as a turtle.

senses.meaningEn: short for television; the machine with a screen

examples.en: Turn off the TV and go to bed.
The TV in my room is really small.

senses.note: 보통 대문자 TV 로 씀. the TV = 기기, 복수는 TVs.

senses.meaningEn: the programs you watch on television

examples.en: What's on TV tonight?
I saw him on TV yesterday.

senses.note: watch TV, on TV 에는 the 를 붙이지 않음. TV show = TV 프로그램.

senses.meaningEn: the number 12

examples.en: Lunch is at twelve.
A year has twelve months.

senses.note: 서수는 twelfth(12th, v 가 f 로 바뀜). 12개 묶음은 a dozen. 12시는 twelve o'clock 또는 noon(정오)/midnight(자정)으로 말함.

senses.meaningEn: the number 20

examples.en: This jacket was only twenty dollars.
I'll be twenty next month.
examples.ko: 나 다음 달에 스무 살 돼.

senses.note: 미국식 발음은 t 가 약해져 /ˈtweni/ 처럼 들림. 21~29는 twenty-one, twenty-two 처럼 하이픈으로 연결. 서수는 twentieth(20th). in your twenties = 20대에.

senses.meaningEn: two times

examples.en: I brush my teeth twice a day.
examples.ko: 나는 하루에 두 번 이를 닦아.

examples.en: She called me twice this morning.
examples.ko: 그녀가 오늘 아침에 두 번 전화했어.

senses.note: two times 보다 twice 가 훨씬 자연스러움. 세 번부터는 three times, four times. Think twice. = 다시 한번 생각해 봐.

senses.meaningEn: two times as much or as many

examples.en: This bag costs twice as much as that one.
examples.ko: 이 가방은 저거보다 두 배나 비싸.

examples.en: My brother eats twice as much as me.
examples.ko: 우리 형은 나보다 두 배는 먹어.

senses.note: twice as + 형용사/부사 + as 형태로 비교. 세 배 이상은 three times as ... as.

senses.meaningEn: one of two children born to the same mother at the same time

examples.en: My brother and I are twins.
She has a twin sister who looks just like her.
examples.ko: 그녀는 자기랑 똑 닮은 쌍둥이 여동생이 있어.

senses.note: 두 명을 말할 때 twins. identical twins = 일란성 쌍둥이, twin brother/sister = 쌍둥이 형제/자매.

senses.meaningEn: having two matching parts, such as two single beds

examples.en: I'd like a twin room for two nights, please.
examples.ko: 1인용 침대 두 개 있는 방으로 이틀 묵고 싶어요.

examples.en: The hotel room has twin beds.
examples.ko: 그 호텔 방에는 1인용 침대가 두 개 있어.

senses.note: 호텔 예약 필수 단어. twin room(침대 두 개) vs double room(2인용 침대 하나).

senses.meaningEn: the number 2

examples.en: A table for two, please.
The movie starts at two thirty.

senses.note: to, too 와 발음이 같음(/tuː/). 서수는 second(2nd). the two of us = 우리 둘. 식당에서 Table for two 는 필수 표현.

senses.meaningEn: not nice to look at

examples.en: That is the ugliest sweater I have ever seen.
examples.ko: 저건 내가 본 것 중 가장 못생긴 스웨터야.

examples.en: The building is old and a little ugly.
examples.ko: 그 건물은 오래되고 좀 보기 흉해.

senses.note: 사람에게 직접 쓰면 매우 무례함. 물건·건물·옷에 쓰는 것이 안전하다. ugly duckling(미운 오리 새끼).

senses.meaningEn: unpleasant, angry, or likely to become violent

examples.en: The argument got ugly very fast.
He said some ugly things to her.
examples.ko: 그가 그녀에게 아주 못된 말을 했어.

senses.note: turn/get ugly = (상황이) 험악해지다. 날씨에도 씀: ugly weather(궂은 날씨).

senses.meaningEn: a thing you hold over your head to keep dry in the rain

examples.en: Take an umbrella; it might rain.
I left my umbrella on the bus again.

senses.note: 우산을 '쓰다'는 use an umbrella, '펴다/접다'는 open/close an umbrella. 양산도 (sun) umbrella 또는 parasol.

senses.meaningEn: the brother of your mother or father, or the husband of your aunt

examples.en: My uncle gave me a bike for my birthday.
Uncle Tom tells the funniest jokes.
examples.ko: 톰 삼촌은 정말 재미있는 농담을 하셔.

senses.note: 삼촌·외삼촌·고모부·이모부 모두 uncle. 한국어처럼 모르는 아저씨를 uncle 이라고 부르지 않음.

senses.meaningEn: to know what something means or how it works

examples.en: I don't understand this question.
Do you understand English?

senses.note: 진행형(I'm understanding)으로 쓰지 않음. 대화 중 '알겠어요'는 I see. / Got it. 이 더 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: to know how someone feels and why they act that way

examples.en: My mom always understands me.
I understand how you feel.

senses.note: I understand. 는 상대의 사정을 받아들인다는 뜻. 상대가 화났을 때 I understand you. 보다 I understand how you feel. 이 자연스러움.

senses.meaningEn: special clothes worn by all members of a school, team, or job
