examples.en: Do you have to wear a uniform at your school?
The nurse was wearing a white uniform.

senses.note: 교복은 school uniform. 소리 /j/ 로 시작하므로 an uniform ✗ → a uniform.

senses.meaningEn: up to a particular time, and then stopping

examples.en: The store is open until nine.
I'll wait here until lunch time.

senses.note: until 은 '그때까지 계속되는' 상태·행동에 쓴다. 마감처럼 '그 전 어느 시점에 한 번' 하는 일은 by 를 쓴다(finish it by Friday). 한국어 '~까지' 가 둘 다를 뜻해 가장 흔한 실수. 구어체 till 도 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: up to the time when something happens

examples.en: Wait until the light turns green.
Stir the soup until it gets hot.

senses.note: until 절도 미래라도 현재형(until it gets hot). not ... until = ~해서야 비로소: I didn't know until yesterday(어제야 알았어).

senses.meaningEn: to or on a higher floor of a building

examples.en: Go upstairs and brush your teeth.
My bedroom is upstairs, next to the bathroom.
examples.ko: 내 방은 위층에 있어, 욕실 옆에.

senses.note: go upstairs 처럼 to 없이 바로 씀(go to upstairs ✗). 형용사로도 씀: the upstairs bathroom.

senses.meaningEn: most of the time, but not always

examples.en: I usually get up at seven.
What do you usually do on weekends?

senses.note: always(100%)보다 약하고 often 보다 강하다(약 80~90%). 위치는 일반동사 앞, be 동사 뒤(He is usually quiet). 문장 앞에 Usually, ... 로 쓸 수도 있음. 형용사 usual: as usual = 평소처럼.

senses.meaningEn: a period when school is closed and students do not have classes

examples.en: Summer vacation starts next week!
What did you do during winter vacation?

senses.note: 미국식 vacation, 영국식 holiday. summer/winter vacation = 여름/겨울 방학. 미국 학교에서는 짧은 방학을 break(spring break)라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: time off from work, often spent traveling

examples.en: We're going on vacation to Jeju.
He's on vacation until Friday.

senses.note: go on vacation / be on vacation. take a vacation = 휴가를 내다. 영국식은 go on holiday. 전치사는 on 을 써야 함(in vacation 은 틀림).

senses.meaningEn: a plant or part of a plant that is eaten as food, such as a carrot or onion

examples.en: Eat your vegetables before you have dessert.
We buy fresh vegetables at the market every week.
examples.ko: 우리는 매주 시장에서 신선한 채소를 사.

senses.note: 보통 복수형 vegetables 로 씀. 일상 대화에서는 veggies 로 줄여 말함. 발음은 3음절 [베지터블]이 아니라 [베취터블]처럼 e 를 거의 생략.

senses.meaningEn: to go to see a person or a place

examples.en: We visited my grandma last weekend.
I want to visit Japan next year.

senses.note: visit to Japan (X) → visit Japan. 동사 뒤에 전치사 없이 바로 장소·사람. 웹사이트 방문도 visit a website.

senses.meaningEn: an occasion when you go to see a person or place

examples.en: Thanks for the visit, come again soon.
examples.ko: 와 줘서 고마워, 또 놀러 와.

examples.en: This is my first visit to Busan.

senses.note: 명사일 때는 a visit to + 장소. pay a visit = 방문하다. 병원 진료도 a doctor's visit.

senses.meaningEn: the sound you make when you speak or sing

examples.en: She has a beautiful singing voice.
Please lower your voice, the baby is sleeping.
examples.ko: 목소리 좀 낮춰, 아기가 자고 있어.

senses.note: 목소리가 안 나오다 lose my voice. 큰 목소리로 in a loud voice. 전화 음성은 voice message.

senses.meaningEn: to stay where you are until something happens or someone comes

examples.en: Wait for me! I'm almost ready.
We waited an hour for the bus.

senses.note: wait for + 사람/사물(for 를 빠뜨리는 실수가 많음). Wait a minute. / Hold on. = 잠깐만. I can't wait! = 너무 기대돼!

senses.meaningEn: to serve food and drinks to people at tables

examples.en: She waits tables at a cafe on weekends.
examples.ko: 그녀는 주말에 카페에서 서빙 일을 해.

examples.en: I waited tables when I was in college.
examples.ko: 대학 때 식당에서 서빙 아르바이트를 했어.

senses.note: wait tables = 식당에서 서빙하다(미국 구어). waiter/waitress 가 여기서 나온 말. 요즘은 server 라고 함.

senses.meaningEn: a man who serves food and drinks at a restaurant

examples.en: The waiter brought us the menu.
Let's ask the waiter for some water.

senses.note: 종업원을 부를 때 'Waiter!' 라고 소리치지 않음. 'Excuse me.' 가 자연스러움. 성별 중립 표현은 server.

senses.meaningEn: a woman who serves food and drinks at a restaurant

examples.en: The waitress was very kind to us.
She works as a waitress on weekends.

senses.note: 요즘은 성별 구분 없이 server 를 많이 씀. 사람을 직접 부를 때는 Excuse me.

senses.meaningEn: one of the flat sides of a room or building

examples.en: Let's paint the walls light blue.
There's a picture of us on the wall.

senses.note: 벽'에' 걸다는 on the wall(in 아님).

senses.meaningEn: a tall structure of stone or brick that goes around an area

examples.en: There's a stone wall around the old town.
The kids climbed over the wall into the yard.

senses.note: the Great Wall of China = 만리장성. 나무 울타리는 fence.

senses.meaningEn: a small flat case for carrying money and cards

examples.en: I left my wallet at home.
He keeps a photo of his kids in his wallet.
examples.ko: 그는 지갑에 아이들 사진을 넣고 다녀.

senses.note: 남녀 모두 쓰는 접이식 지갑. 미국에서 purse 는 지갑이 아니라 여성용 핸드백이니 주의. 동전 지갑은 coin purse.

senses.meaningEn: a little hot, in a pleasant way

examples.en: It's nice and warm today.
Put on a warm coat before you go out.

senses.note: 온도 순서: cold < cool < warm < hot. warm 은 '기분 좋게 따뜻한' 느낌. warm water = 따뜻한 물, hot water = 뜨거운 물.

senses.meaningEn: friendly and kind

examples.en: They gave us a warm welcome.
She's a warm and caring person.

senses.note: a warm welcome(따뜻한 환영), warm regards(이메일 맺음말: 안부를 전하며).

senses.meaningEn: to make something a little hotter

examples.en: Can you warm up the soup for me?
Sit by the fire and warm your hands.
examples.ko: 불 옆에 앉아서 손 좀 녹여.

senses.note: warm up = 데우다, 몸을 풀다(운동 전 준비운동).

senses.meaningEn: to clean something with water and often soap

examples.en: Wash your hands before you eat.
I washed my face with cold water.

senses.note: wash my face(세수하다), wash my hair(머리 감다). 몸 전체를 씻는 것은 take a shower / take a bath.

senses.meaningEn: to clean clothes or dishes

examples.en: I'll wash the dishes after dinner.
Can you wash these jeans today?
examples.ko: 이 청바지 오늘 빨아 줄 수 있어?

senses.note: wash the dishes = do the dishes(설거지하다). wash the clothes = do the laundry(빨래하다).

senses.meaningEn: to look at something for a period of time

examples.en: We watched a movie together last night.
I like watching soccer on TV.
examples.ko: 나는 TV로 축구 보는 걸 좋아해.

senses.note: TV·영화·경기는 watch, 그냥 눈에 들어오는 건 see, 시선을 돌리는 건 look.

senses.meaningEn: a small clock you wear on your wrist

examples.en: I got a new watch for my birthday.
My watch says it's almost three.

senses.note: 벽시계는 clock, 손목시계는 watch.

senses.meaningEn: to be careful about something

examples.en: Watch your step, the floor is wet.
Watch out! A car is coming.

senses.note: Watch out! = 조심해! Watch your head = 머리 조심.

senses.meaningEn: the clear liquid that falls as rain and that people drink

examples.en: Can I have a glass of water, please?
Drink plenty of water every day.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사. a water 가 아니라 a glass of water, a bottle of water. 식당에서 생수는 bottled water, 수돗물은 tap water.

senses.meaningEn: to pour water on plants

examples.en: Don't forget to water the plants.
examples.ko: 식물에 물 주는 거 잊지 마.

examples.en: I water the garden every evening.

senses.note: give water to the plants 보다 water the plants 가 훨씬 자연스럽다.

senses.meaningEn: a place where water falls from a high place, such as a cliff

examples.en: We took photos in front of the waterfall.
You can hear the waterfall from here.

senses.note: water + fall 을 붙여서 한 단어로 씀. 유명한 폭포 이름은 Niagara Falls 처럼 Falls 라고도 함.

senses.meaningEn: a very large, round fruit with a green skin and sweet red inside

examples.en: Nothing beats cold watermelon on a hot day.
Can you cut the watermelon into slices?

senses.note: 통째로는 a watermelon(셀 수 있음), 잘라 놓은 과육은 some watermelon(셀 수 없음). 한 조각은 a slice of watermelon. 참외·멜론류는 melon.

senses.meaningEn: not strong in body or health

examples.en: I feel weak after being sick all week.
Grandpa's legs are weak now, so he walks slowly.
examples.ko: 할아버지는 이제 다리가 약해서 천천히 걸으셔.

senses.note: week(주)와 발음이 같다(/wiːk/). 문맥으로 구분.

senses.meaningEn: having little flavor or not much of a substance in it

examples.en: This coffee is too weak for me.
I like my tea weak, with lots of milk.
examples.ko: 나는 차를 연하게, 우유 많이 넣어서 마셔.

senses.note: 커피·차가 연하면 weak, 진하면 strong. thin coffee 라고 하지 않는다.

senses.meaningEn: to have clothes, shoes, glasses, or jewelry on your body

examples.en: What are you wearing to the party?
She wore a red dress yesterday.

senses.note: 한국어는 입다/쓰다/신다/끼다/차다로 갈리지만 영어는 모두 wear. put on 은 '입는 동작', wear 는 '입고 있는 상태'. 화장·향수·머리 모양도 wear(wear makeup, wear perfume). wear-wore-worn.

senses.meaningEn: to become thin or damaged from being used a lot

examples.en: My shoes are worn out.
These jeans have worn thin at the knees.

senses.note: wear out = 닳아서 못 쓰게 되다; 사람에게 쓰면 '지치게 하다'(I'm worn out = 완전히 지쳤어).

senses.meaningEn: the condition of the air outside, such as sun, rain, or wind

examples.en: What's the weather like today?
We had great weather on our trip.

senses.note: 셀 수 없는 명사: a weather ✗, a good weather ✗ → good weather ✓. weather(날씨)와 whether(~인지)는 발음이 같음. 날씨 묻기: How's the weather? / What's the weather like?

senses.meaningEn: the day of the week after Tuesday and before Thursday

examples.en: Are you free on Wednesday afternoon?
The library is closed on Wednesdays.

senses.note: 철자와 발음이 다르다: 첫 d 는 발음하지 않음(/ˈwenzdeɪ/). 한국인이 자주 틀리는 것: Wen-nes-day 로 3음절 발음하기. 줄임말은 Wed.

senses.meaningEn: a period of seven days, usually from Monday to Sunday

examples.en: I go to the gym three times a week.
examples.ko: 나는 일주일에 세 번 헬스장에 가.

examples.en: See you next week!

senses.note: this week(이번 주), next week(다음 주), last week(지난주) 앞에는 전치사를 쓰지 않는다: on next week (X). once a week = 일주일에 한 번. 발음이 weak(약한)와 같다.

senses.meaningEn: the working days of the week, Monday to Friday

examples.en: I'm too busy during the week, so let's meet Saturday.
We work a five-day week at my company.

senses.note: during the week = 주중에(평일에). a four-day week = 주 4일 근무. weekday(평일) ↔ weekend(주말).

senses.meaningEn: Saturday and Sunday

examples.en: What are you doing this weekend?
We went camping on the weekend.

senses.note: 미국식은 on the weekend, 영국식은 at the weekend. on weekends = 주말마다. Have a good weekend! 는 금요일 작별 인사로 아주 흔하다. this weekend 앞에는 전치사 없음.

senses.meaningEn: happening or done once every week

examples.en: We have a weekly meeting on Monday.
I get paid weekly, not monthly.

senses.note: 형용사(a weekly meeting)와 부사(meet weekly) 둘 다 같은 형태. 명사로 쓰면 "주간지". once a week 와 같은 뜻.

senses.meaningEn: how heavy someone or something is

examples.en: I've gained some weight this winter.
What's the weight of this package?

senses.note: 살이 빠지다 lose weight, 살이 찌다 gain/put on weight. wait(기다리다)와 발음이 같다. 동사 '무게를 재다'는 weigh.

senses.meaningEn: a heavy object that you lift to make your muscles stronger

examples.en: He lifts weights at the gym three times a week.
examples.ko: 그는 일주일에 세 번 헬스장에서 웨이트를 해.

examples.en: Start with light weights and go slowly.

senses.note: lift weights = 근력 운동을 하다. 한국어 '헬스하다'에 가장 가까운 표현은 work out.

senses.meaningEn: a very large sea animal that breathes air through a hole on top of its head

examples.en: The blue whale is the biggest animal on Earth.
We went whale watching on our trip to Hawaii.
examples.ko: 하와이 여행에서 고래 관찰 투어를 했어.

senses.note: whale 의 wh 는 /w/ 로 발음(/weɪl/), wail(울부짖다)과 같은 소리. whale watching(고래 관찰). 고래는 fish 가 아닌 mammal(포유류).

senses.meaningEn: a white board that you write on with special markers

examples.en: Write your answer on the whiteboard.
Who can erase the whiteboard for me?

senses.note: 쓰는 펜은 marker(whiteboard marker / dry-erase marker). 회의실에도 흔함.

senses.meaningEn: the woman that a person is married to

examples.en: My wife and I moved here last year.
examples.ko: 아내와 나는 작년에 여기로 이사 왔어.

examples.en: This is my wife, Jiyoung.

senses.note: 복수는 wifes 가 아니라 wives /waɪvz/. 남의 아내는 your wife, 자기 아내는 my wife.

senses.meaningEn: air that moves quickly outside

examples.en: The wind blew my hat off.
There's a cold wind today.

senses.note: 바람이 불다 = The wind blows / It's windy. strong wind(강풍), a light wind(약한 바람). 명사 wind 는 /wɪnd/, 동사 wind(감다, 구불구불하다)는 /waɪnd/ 로 발음이 다름.

senses.meaningEn: a space in a wall with glass in it that lets in light and air

examples.en: Could you open the window? It's hot in here.
examples.ko: 창문 좀 열어 줄래? 여기 덥다.

examples.en: I like sitting by the window on the train.

senses.note: 창가 자리 = window seat(비행기·기차). 가게 진열창도 window(shop window).

senses.meaningEn: a box on a computer screen that shows a program or a web page

examples.en: Close that window and open a new one.
examples.ko: 그 창 닫고 새 창을 열어.

examples.en: The link opens in a new window.

senses.note: 브라우저 탭은 tab, 창은 window. 팝업 창은 pop-up window.

senses.meaningEn: with a lot of wind

examples.en: It's too windy to use an umbrella.
examples.ko: 바람이 너무 세서 우산을 못 쓰겠어.

examples.en: Jeju is very windy in winter.

senses.note: '바람이 세다'를 The wind is strong 보다 It's windy 로 말하는 게 더 자연스러움. 발음 주의: windy /ˈwɪndi/, wind(감다)는 /waɪnd/.

senses.meaningEn: the coldest season of the year, between fall and spring

examples.en: It gets dark early in winter.
We go skiing every winter.

senses.note: winter break(겨울 방학), winter coat, the Winter Olympics. 날씨 이야기에서 cold/freezing 과 함께 자주 나온다.

senses.meaningEn: to clean or dry something by rubbing it with a cloth or your hand

examples.en: Please wipe the table after dinner.
examples.ko: 저녁 먹고 식탁 좀 닦아 줘.

examples.en: Wipe your hands with this towel.

senses.note: wipe off(닦아 내다), wipe up(흘린 것을 닦다), wipe down(표면 전체를 닦다). clean 은 일반적인 청소, wipe 는 문질러 닦는 동작.

senses.meaningEn: a wild animal like a large dog that lives and hunts in groups

examples.en: We heard a wolf howling in the forest.
Wolves live and hunt in groups called packs.
examples.ko: 늑대는 '팩'이라고 하는 무리를 지어 살고 사냥해.

senses.note: 복수형은 wolves(f→ves). 늑대는 howl(울부짖다). 동화 속 big bad wolf(나쁜 늑대), cry wolf = 거짓 경보를 울리다.

senses.meaningEn: to eat something very quickly and in large bites

examples.en: He wolfed down his lunch in five minutes.
examples.ko: 그는 5분 만에 점심을 뚝딱 먹어 치웠어.

examples.en: Don't wolf your food. Eat slowly.
examples.ko: 음식 너무 급하게 먹지 마. 천천히 먹어.

senses.note: 거의 항상 wolf down 으로 쓰임. 배고픈 늑대가 먹어 치우는 모습에서 온 표현. 비격식.

senses.meaningEn: an adult female person

examples.en: The woman in the blue dress is my teacher.
examples.ko: 파란 드레스 입은 여자분이 우리 선생님이야.

examples.en: Many women work at this company.

senses.note: 복수 women 의 발음은 /ˈwɪmɪn/ (위민). 단수 woman 은 /ˈwʊmən/ (우먼). 한국인이 자주 섞어 발음함.

senses.meaningEn: the hard material that trees are made of, used for building and burning

examples.en: This table is made of wood.
We need more wood for the fire.

senses.note: 재료로서의 나무는 wood(불가산), 살아 있는 나무 한 그루는 tree. wooden = 나무로 된(형용사).

senses.meaningEn: a small forest; an area with many trees

examples.en: We walked through the woods behind the house.
examples.ko: 우리는 집 뒤 숲을 걸어서 지나갔어.

examples.en: Don't go into the woods alone at night.

senses.note: 이 뜻은 보통 복수 the woods. forest 보다 작은 숲.

senses.meaningEn: a single unit of language with a meaning

examples.en: What does this word mean?
I learn ten new words every day.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 새 단어를 열 개씩 외워.

senses.note: word 는 셀 수 있는 명사(a word, words). vocabulary(어휘)는 보통 셀 수 없음. in other words = 다시 말해서.

senses.meaningEn: something you say, or a promise

examples.en: Can I have a word with you?
examples.ko: 잠깐 얘기 좀 할 수 있을까?

examples.en: I give you my word. I'll be there.

senses.note: have a word with = ~와 잠깐 이야기하다(주로 진지한 이야기). keep your word = 약속을 지키다. Don't say a word. = 아무 말도 하지 마.

senses.meaningEn: to do a job, especially for money

examples.en: I work at a bank downtown.
She works from home on Fridays.

senses.note: work at/for + 회사, work as + 직업.

senses.meaningEn: to function correctly

examples.en: The elevator isn't working again.
Does this remote work with the TV?

senses.note: 기계가 '된다/안 된다'는 work / doesn't work. 아주 자주 쓰임.

senses.meaningEn: to have the result you want

examples.en: This medicine really works for headaches.
examples.ko: 이 약은 두통에 정말 효과가 있어.

examples.en: I tried your idea, and it worked!

senses.meaningEn: a job, or the place where you do it

examples.en: I have a lot of work to do today.
What time do you leave for work?

senses.note: work 는 셀 수 없는 명사. a work (X), many works (X). 직장 하나는 a job.

senses.meaningEn: the earth and all the people, places, and things on it

examples.en: I want to travel around the world.
English is spoken all over the world.

senses.note: 항상 the world. in the world = 세상에서(the best food in the world). World Cup, world record.

senses.meaningEn: a particular area of activity or life

examples.en: She works in the world of fashion.
Kids live in their own little world.

senses.meaningEn: the part of your body between your hand and your arm

examples.en: I hurt my wrist when I fell.
She wears a watch on her left wrist.

senses.note: w 는 발음하지 않음(/rɪst/). 발목은 ankle. 손목시계 = wristwatch.

senses.meaningEn: to make letters or words on paper or a screen

examples.en: Write your name here, please.
I wrote the answer in pencil.

senses.note: write down = 받아 적다, 메모하다. right(오른쪽/옳은)와 발음이 같음.

senses.meaningEn: to send someone a letter or message

examples.en: I'll write to you when I get there.
She wrote me a long email yesterday.
examples.ko: 그녀가 어제 나한테 긴 이메일을 썼어.

senses.note: write to someone(영) / write someone(미) 둘 다 가능.

senses.meaningEn: to create a book, story, song, or report

examples.en: He has written three children's books.
examples.ko: 그는 어린이 책을 세 권 썼어.

examples.en: We are writing a story in class.

senses.note: 책을 쓴 사람은 writer / author. 노래를 쓰다 write a song, 숙제를 하다 do homework(write ✗).

senses.meaningEn: the area of land next to a house, usually with grass

examples.en: The kids are playing in the yard.
I need to cut the grass in the back yard.

senses.note: front yard(앞마당), backyard(뒷마당). 미국식 표현. 영국에서는 garden.

senses.meaningEn: a unit for measuring length, equal to about 0.9 meters

examples.en: The store is about a hundred yards from here.
He ran fifty yards in a few seconds.

senses.note: 1 yard = 3 feet ≈ 0.91m. 미식축구·거리 말할 때 자주 등장.

senses.meaningEn: a period of twelve months or 365 days

examples.en: We moved to Seoul two years ago.
Happy New Year!

senses.note: this year / last year / next year 앞에는 전치사 없음. all year (round) = 일 년 내내. 나이: I'm 20 years old. (years 복수) / a 20-year-old student (단수).

senses.meaningEn: a period of about nine months when students go to school

examples.en: My son is in his first year of high school.
The school year starts in March in Korea.

senses.note: 미국 대학은 freshman/sophomore/junior/senior year 로 학년을 부른다. school year = 학년도. 발음에 주의: year(/jɪr/)와 ear(/ɪr/)를 구분한다.

senses.meaningEn: on the day before today

examples.en: I called you yesterday, but you didn't answer.
It rained all day yesterday.

senses.note: yesterday 가 있으면 동사는 과거형: I go there yesterday (X) → I went there yesterday (O). the day before yesterday = 그저께. yesterday morning(어제 아침)이라고 하지만 '어젯밤'은 last night(yesterday night 는 어색).

senses.meaningEn: up to now, used in negative sentences

examples.en: I haven't had lunch yet.
The bus isn't here yet.

senses.note: 부정문 끝에 와서 "아직 ~않다". Not yet. 한 마디로 "아직요"라고 답할 수 있음. still 은 "아직도 계속" 느낌: It's still raining.

senses.meaningEn: used in questions to ask if something has happened

examples.en: Have you finished your homework yet?
Is dinner ready yet?

senses.note: 의문문 끝의 yet 은 "이제 됐어?"라는 기대·재촉의 느낌. already 를 쓰면 "벌써 했다고?"라는 놀람.

senses.meaningEn: but; despite that

examples.en: The hotel was small, yet very clean.
He is rich, yet he is not happy.

senses.note: but 보다 조금 글말 느낌. 뜻밖의 대조를 강조할 때 씀.

senses.meaningEn: a thick, slightly sour food made from milk

examples.en: I had yogurt with fruit this morning.
examples.ko: 오늘 아침에 과일 넣은 요거트를 먹었어.

examples.en: Can you buy some yogurt at the store?
examples.ko: 가게에서 요거트 좀 사 올 수 있어?

senses.note: yoghurt 로도 씀(영국식). 발음은 '요구르트'가 아니라 /ˈjoʊɡərt/. 한국의 마시는 요구르트는 drinkable yogurt.

senses.meaningEn: tasting very good (informal, often used by or with children)

examples.en: Yummy! I love this cake.
Mom made some yummy cookies for us.
examples.ko: 엄마가 우리한테 맛있는 쿠키를 만들어 주셨어.

senses.note: 아주 캐주얼한 말. 격식 있는 자리나 글에서는 delicious 를 씀. 반대말 yucky(맛없는, 더러운).

senses.meaningEn: an African wild animal like a horse with black and white stripes

examples.en: A zebra looks like a horse with stripes.
Zebras live together in big groups.

senses.note: 미국식 발음은 /ˈziːbrə/(지브라), 영국식은 /ˈzebrə/(제브라). 영국에서 zebra crossing 은 횡단보도(미국은 crosswalk).

senses.meaningEn: the number 0; nothing

examples.en: My phone number ends in zero.
The score was two to zero.

senses.note: 전화번호·방 번호를 읽을 때는 zero 대신 oh(/oʊ/)라고도 많이 읽음. 축구 점수에서는 nil(영국)·nothing(미국)도 씀. 복수형은 zeros.

senses.meaningEn: the temperature at which water freezes, 0 degrees Celsius

examples.en: It will be below zero tonight.
The temperature is five degrees above zero.

senses.note: below zero = 영하, above zero = 영상. 미국은 화씨(Fahrenheit)를 쓰므로 미국 날씨에서 zero 는 섭씨 -18도쯤임.

senses.meaningEn: a fastener with two rows of metal or plastic teeth that you pull together to close clothes or bags

examples.en: The zipper on my bag is broken.
Pull the zipper up; it's cold.

senses.note: 미국식 zipper, 영국식 zip. 동사는 zip up(올리다)/unzip(내리다). 지퍼가 '걸리다' = The zipper is stuck.
